description:
Kungakhathaliseki ubudala, bonke abashayeli abasha bayingxenye yohlelo lwe-Graduated Driver Licensing (GDL). Lolu hlelo luqinisekisa ukuthi abashayeli abasha bathola ukwesekwa, amakhono, kanye nolwazi abaludingayo ukuze babhekane nomsebenzi onzima wokushayela. I-GDL ithuthukisa ukuphepha emgwaqweni ngokudala indawo ephephile nelawulwayo yabo bonke abashayeli abasha.

 Njengomshayeli we-GDL, uzoba nelinye lamalayisense okushayela alandelayo:
• Isigaba Sokuqala: Isigaba 7 (Ilayisensi Yomfundi)
• Isigaba Sesibili: Isigaba 5-GDL (Ilayisensi Yokuhlola)

 Ulwazi olulandelayo luqokomisa izici ezibalulekile zezigaba Zomfundi kanye Nezokuhlola zohlelo lwe-GDL.

 Isigaba 1: Umfundi (Isigaba 7)

 Ukuze uthole ilayisensi yomfundi yesigaba 7 kufanele:
• ube neminyaka engu-14 noma ngaphezulu
• uphumelele ukuhlolwa kokubona
• uphumelele isivivinyo solwazi ngemithetho yomgwaqo
• ube nemvume yabazali uma ungaphansi kweminyaka eyi-18 ubudala
• ube nobunikazi obusebenzayo.

 Imibandela yomfundi:
• Kufanele ube nelayisensi yokufunda (Ibanga lesi-7) okungenani unyaka owodwa.
• Kufanele uhambisane nomshayeli onelayisensi ephelele (ongeyena owe-GDL) oneminyaka eyi-18 noma ngaphezulu futhi ohlezi eduze kwakho.
• Awuvunyelwe ukushayela kusukela phakathi kwamabili kuya ku-5 ekuseni.
• Awuvunyelwe ukuba nabagibeli abaningi kunamabhande esihlalo.
• Uzomiswa uma uqoqa amaphuzu ayisishiyagalombili noma ngaphezulu okungekho emthethweni.
• Kufanele ube nezinga lotshwala kanye/noma lezidakamizwa elingekho lapho ushayela (noma ugibela isithuthuthu).

 Isigaba sesi-2: I-GDL Probationary (Ibanga lesi-5-GDL)

 Ukuze ube ngumshayeli wesilingo kumele:
• ube nelayisensi yakho ye-leaner yebanga lesi-7 unyaka wonke (lesi sikhathi sizokwelulwa uma uthola ukumiswa kwamalungelo akho okushayela)
• ube neminyaka eyi-16 noma ngaphezulu
• uphumelele isivivinyo somgwaqo sase-Alberta sebanga lesi-5.

 Izimo zesilingo:
• Kufanele ube ngumshayeli wesilingo okungenani iminyaka emibili.
• Akufanele ube nabagibeli abangaphezu kwamabhande esihlalo.
• Uzomiswa uma uqoqa amaphuzu ayisishiyagalombili noma ngaphezulu okulahlekelwa yiwo.
• Kufanele ube nezinga lotshwala kanye/noma lezidakamizwa lapho ushayela.
• Awukwazi ukuhlanganisa kabusha ilayisensi yakho nelayisensi yokushayela yezentengiselwano (iBanga 1, 2, 3, noma 4).
• Awukwazi ukukhonza njengomshayeli oqaphayo kumfundi.

 Isigaba 3: Ibanga Eligcwele 5 (elingeyona i-GDL)

 Ukuze uphume ohlelweni lwe-GDL kumele:
• okungenani ube neminyaka eyi-18 ubudala
• ube sesigabeni sokuhlolwa okungenani iminyaka emibili
• ungabi nokumiswa noma ukwephulwa kwemithetho yethrafikhi ezinyangeni eziyi-12 zokugcina zesigaba sokuhlolwa, okuhlanganisa nezinga lotshwala kanye/noma lezidakamizwa lapho ushayela.

 Unganciphisa isigaba sakho sokuhlolwa kuze kube yizinyanga eziyisithupha, uma:
• uqede ngempumelelo inkambo yokuqeqeshwa kokushayela evunyiwe okuholela ekufakweni kwekhodi yesimo (U) kurekhodi lakho lokushayela
• zonke ezinye izidingo zokufaneleka ziyahlangatshezwa.

 Lapho uphuma ohlelweni lwe-GDL, uzokwenza lokhu:
• usuke ku-Class 5-GDL uye kulayisensi yokushayela ephelele ye-Class 5
• ufanelekela ukuphinda ubhalisele ilayisensi yokushayela yeBanga 1, 2, 3, noma 4
• ukwandisa inani lezinkinga ovunyelwe ukuzifinyelela
• ukususa isimo sokungabekezeleli utshwala nezidakamizwa
• ukwazi ukuba umshayeli ohambisana nomfundi.

Ukuze uthole ilayisensi yakho yokufunda, kuzodingeka uphumelele ukuhlolwa kolwazi. Ungathatha ukuhlolwa kolwazi lwakho emahhovisi amaningi e-ejenti yokubhalisa yase-Alberta. Ukuhlolwa kusekelwe emibuzweni ethathwe kulo mhlahlandlela. Uzobuzwa ngemikhuba yokushayela ephephile, imithetho yokushayela, kanye nezimpawu zomgwaqo. Ukuhlolwa kuwuchungechunge lwemibuzo enezinketho eziningi futhi kufanele uthole inani elithile lezimpendulo ezifanele ukuze uphumelele ukuhlolwa. Uzokwenza ukuhlolwa kukhompyutha.

 Uma uphumelela ukuhlolwa kolwazi kumele uthathe imvume yokuhlola ulwazi oyithengile ukuze wenze ukuhlolwa ku-ejenti yokubhalisa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ilayisensi yakho yokushayela ibuyekeziwe.

 Ukuhlolwa kolwazi lokushayela ngogesi lweBanga lesi-7 kuyatholakala ngezilimi ezingu-25 ezilandelayo:
• Isi-Amharic
• Isi-Arabhu
• IsiShayina (Esilula)
• IsiShayina (Esendabuko)
• IsiCree
• IsiDashi
• IsiNgisi
• IsiFarsi
• IsiFulentshi
• IsiJalimane
• IsiHindi
• IsiNtaliyane
• IsiKorea
• Isi-Oromo
• IsiPolish
• IsiPutukezi
• IsiPunjabi
• IsiRashiya
• IsiSomalia
• IsiSpanishi
• IsiTagalog
• IsiThai
• Isi-Ukraine
• Isi-Urdu
• IsiVietnam

 Kukhona imali yokuhlolwa kolwazi ngalunye oluthathayo, futhi ungathatha ukuhlolwa okukodwa kuphela ngosuku.

Kudingeka ukuhlolwa kombono ngaphambi kokuba ufanelekele ukuthola ilayisensi yokushayela yase-Alberta. Uma ungahlangabezani nezindinganiso zokubona, uzothunyelwa kudokotela wamehlo noma kudokotela wamehlo ukuze ugcwalise ifomu le-Vision Referral. Uma unezibuko zokulungisa noma ama-contact lens, zilethe nawe ukuze uhlolwe umbono wakho.

Ibanga lesi-5 yilayisensi yokushayela evame kakhulu, evumela abashayeli ukuthi basebenzise izimoto nezinye izimoto ezilula. Ukuphasa isivivinyo somgwaqo seBanga lesi-5 kuvumela abashayeli ukuthi basuke elayisensini yomfundi yeBanga lesi-7 baye elayisensini yokushayela yeBanga lesi-5-GDL. Lokhu kuhlolwa kunquma ukuthi umfundi usethuthukise amakhono okushayela adingekayo njengokuphatha imoto ngokuphephile, ukwahlulela, kanye nolwazi lwemithetho yomgwaqo ukuze abe umshayeli wesilingo weBanga lesi-5-GDL.

 Uma uphasa isivivinyo somgwaqo seBanga lesi-5 kufanele uthathe imvume yokuhlolwa komgwaqo oyithengile ukuze wenze isivivinyo ku-ejenti yokubhalisa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ilayisensi yakho yokushayela ibuyekeziwe. Imvume yokuhlolwa komgwaqo akuyona ilayisensi yokushayela.

 Lokhu kuhlolwa komgwaqo kuthatha cishe imizuzu engama-45. Lokhu kuzofaka imiyalelo yangaphambi kokuhlolwa komshayeli kanye nesifinyezo semiphumela yakho. Kuzodingeka ubonise ikhono lokusebenzisa imoto yakho ngokuphephile ngaphandle kokugadwa ngenkathi usebenzisana nabanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo.

 Imoto yokuhlolwa komgwaqo wakho kumele ibe sesimweni sokusebenza esamukelekayo futhi kumele ibe nalokhu okulandelayo:
• ipuleti lelayisensi elisebenzayo kanye nomshwalense
• izibani zangaphambili, izibani zamabhuleki, kanye nezibani zesignali
• uphondo
• i-speedometer
• amabhuleki/ukupaka ibhuleki
• i-windscreen/ama-wiper angaphazanyiswa
• amathayi asesimweni esihle
• iminyango yomshayeli nomgibeli
• izihlalo/amabhande esihlalo semoto
• uhlelo lokukhipha ugesi/i-muffler
• izibuko
• uphethiloli owanele wokuhlolwa komgwaqo.

 Ukuhlolwa kuzofaka phakathi ukuhlonza nokusebenzisa izilawuli zemoto yakho. Lokhu kufaka phakathi:
• ukuphatha imoto (ukuqondisa, ukubhuleka, kanye nokulawula isivinini)
• ukukhetha umzila ofanele wokujika
• ukubheka nokulalela izindawo zesivinini
• ukunquma ilungelo lendlela ezindaweni zokuhlangana kanye ngenkathi ushintsha imizila
• ukubonisa ulwazi kanye nekhono ezindaweni zokuhlangana ezinezilawuli zezimpawu nezimpawu kanye nezingenazo
 • ukusebenzisana nabanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo ngendlela engavimbeli
• ukupaka – ukupaka okuqondile, okukhuphukayo, noma okwehlayo, kanye nokuhambisana (abashayeli abangaphezu kweminyaka engu-65 akudingeki ukuthi baqedele ipaki elihambisanayo).

 Ezinye zezizathu ezivamile zokungaphumeleli ukuhlolwa komgwaqo

 Abashayeli bathola amaphuzu ngamaphutha enziwe ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa komgwaqo, ngomkhawulo omisiwe wokuhlolwa ngakunye. Uma amaphuzu aphezulu amaphutha edluliwe, umshayeli wehluleka ukuhlolwa.

 Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi amaphuzu aphelele angakanani, izenzo ezilandelayo ziholela ekuhlulekeni okuzenzakalelayo:
• Ukudlula umkhawulo wejubane noma ukushayela ngesivinini esikhulu kakhulu ngokwezimo.
• Ukwehluleka ukuma ngokuphelele ngaphambi kokuqhubeka endaweni yokuhlangana elawulwa uphawu lokuma, noma ngaphambi kokujika kwesokudla esibanini esibomvu.
• Ukwehluleka ukunikeza ilungelo lokungena endaweni yokuhlangana noma ngesikhathi sokushintsha komzila.
• Ukuvimbela ithrafikhi ngokushayela kancane kakhulu noma ukuma ngokungadingekile.
• Ukweqa umgwaqo ngenkathi upaka, noma ukungakwazi ukupaka ngokusemthethweni ngemizamo emithathu.
• Ukwehluleka ukuhamba kancane noma ukuqaphela ngokwanele ezimpambanweni ezingalawuleki (kumele ulungele ukuvumela abashayeli abangakwesokudla sakho).

 Ukuze ubuyekeze ilayisensi yakho yokushayela ngemuva kokuphumelela ukuhlolwa komgwaqo, hambisa imvume yokuhlola umgwaqo ku-ejenti yokubhalisa. Imvume yokuhlola umgwaqo akuyona ilayisensi yokushayela.

description:
Ibanga lesi-7 (i-GDL)

 Umuntu oneminyaka engu-14 noma ngaphezulu angafaka isicelo selayisensi yokushayela yokufunda. Umzali noma umnakekeli kumele anikeze imvume ngesicelo uma umuntu ofaka isicelo engaphansi kweminyaka engu-18.

 Ukuze ufunde futhi ngenkathi ephelezelwa umshayeli onelayisensi ephelele, umnikazi welayisensi yokushayela yeBanga lesi-7 angasebenzisa okulandelayo:
• inhlanganisela yemoto noma yemoto nenqola umnikazi welayisensi yokushayela yeBanga lesi-5 angayisebenzisa
• isithuthuthu (kumele sibe neminyaka engu-16 noma ngaphezulu lapho sifunda nomphathi onelayisensi yeBanga lesi-6 engeyona i-GDL)
• i-moped.

 Ibanga lesi-5-GDL

 Ubudala obuncane belayisensi yiminyaka engu-16. Noma ubani ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-18 ofaka isicelo selayisensi yokushayela kumele abe nemvume yomzali noma yomnakekeli.

 Umnikazi welayisensi yokushayela ye-Class 5-GDL angasebenzisa okulandelayo:
• inhlanganisela yemoto noma yemoto nenqola umnikazi welayisensi yokushayela ye-Class 5 angayisebenzisa.

 I-Class 5 non-GDL

 Ubudala obuncane belayisensi yiminyaka eyi-18.

 Umnikazi welayisensi yokushayela ye-Class 5 non-GDL angasebenzisa okulandelayo:
• inhlanganisela yemoto noma yemoto nenqola umnikazi welayisensi yokushayela ye-Class 5 angayisebenzisa.

 Izimoto ezingase zisebenze ngelayisensi yokushayela ye-Class 5:
• imoto enama-axle amabili kuphela
• imoto yokuzijabulisa enama-axle angaphezu kwamathathu
• imoto enama-axle amabili kuphela ngenkathi leyo moto idonsa inqola nge-axle eyodwa noma ngaphezulu, futhi ayinawo amabhuleki omoya
• imoto yokuzijabulisa enama-axle amabili kuphela ngenkathi leyo moto idonsa i-trailer ene-axle eyodwa noma ngaphezulu, futhi i-trailer ayinawo ama-air brake
• imoto yokuzijabulisa enama-axle amathathu ngenkathi leyo moto idonsa i-trailer ene-axle eyodwa noma ezimbili futhi engenawo ama-air brake
• i-moped
• zonke izimoto ezifakiwe ngaphansi kwamakilasi 1, 2, 3, kanye no-4 okufunda. Umfundi kumele okungenani abe neminyaka eyi-18 ubudala futhi abe nomphathi onelayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo yohlobo lwemoto
• isithuthuthu (sokufunda nomphathi onelayisensi ye-GDL yekilasi 6).

 Umnikazi welayisensi yokushayela yekilasi 5 ngeke asebenze:
• isithuthuthu (ngaphandle kokufunda)
• imoto enendawo yokuhlala engaphezu kwe-15 ngenkathi leyo moto ithutha noma yimuphi umuntu ngaphandle komshayeli
• imoto ethutha abagibeli abaqashiwe
• imoto efakwe amabhuleki omoya, ngaphandle uma umphathi enemvume yebhuleki lomoya.

Ilayisensi yokushayela yeSigaba 4 iyadingeka lapho umnikazi wemoto noma umqhubi, noma umqashi womqhubi, ekhokhelwa isevisi esetshenziswa yimoto ukuyihlinzeka.

 Ilayisensi yokushayela yeSigaba 4 AYIFUNI lapho umnikazi wemoto noma umqhubi, noma umqashi womqhubi, eshayela imoto yabagibeli yangasese yokuthutha abagibeli ngengozi noma ngezikhathi ezithile futhi ethola isinxephezelo salokhu:
• inkokhelo yamakhilomitha ahanjiwe
• imbuyiselo eqondile yezindleko eziphuma ephaketheni ezihlobene ngqo nokuhamba okufana nephethiloli, indawo yokupaka, amapasi esango kanye nemigwaqo ekhokhelwayo, noma lapho umqhubi wemoto eyingxenye yesivumelwano sokuhlinzeka ngezokuthutha ukuze kunxeshezelwe kuphela:
• amalungu omndeni womqhubi
• amalungu omndeni womqhubi
• abantu umqhubi angumgcini wabo osemthethweni.

Uma umuntu eqeda ngempumelelo inkambo yokubhuleka komoya e-Alberta evunyiwe nge-ejensi egunyaziwe, kuzobekwa imvume yokubhuleka komoya (Q) kuleyo layisensi yokushayela.

 Kudingeka imvume yokubhuleka komoya kubashayeli bezimoto abane:
• uhlelo lokubhuleka lomoya kuphela, noma
• inhlanganisela yesistimu yokubhuleka yomoya kanye neye-hydraulic.

 Ulwazi olwengeziwe ngenkambo yokubhuleka komoya luyatholakala ku-inthanethi ku: www.alberta.ca/airbrake-program.aspx

Abahloli babashayeli banesibopho sokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abafanelekayo kuphela abathola ilayisensi yokushayela. Ukuhlolwa komgwaqo kumele kwenziwe kuphela ngabantu abaqokwe nguHulumeni wase-Alberta njengabahloli babashayeli.

 Amahhovisi e-ejenti yokubhalisa yizindawo eziyinhloko zokuhlolwa komgwaqo ukuqala nokuphela.

 Ekuhlolweni komgwaqo, abagibeli noma izilwane ezifuywayo azivunyelwe. Ukukhululwa kulokhu kwenzeka lapho umhloli ephelezelwa yisikhulu sikahulumeni ngesikhathi sokuqeqeshwa noma sokuqapha.

 Ukuhlolwa komgwaqo kweBanga lesi-4, lesi-5, nelesi-6 kwenziwa ngabahloli babashayeli abanelayisensi ngama-ejenti okubhalisa e-Alberta egameni likaHulumeni wase-Alberta. Abahloli babashayeli abanelayisensi baqeqeshwe, banikezwe ilayisensi, baqashwe, futhi bahlolwe nguhulumeni. Ukuhlolwa komgwaqo kungahlelwa nge-ejenti yokubhalisa yase-Alberta.

 Ukuhlolwa komgwaqo wezentengiselwano kweBanga loku-1, lesi-2, nelesi-3 kwenziwa ngabahloli babashayeli bakaHulumeni wase-Alberta futhi kungahlelwa nge-ejenti yokubhalisa yase-Alberta noma ku-inthanethi ngohlelo lokuhlela online.

 Ulwazi olwengeziwe mayelana nokuhlolwa komgwaqo luyatholakala ku-inthanethi ku-: www.alberta.ca/driversroad-test.aspx

Ilayisensi yokushayela iyadingeka ukuze usebenzise imoto futhi ikhishwa ngokwe-Traffic Safety Act. Umuntu akufanele ashayele imoto emgwaqweni omkhulu ngaphandle kokuthi ilayisensi yokushayela yalowo muntu isesandleni salowo muntu. Uma isicelo sesikhulu sokuthula sicela, umuntu oshayela imoto kufanele aveze ilayisensi yakhe yokushayela, umshwalense, kanye nokubhaliswa. Qinisekisa ukuthi la madokhumenti akhona kuwe njalo uma usebenzisa imoto.

description:
Izinsizakalo zokuthola amalayisense okushayela zinikezwa ngenethiwekhi ye-ejenti yokubhalisa yase-Alberta.

 Uma ufaka isicelo selayisensi yokushayela yase-Alberta kufanele unikeze umazisi. Ukuze uthole ulwazi mayelana nezidingo zokukhomba vakashela ku-: www.alberta.ca/idrequirements-for-identification-cards.aspx

 Ilayisensi yokushayela inganikezwa izakhamuzi zase-Alberta kuphela. Isakhamuzi ngumuntu onelungelo ngokusemthethweni lokuba seCanada, ohlala e-Alberta futhi ovame ukuba khona e-Alberta.

 Abafakizicelo abavela ngaphandle kweCanada noma e-United States kumele baveze amadokhumenti okufuduka afanele ukuze babhekwe njengezakhamuzi.

 Imfuneko yemvume yabazali

 Izingane ezincane (ezingaphansi kweminyaka engu-18) ezifaka isicelo selayisensi yokushayela okokuqala kumele zibe nomzali noma umnakekeli osemthethweni ohamba nabo ehhovisi lokubhalisa, abonise ubufakazi bokugada, futhi asayine ifomu lemvume. Umnakekeli unelungelo lokuhoxisa imvume yakhe ebhaliwe kuze kube yilapho ingane ifinyelela eminyakeni eyi-18. Uma ihoxiswa, ilayisensi izomiswa. Akudingeki isiginesha somzali/umnakekeli uma ingane ihlinzeka ngobufakazi bomshado noma ukuzisekela.

description: Izivakashi eziya e-Alberta ezinelayisensi noma imvume evumelekile yangaphandle kwesifundazwe yeklasi ethile yemoto zivunyelwe ukushayela uhlobo olufanayo lwemoto e-Alberta ngaphandle kokuthola ilayisensi yendawo kuze kube unyaka owodwa.

Ukusuka kwezinye izindawo eCanada

 Izakhamuzi zaseNew Alberta zingasebenzisa ilayisensi yazo yokushayela yangaphandle kwesifundazwe izinsuku zokuqala ezingama-90 zokuhlala. Kumelwe zifake isicelo selayisensi yokushayela yase-Alberta futhi zinikezele ngelayisensi yazo yokushayela yangaphandle kwesifundazwe zingakapheli lezo zinsuku ezingama-90. Akukho emthethweni ukuba nelayisensi yokushayela engaphezu kweyodwa. Kuye ngohlobo lwelayisensi, imikhawulo yokulingana kwelayisensi yokushayela ingasebenza kubantu abashintshana ngelayisensi yokushayela besuka kwenye indawo ngaphakathi kweCanada.

 Ukusuka kwezinye izindawo eCanada

 Izakhamuzi zaseNew Alberta zingasebenzisa ilayisensi yazo yokushayela yangaphandle kwesifundazwe ezinsukwini zokuqala ezingama-90 zokuhlala. Kumelwe zifake isicelo selayisensi yokushayela yase-Alberta futhi zinikezele ngelayisensi yazo yangaphandle kwesifundazwe zingakapheli lezo zinsuku ezingama-90. Akukho emthethweni ukuba nelayisensi yokushayela engaphezu kweyodwa. Kuye ngohlobo lwelayisensi, imikhawulo yokulingana kwelayisensi yokushayela ingasebenza kubantu abashintshana ngelayisensi yokushayela besuka kwenye indawo ngaphakathi kweCanada.

 Zonke ezinye izigaba zamalayisense zidinga ukuhlolwa nokuhlolwa kwamehlo. Abafakizicelo kumele badalule zonke izimo zezokwelapha kanye nokukhubazeka ngokomzimba okungathinta ikhono labo lokusebenzisa imoto ngokuphephile. Bonke abafakizicelo kumele baveze amadokhumenti okufuduka kanye nokuhlala kanye nobunikazi obamukelekayo.

 Amagunya ngaphandle kwezivumelwano zamalayisense okushintshana

 Umuntu oza e-Alberta evela ngaphandle kweCanada angafaka isicelo sokuba umlando wakhe wokushayela wangaphambilini ufakwe kurekhodi lakhe lokushayela lase-Alberta. Isicelo esiphumelelayo sizonikeza ukukhululwa ohlelweni lwe-GDL futhi sivumele ukuhlolwa komgwaqo kweBanga lesi-5 ngaphandle kokudingeka ukuthi abe nelayisensi yomfundi yeBanga lesi-7 unyaka owodwa. Ulwazi olwengeziwe mayelana nenqubo yokushintshana ilayisensi evela endaweni engahambisani nayo luyatholakala kunoma yiliphi ihhovisi le-ejenti yokubhalisa.

 Abafundi

 Umfundi akadingeki ukuthola ilayisensi yokushayela yase-Alberta lapho esebenzisa imoto uma okulandelayo kusebenza:
• Umfundi ugunyaziwe ukuqhuba imoto yohlobo olufanayo noma isigaba ngemithetho yendawo lapho umfundi ehlala khona ngokuvamile.
• Amadokhumenti adingekayo yimithetho yendawo lapho umfundi ehlala khona ngokuvamile aphathwa ngumfundi noma asemotweni.
• Umfundi kumele aphathe ubufakazi obubonisa ukuthi ungumfundi wesikhathi esigcwele kulesi sifundazwe.

Amakhodi ezimo

 Ikhodi yesimo ingafakwa elayisensini yokushayela ukuze ibonise izidingo ezikhethekile. Isibonelo, bonke abashayeli kumele bahlangabezane nezidingo ezithile zokubona ukuze basebenzise imoto. Uma udinga izibuko noma amalensi okuxhumana ukuze uthuthukise umbono wakho ukuze uhlangabezane nalezi zindinganiso, uzoba nekhodi yesimo elayisensini yakho yokushayela ekhombisa le mfuneko. Abanye abashayeli bangadinga ukuhlolwa kwezokwelapha ngudokotela noma umhlengikazi, okuzoboniswa nekhodi yesimo. Ezimweni ezimbi kakhulu, ushintsho esimweni somuntu lungenza kube nzima ukuqhuba imoto ngokuphephile. Lezi zimo azivamile, kodwa zisho ukuthi umuntu akakwazi ukuthola ilayisensi yokusebenzisa imoto.

 Amakhodi okuqinisekisa

 Ikhodi yokuqinisekisa elayisensini yokushayela ikhombisa ukuthi umuntu ube nemfundo noma ukuqeqeshwa okuthile, njengokuqeda isifundo sokushayela sabaqalayo noma isifundo esithile sokusebenzisa ibhasi lesikole. Ukuqinisekisa kungabonisa nokuthi umuntu uvunyelwe ukushayela imoto enezici ezithile, njengemoto enamabhuleki omoya.

 Isimo ngasinye noma ukuqinisekiswa kuhambisana nekhodi yezinhlamvu engabonakala kulayisensi yokushayela. Imibandela kanye nokuqinisekiswa okuqondene nawe kubekwe ngaphambili kwelayisensi, esigabeni se-Cond/End. Amanye amakhodi kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwemibandela anencazelo ngemuva kwelayisensi yokushayela.

 Ukushintsha kabusha ilayisensi yakho yokushayela kusukela ekilasini lakho lamanje kuya kulayisensi yeClass 1, 2, noma 4 kuzodinga nombiko wezokwelapha. Bheka isigaba sezimfuneko zezokwelapha ukuze uthole ulwazi olwengeziwe.

 Ukuze uthole ulwazi ngemali yokuhlolwa komgwaqo, vakashela: www.alberta.ca/drivers-road-test.aspx.

 Ukushayela ngeklasi yelayisensi engalungile kuphambene nomthetho. Kuyicala ngabanikazi bezimoto ukuvumela imoto yabo ukuthi isetshenziswe ngumuntu ongenalo uhlobo olufanele lwelayisensi yaleyo moto.

Uma ilayisensi yakho yokushayela ilahlekile, yebiwe, ibhujiswe, noma ingafundeki, kufanele ufake isicelo sokushintsha ngokushesha ehhovisi le-ejenti yokubhalisa. Uma ilayisensi yakho yokushayela yebiwe, kufanele uyibike emaphoyiseni, futhi unikeze ikhophi yombiko wamaphoyisa ku-ejenti yokubhalisa uma ufaka isicelo sokushintsha kwakho.

Uhulumeni wase-Alberta uyeke ukuthumela izikhumbuzo mayelana namalayisense okushayela kanye nokubhaliswa kwezimoto. Abantu base-Alberta abakhubazekile bazoqhubeka nokuthola izikhumbuzo ngeposi. Abantu base-Alberta bangabhalisela izikhumbuzo ze-elekthronikhi ngokuvakashela i-E-registry noma i-MyAlberta bese bebhalisela izikhumbuzo zamahhala. Kungumthwalo wakho ukuvuselela ilayisensi yakho yokushayela ngosuku lokuphelelwa yisikhathi noma ngaphambi kosuku lokuphelelwa yisikhathi.

Ukuze ushintshe ulwazi oluselayisensini yakho yokushayela, njengegama lakho, ikheli, noma ikilasi lelayisensi, vakashela ihhovisi le-ejenti yokubhalisa yase-Alberta.

 Umthetho uyadingeka ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi oluselayisensini yakho lusesikhathini futhi lunembile. Kungadingeka ukuthi unikeze umazisi ofanele ngaphambi kokuba kwenziwe noma yiluphi ushintsho, ukushintshwa, noma ukuvuselelwa.

 Ukuze ufake esikhundleni, uvuselele, noma ubuyekeze ilayisensi yakho yokushayela yase-Alberta, xhumana ne-ejenti yokubhalisa ngokuvakashela: https://www.alberta.ca/lookup/find-a-registry-agent.aspx

Ukubhalisa

 Izimoto nama-trailer ahamba emigwaqweni yase-Alberta kumele abhaliswe. Izitifiketi zokubhalisa azikwazi ukukhishwa kunoma ubani ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-18 ubudala, ngaphandle kokuthi isicelo sokubhalisa sisayinwe ngumzali noma umnakekeli. Umzali noma umnakekeli unelungelo lokuhoxisa imvume ebhaliwe nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Uma imvume ihoxiswa, ipuleti lelayisensi kanye nokubhaliswa kwemoto kuzomiswa. Ukusayina komzali noma umnakekeli wakho akudingeki uma ungafakazela ukuthi ushadile noma uyazinakekela.

 E-Alberta, amapuleti elayisensi ahlala nomnikazi wemoto futhi awadluliselwa komunye umuntu. Umnikazi wemoto kumele abhalise imoto yakhe zingakapheli izinyanga ezintathu ethuthela e-Alberta.

 Izidingo zomshuwalense

 Zonke izimoto kumele zibe nomshwalense ngenqubomgomo yomshwalense wesikweletu somphakathi njengoba kuchaziwe kuMthetho Womshuwalense wase-Alberta. Akukho emthethweni ukusebenzisa imoto engenamshwalense. Inkampani yakho yomshwalense ikhipha ikhadi lesibopho sezimali (ikhadi elipinki) okumele lilethwe lapho kubhaliswa imoto futhi uma licelwe yisikhulu sokuthula.

Izimpawu zokulawula ithrafikhi yizibani ezisebenzisa imibala eluhlaza, ophuzi, nobomvu ukulawula ukuhamba kwethrafikhi ezindaweni zokuhlangana noma lapho imigwaqo ihlangana khona. Umbala wokukhanya unquma ukuthi yimuphi umzila wethrafikhi onelungelo lokungena. Isibonakaliso sokulawula ithrafikhi singaba siqondile noma sivundlile.

 Ukuhleleka kwezibani zesibonakaliso sokulawula ithrafikhi esiqondile kubomvu phezulu, ophuzi phakathi, kanye noluhlaza phansi. Ukuhleleka kwezibani zesibonakaliso sokulawula ithrafikhi esivundlile kubomvu ngakwesobunxele, ophuzi phakathi, kanye noluhlaza ngakwesokudla.

 Ukukhanya okubomvu okuqinile:

 Abashayeli ababhekene nesibonakaliso sokulawula ithrafikhi esibonisa ukukhanya okubomvu okuqinile kumele bamise izimoto zabo ngokuphelele ngaphambi komugqa wokuma noma indawo yokuwela ephambi kwemoto ngqo. Uma kungekho umugqa wokuma noma indawo yokuwela, abashayeli kumele bame ngaphambi kwendawo yokuhlangana. Izimoto kumele zihlale zimile endaweni yokukhanya okubomvu kuze kube yilapho ziphenduka zibe luhlaza, ngaphandle kokuthi ziphenduke ngokuphephile kwesokudla ngemva kokuma. Ukukhanya okubomvu okuqinile okuphindwe kabili kunencazelo efanayo nokukhanya okubomvu okukodwa.

 Ukujika kwesokudla esibanini esibomvu kuvunyelwe uma nje kungekho sibonakaliso esivimbela ukujika. Ngaphambi kokwenza ukujika, imoto kumele ime ngokuphelele ngaphambi komugqa wokuma noma oweqa abantu. Qedela ukujika uma kuphephile ukwenza kanjalo ngenkathi uvumela noma yimuphi omunye umgwaqo.

 Ngaphandle kokuthi uphawu luvimbela ukujika, ukujika kwesobunxele okuvunyelwe kuphela esibanini esibomvu kukungena emgwaqweni ohamba ngendlela eyodwa kusuka emgwaqweni ohamba ngendlela eyodwa. Lokhu kujika kuvunyelwe kuphela ngemva kokuba imoto imiswe ngokuphelele ngaphambi komugqa wokuma noma oweqa abantu, futhi uma ukujika kungenziwa ngokuphephile ngemva kokuvumela eminye imigwaqo.

 Ukukhanya okuphuzi okuqinile:

 Uma ukukhanya okuluhlaza kushintsha kube okuphuzi, kuxwayisa ukuthi ukukhanya kuzoshintsha kube okubomvu ngokushesha futhi abashayeli kumele balungiselele ukuma noma ukususa umgwaqo ohambayo. Abashayeli abasondela endaweni yokuhlangana abanesibani sokulawula ithrafikhi esiqinile (esingakhanyi) kumele bamise izimoto zabo ngokuphelele ngaphambi komugqa wokuma noma oweqa abantu, ngaphandle kokuthi kufinyelelwe iphuzu endaweni yokuhlangana lapho ukuma kungenzeki khona ngokuphepha. Uma kungekho umugqa wokuma noma owesiphambano, izimoto kumele zime ngaphambi komgwaqo. Abashayeli asebevele besempambanweni futhi bebheke ukukhanya okuphuzi kumele basuse ngokuphephile umgwaqo.

 Ukukhanya okuluhlaza okuqinile:

 Abashayeli ababhekene nokukhanya okuluhlaza okuqinile bavunyelwe ukuhamba phakathi komgwaqo ngaphandle kokuma, ngaphandle kokuthi kudingeka bavumele izimoto ezizayo lapho bejika ngakwesobunxele noma kwabahamba ngezinyawo endaweni yomgwaqo lapho bejika kwesokudla noma ngakwesobunxele.

 Uma usondela ekukhanyeni okuluhlaza, lindela ukuthi kuzophenduka kube phuzi. Ukukhanya okuluhlaza `okudala` kusho ukuthi ukukhanya sekuluhlaza isikhathi eside futhi kuzophenduka kube phuzi maduze. Icebiso elihle ukuhlola ukukhanya kwabahamba ngezinyawo endaweni yomgwaqo. Uma kubonisa uphawu `LOHAMBA`, ukukhanya kuzohlala kuluhlaza. Uma kubonisa uphawu `LOHAMBA`, lungela ukuma. Uma ukukhanya kwethrafikhi kushintsha, umshayeli kumele ame ngaphambi komgwaqo uma kungenziwa ngokuphephile.

 Abashayeli ababhekene nesibani sokulawula ithrafikhi esinomcibisholo oluhlaza kanye nesibani sokulawula ithrafikhi esiqinile bangangena endaweni yokuhlangana futhi baqhubeke ngaphandle kokushiya eceleni ngendlela ekhonjiswe ngumcibisholo. Abashayeli ababhekene nesibani esiluhlaza bangaqhubeka nakwezinye izindlela uma kuphephile futhi kusemthethweni.

 Umcibisholo oluhlaza onokukhanya okubomvu:

 Abashayeli ababhekene nesibani sokulawula ithrafikhi esinomcibisholo oluhlaza kanye nesibani sokulawula esibomvu bangangena endaweni yokuhlangana futhi baqhubeke ngaphandle kokuyeka eceleni ngendlela ekhonjiswe ngumcibisholo.

 Isibani esibomvu esikhanyayo:

 Abashayeli ababhekene nesibani sokulawula ithrafikhi esibomvu esikhanyayo kumele bame ngaphambi komugqa wokuma noma indawo yokuwela. Uma kungekho umugqa wokuma noma indawo yokuwela, abashayeli kumele bame ngaphambi kwendawo yokuhlangana. Abashayeli kufanele baqhubeke kuphela uma kuphephile futhi ngemva kokushiya eceleni indlela efanele. Isibani esibomvu esikhanyayo siphathwa njengophawu lokuma. Lapho izibani kuzo zonke izindlela zibomvu, indawo yokuhlangana iba yindawo yokuma enezindlela ezine.

 Isibani esiphuzi esikhanyayo:

 Abashayeli ababhekene nesibani sokulawula ithrafikhi esiphuzi esikhanyayo bangaqhubeka ngokuqapha ngemva kokuzivumela ukuba zihambe ngezinyawo nezinye izimoto ngaphakathi kwendawo yokuhlangana.

 Isibani esiluhlaza esikhanyayo:

 Abashayeli ababhekene nesibani sokulawula ithrafikhi esiluhlaza esikhanyayo bavunyelwe ukudlula, bajike ngakwesobunxele noma bajike kwesokudla ngaphandle kokuma. Ithrafikhi ephikisanayo izobe ibhekene nesibani esibomvu; noma kunjalo umshayeli kumele aqhubeke nokuzivumela ukuba zihambe ngezinyawo noma ezinye izimoto ngokusemthethweni endaweni yokuhlangana.

Abashayeli kumele baqonde izibani zokulawula abahamba ngezinyawo ukuze bakwazi ukulindela izenzo zalabo abahlanganyela umgwaqo.

 Abahamba ngezinyawo ababhekene nesibonakaliso sokulawula ithrafikhi lapho kuboniswa khona igama noma uphawu olubonisa ukuthi “HAMBA”, bangangena endaweni yokuwela noma emgwaqweni lapho kuphephile, futhi baqhubeke kuleyo ndlela. Abahamba ngezinyawo asebeqalile ukuwela lapho igama noma uphawu luvela bangaqhubeka nokuwela futhi baphume endaweni yokuwela. Ezinye izimpawu zabahamba ngezinyawo zifaka isikhathi sokubala ukuze kuboniswe ukuthi kusele isikhathi esingakanani ngaphambi kokuba ukukhanya kushintshe.

 Izimpawu zomzila

 Izimpawu zomzila zingaba phuzi noma zimhlophe, zodwa noma ezimbili, ziqinile noma ziphukile. Le migqa inikeza ulwazi olubalulekile mayelana nendlela yokuhamba kwethrafikhi, ukushintsha komzila, imikhawulo yomzila, kanye nokudlula.

 Izimpawu zomugqa oqinile: Imigqa eqinile isho ukuthi ukuwela umugqa oqinile ukuze udlule noma ushintshe imizila akuvunyelwe.

 Izimpawu zomugqa eziphukile: Imigqa ephukile isho ukuthi ukuwela umugqa ophukile ukuze udlule noma ushintshe imizila kuvunyelwe.

 Izimpawu zomugqa ophuzi: Imigqa ephuzi isho ukuthi izimoto ohlangothini ngalunye lomugqa ophuzi kumele zihambe ngezindlela eziphambene. Umugqa ophuzi kufanele uhlale ohlangothini lwesobunxele lomshayeli.

 2. Imigqa ephuzi ephukile ikhombisa ukuthi ukudlula kuvunyelwe. Qiniseka ukuthi umzila ucacile futhi ukudlula kungaqedwa ngokuphephile.

 3. Umugqa ophuzi oqinile kanye nomugqa ophuzi ophukile ndawonye kubonisa ukuthi ukudlula kuvunyelwe kumshayeli onomugqa ophukile ohlangothini lwakhe lomgwaqo. Ukudlula akuvunyelwe kumshayeli onomugqa ophuzi oqinile ohlangothini lwakhe lomgwaqo

 Izimpawu zomugqa omhlophe: Imigqa emhlophe isho ukuthi izimoto ohlangothini ngalunye lomugqa omhlophe zihamba ngendlela efanayo.

 4. Imigqa emhlophe eqinile ikhombisa ukuthi ukushintsha umzila akuvunyelwe.

 5. Imigqa emhlophe ephukile ikhombisa ukuthi ukushintsha umzila kuvunyelwe.

 Izimpawu

 Izimpawu zingasetshenziswa endleleni ukuze zengeze izimpawu ezijwayelekile noma zona ngokwazo ukuxwayisa abashayeli, noma ukulawula noma ukuqondisa ithrafikhi. Lezi zimpawu zifaka:

 Imicibisholo: Imicibisholo ikhombisa ukunyakaza kwezimoto okuvunyelwe emzileni.

 6. Emzileni wokujika kwesobunxele onezindlela ezimbili, umzila ophakathi womgwaqo uyabelwana futhi ugcinelwe ithrafikhi ejika kwesobunxele ehamba kunoma iyiphi indlela

 7) Izimpawu zedayimane: Izimpawu zedayimane zikhombisa ukuthi umzila ubekelwe izimoto ezithile. Kungase kube nezimpawu ezizobonisa isikhathi noma imikhawulo yemoto.

Izindawo Zokuwela: Imigqa yezindawo zokuwela imigwaqo iphawula izindawo zokuwela abahamba ngezinyawo. Imigqa yokuma ikhombisa lapho izimoto kumele zime khona ezimpambanweni zemigwaqo noma ezimpambanweni zesitimela.

Ukuhlola izingane, abahamba ngezinyawo, nanoma yini esendleleni yemoto yakho. Hlola amathayi akho ukuthi awekho yini amaza afanele, kanye naseduze nangaphansi kwemoto yakho ukuze kutholakale ukuvuza kwamanzi nezinye izinkinga ezingase zithinte ukusebenza okuphephile kwemoto yakho. Uma wenza lokhu ngenkathi upake eceleni komgwaqo, hamba ngendlela ekuvumela ukuthi ubone izimoto ziza kuwe emzileni oseduze nawe. Ngemva kokuthi usuqedile lokhu kuhlola, uzobe usukulungele ukuthatha indawo yakho esihlalweni somshayeli futhi uzilungiselele ukushayela ngokuphephile.

 Ngaphambi kokushayela yenza le mikhuba eyisisekelo elandelayo ngale ndlela:
1 Khiya iminyango yakho.
2 Lungisa isihlalo sakho nesihlalo sakho emuva.
3 Lungisa isithiyo sakho sekhanda.
4 Lungisa izibuko zakho zangemuva zangaphakathi nangaphandle.
5 Bopha ibhande lakho lesihlalo.

 Khiya iminyango yakho

 Khiya iminyango yakho ukuze uvimbele abantu abangafuneki ukuthi bavule umnyango wakho noma bangene emotweni yakho. Ukukhiya iminyango kunciphisa namathuba okuthi iminyango ivuleke uma uhileleke engozini.

 Lungisa isihlalo sakho kanye nesihlalo sakho emuva

 Lungisa isihlalo sakho kanye nesekelo sesihlalo sakho emuva kahle ukuze okungenani ube ngamasentimitha angu-25 (amasentimitha angu-10) ukusuka esiteringini. Leli yibanga elinconywa yiTransport Canada. Qiniseka ukuthi uyakwazi ukubona ngaphezu kwesiteringi. Izimoto eziningi zinesiteringi esingatshekiswa noma sihanjiswe emuva naphambili. Thola indawo ekhululekile kuwe futhi engavimbi umbono wakho wephaneli yezinsimbi. Izindololwane zakho kufanele zigobe kancane lapho izandla zakho zibekwe kahle esiteringini. Ukubeka isandla sakho sobunxele cishe endaweni yehora lesi-9 kanye nesandla sakho sokudla cishe endaweni yehora lesi-3 kuyanconywa. (Bheka `Isiteringi` kulesi sahluko ukuthola ulwazi olwengeziwe.) Futhi, indawo yakho kumele ikuvumele ukuthi usebenzise i-brake pedal kanye ne-accelerator. Emotweni ejwayelekile yokudlulisa, kufanele futhi ukwazi ukusunduza i-clutch pedal kuze kube phansi. Qiniseka ukuthi ungafinyelela kuzo zonke izilawuli futhi ungaphumuza izingalo zakho uma ubamba isiteringi.

 Lungisa isithiyo sakho sekhanda

 Sebenzisa isithiyo sakho sekhanda ngendlela efanele. Isithiyo sekhanda endaweni efanele sinciphisa kakhulu ingozi yokulimala ngenxa yokushayisana nokunyakaza kwemoto ngokuzumayo.
• Uma imoto yakho inesithiyo sekhanda esilungisekayo, kufanele sibekwe ngendlela yokuthi isikhungo sesithiyo sekhanda silingane nengxenye ephezulu yezindlebe zakho.
• Uma isithiyo sakho sekhanda sitsheka, sisihambise phambili ukuze sinciphise isikhala phakathi kwekhanda lakho nesithiyo. Ngaphansi kwamasentimitha ayi-10 (amasentimitha amane) kufanelekile.
• Njalo hlola ukuthi isithiyo sekhanda somgibeli ngamunye silungiswe sibe ukuphakama okufanele.

 Lungisa izibuko zakho zangemuva zangaphakathi nangaphandle

 Setha izibuko zakho zangemuva endaweni efanele.
• Lungisa isibuko sakho sangemuva sangaphakathi ukuze sibonise okuningi ngemuva kwakho ngangokunokwenzeka ngokuba nefasitela langemuva elifakwe ngaphakathi kwesibuko.
• Lungisa izibuko zangemuva zangaphandle ukuze unciphise izindawo ezingabonakali. Kufanele ukwazi ukubona imoto yakho engxenyeni encane yesibuko esiseceleni esiseduze nemoto.

 Bopha ibhande lakho lesihlalo

 Bopha ibhande lakho lesihlalo kanye nebhande lamahlombe ngendlela efanele. Amabhande esihlalo asindisa izimpilo futhi anciphise ukulimala, futhi ahlinzeka ngesivikelo esikhulu uma egqokwe kahle. Umthetho udinga ukuthi ugqoke ibhande lakho lesihlalo.
• Gqoka ibhande lethanga phansi futhi linamathele ezinqeni zakho. Ibhande lamahlombe kumele lilingane nesifuba sakho kanye nehlombe.
• Ungalifaki ibhande lehlombe ngemuva noma ngaphansi kwengalo yakho.
• Usadingeka ukuthi ugqoke ibhande lakho lesihlalo uma usemotweni enezikhwama zomoya.

 Uma usukulungele ukuhamba, yenza okulandelayo:
• Hlola ukuthi indlela ohlose ukuhamba ngayo icacile.
• Hlola izibuko zakho zangemuva zangaphakathi nangaphandle.
• Hlola amahlombe ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi izindawo ongaboni kuzo zicacile.

 Uma usuka ohlangothini lwesokudla lomgwaqo, sebenzisa isignali yakho yokujika kwesobunxele ukukhombisa ukuthi ungena emotweni. Uma usehlangothini lwesobunxele lomgwaqo ohamba ngendlela eyodwa, sebenzisa isignali yakho yokujika kwesokudla. Kulesi simo, kungaba nzima ukubona izimoto ngokucacile esihlalweni somshayeli.

englishSubcategory: Driving a vehicle with an automatic transmission
description:
Imoto enokudluliselwa okuzenzakalelayo ivumela umshayeli ukukhetha igiya elivumela ukudluliselwa ukuthi kushintshe amagiya ngokwalo njengoba isivinini sishintsha. Ukudluliselwa okuzenzakalelayo kunenkinobho yokukhulula ilokhi noma ukulawula okwakhelwe kukhethi wegiya ukuze kuncishiswe amathuba okushintsha ngokungalungile.

 Ukukhululwa kwelokhi kunikeza izici zokuphepha ezilandelayo:
• Kumelwe kusetshenziswe ukuhambisa isikhethi segiya kusuka ePaki kuya eReverse noma kunoma yiliphi igiya eliya phambili ngenkathi i-pedal yebhuleki icindezelwe.
• Kumelwe kusetshenziswe ukuhambisa imoto kusuka eDrive iye egiya elingezansi (elokuqala noma elesibili).
• Kumelwe kusetshenziswe ukushintshela ePaki kusuka kunoma yiliphi igiya.

 Bheka incwadi yemiyalelo yomnikazi wakho ukuthola ulwazi olwengeziwe mayelana nokukhululwa kwelokhi yokudlulisela.

 Paka

 Ingasetshenziswa lapho uqala injini nalapho ushiya imoto ipakile. Indawo yePaki ivala ukudluliselwa, okuvimbela amasondo ukuthi ajike. Injini yemoto izoqala lapho ukudluliselwa kusePaki.

 Ukuhlanekezela

 Kusetshenziswa lapho uhlehlisa imoto noma uyibuyisela emuva. Uma imoto isegiya elibuyela emuva, izibani ezimhlophe noma ezicacile ezingemuva kwemoto zizokhanya. Injini yemoto ngeke iqale ku-Reverse.

 Okungathathi hlangothi

 Kusetshenziswa lapho ukudluliselwa kusesimweni lapho kungekho giya elikhethiwe. Amasondo awakhiyiwe, futhi akukho mandla emasondweni. Lesi sikhundla sisetshenziselwa ukudonsa imoto. Injini yemoto izoqala ku-Neutral.

 Shayela

 Kusetshenziswa ukushayela okuvamile phambili. Ukudluliselwa kuzoshintsha phezulu naphansi ngamagiya okushayela ngokuzenzakalelayo. Injini yemoto ngeke iqale kuleli giya.

 Okwesithathu, Okwesibili, kanye Nokuqala Amagiya

 Kusetshenziswa lapho udinga amandla engeziwe kodwa isivinini esincane kanye nokuvimbela ukudluliselwa ukuthi kushintshele kugiya eliphezulu. Lawa magiya angasetshenziswa uma ukhuphuka noma wehla emagqumeni nasezimweni zomgwaqo ezifana nodaka, amatshe axegayo, iqhwa, isihlabathi, noma iqhwa, lapho udinga khona amandla engeziwe kodwa isivinini esincane. Injini yemoto ngeke iqale kuleli giya.

 Ukushayela ngokweqile (uma kufakwe)

 Ingasetshenziswa ukushayela ngesivinini esiphezulu. Leli giya lisiza ukonga uphethiloli. Akuzona zonke izimoto ezinalolu khetho. Injini yemoto ngeke iqale kuleli giya.

 Ukuze uthole ulwazi olwengeziwe mayelana nokukhetha nokusetshenziswa kwamagiya, bheka incwadi yemiyalelo yomnikazi wemoto yakho.

englishSubcategory: Driving a vehicle with a manual (standard) transmission
description:
Ukushintsha amagiya emotweni efakwe i-transmission manual kuyikhono elidinga ukuzijwayeza okukhulu. Kumelwe usebenzise i-clutch pedal ngonyawo lwakho lwesobunxele ngenkathi usebenzisa i-gear shift lever ngesandla sokudla ukuze ukhethe ngesandla igiya olifunayo.

 Uma i-clutch pedal icindezelwe phansi, ukuxhumana phakathi kwe-transmission namasondo kuyasuswa. Lokhu kuvimbela ukudluliselwa kwamandla enjini emasondweni. Umshayeli ushintsha amagiya uma i-clutch pedal icindezelwe phansi. I-clutch pedal isetshenziselwa ukuxhuma nokunqamula injini yemoto kanye ne-transmission.

 Uma i-clutch pedal ingacindezelwe phansi, kukhona ukuxhumana phakathi kwenjini kanye ne-transmission, futhi amandla enjini adluliselwa emasondweni emoto.

 Lapho uqala injini yemoto efakwe i-transmission manual, i-gear shift lever kufanele ibe sesimweni esingathathi hlangothi futhi i-clutch pedal kufanele icindezelwe phansi ngokuphelele.

 Njengoba uqala ukukhulula i-clutch pedal ngokuphakamisa kancane unyawo lwakho lwesobunxele, ukuxhumana phakathi kwenjini kanye ne-transmission kuzoqala ukuzwakala ngaphambi kokuba i-pedal ikhishwe ngokuphelele. Indawo lapho lokhu kwenzeka khona ibizwa ngokuthi indawo yokushayisana. Kulapho kufanele ukhulule khona i-clutch pedal kancane ukuze uvimbele injini ukuthi ingami. Endaweni yokushayisana, ukusebenzisa i-gas pedal ngokucophelela ngokukhulula kancane i-clutch pedal kuzosiza ekufezeni ukuqala okubushelelezi. Ukuze ufunde ukusebenzisa i-clutch kahle, abashayeli abasha kufanele bazijwayeze ukusebenzisa i-friction point ngaphandle kokusebenzisa i-gas pedal.

 Uma ushayela imoto yokudlulisa ngesandla, kubalulekile ukukhetha igiya elifanele ukuze injini ingahambi (ihambe ngendlela enzima, enesithukuthezi) noma igijime (ishintshe injini kodwa ingashukumisi imoto ngempumelelo). Incwadi yomnikazi wemoto izokunikeza isivinini esilinganiselwe okufanele ushintshe ngaso amagiya.

 Amaphethini okushintsha ayahlukahluka phakathi kwezimoto njengoba kunjalo nenani lamagiya. Incwadi yomnikazi wemoto yakho izochaza iphethini yokushintsha imoto yakho. Iphethini ivame ukutholakala phezulu kwe-gear shift lever. Ungazijwayeza ukuhambisa i-gear shift lever, lapho imoto ingasebenzi futhi i-clutch pedal icindezelwa phansi, iye kumagiya ahlukahlukene uze uqiniseke ngezindawo zamagiya. Udinga ukwazi ukuthola i-gear ngayinye ngaphandle kokubheka i-gear shift uma ushayela.

 Uma ushayela, qiniseka ukuthi ususa unyawo lwakho ku-clutch pedal njalo uma uqeda ukushintsha uye kwenye i-gear. Ukushiya unyawo lwakho ku-clutch pedal ngokungadingekile kubizwa ngokuthi “ukugibela i-clutch” futhi kungabangela ukuguguleka okwengeziwe ku-clutch.

 Uma ufisa ukubhuleka noma ukuma, ungami lapho ucindezela i-clutch pedal. Ukucindezela i-clutch pedal kanje kukuvimbela ekubeni ukwazi ukusebenzisa i-accelerator.

 Uma ujika amakhona, qiniseka ukuthi imoto yakho isegiya elifanele ijubane lokujika, nokuthi unyawo lwakho lungaphandle kwe-clutch pedal.

 Sebenzisa i-clutch pedal kuphela ukuqala imoto, ukushintsha kusuka kwelinye igiya uye kwelinye, nangaphambi nje kokuba ume ukuze uvimbele ukuma.

Cabanga ngesiteringi njengewashi. Ukuze ube nokulawula okungcono kakhulu kwemoto, beka isandla sakho sobunxele cishe ngo-9:00. Isandla sakho sokudla kufanele sibe cishe ngo-3:00. Uma lokhu kungenzeki ngenxa yokwakheka kwesiteringi, beka isandla sakho sobunxele cishe ngo-10:00 kanye nesandla sakho sokudla cishe ngo-2:00.

 Uma ujika ekhoneni, qondisa usebenzisa indlela yesandla-ngaphezulu-kwesandla. Uma ubuyisela isondo endaweni yokujika, sebenzisa indlela yesandla-ngaphezulu-kwesandla. Ungavumela futhi isiteringi sishelele ezandleni zakho sibuyele endaweni yaso ngokukhulula ukubamba kwakho kancane, kodwa ugcine uthintana nesiteringi.

 A. Indawo yesandla ukuqala ukujika kwesobunxele noma kwesokudla.
B. Ekujikeni kwesokudla, isandla sobunxele sisebenzisa amandla okujika. Isandla sokudla sikhulula isiteringi, bese sithuthela phezulu kwesiteringi.
C. Isandla sokudla sithatha indawo entsha futhi sisebenzisa amandla okujika.
D. Isandla sobunxele siyayidedela isondo lokuqondisa, bese sibuyela endaweni yehora lesi-9.
E. Buyisela izinyathelo ukuze uqedele ukujika bese ubuyisela isondo lokuqondisa endaweni evamile. Phenduka usuqedile, buyisela izandla endaweni yokushayela.

Izibani zesignali kanye nezibani zamabhuleki zitshela abanye abashayeli ukuthi uzokwenzani. Kumelwe usebenzise isibani sakho sesignali uma:
• usuka eceleni komgwaqo noma emzileni wokupaka
• ujika kwesobunxele noma kwesokudla
• ushintsha imizila.

 Uma usebenzisa amabhuleki akho, izibani zakho zamabhuleki ziyavulwa ukuze zixwayise abanye abashayeli ukuthi uyehlisa noma uyama.

 Ungabadideki abanye abashayeli ngokubonisa kusenesikhathi noma sekwephuzile. Khumbula ukucima isibani sakho sesignali uma singacimi ngokuzenzakalelayo

Uma ushayela imoto yakho, ikhono lakho lokulawula isivinini sakho lincike ekubhekeni lapho ufuna ukuya khona nokusebenzisa i-accelerator ngendlela efanele. Cindezela kancane kancane i-accelerator ukuze uhambise imoto, bese uyibamba endaweni efanele yesivinini esikhethiwe. Lokhu kuzothatha ukuzijwayeza okuthile.

 Khumbula okulandelayo:
• Sheshisa kahle.
• Lungisa isimo sezulu, umgwaqo, kanye nezimo zethrafikhi.
• Ungasheshisi noma wehlise isivinini ngokungadingekile.
• Ungalokothi weqe umkhawulo wejubane obekwe.
• Ungasheshisi ngokushesha kangangokuthi amathayi emoto ajikeleze.
• Shayela ngokuhamba kwethrafikhi ukuze unciphise ingozi yokuba sengozini. Ukushayela kancane kakhulu kungaba yingozi.
• Bheka i-speedometer yakho ngezikhathi ezithile ukuze uhlole isivinini sakho.

Ukwazi ukuthi kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani kanye nebanga ukufaka amabhuleki akho ukuze umise imoto yakho ngokuphelele kungasiza ekugwemeni amaphutha ekwahluleleni futhi kusize ekugwemeni ukushayisana. Izici ezintathu zinquma isikhathi kanye nebanga elithathayo ukuze ume.

 Isikhathi sokubona: Isikhathi sokubona ukuthi kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuqaphela isimo nokuqonda ukuthi udinga ukuma. Lokhu kungathatha cishe izingxenye ezintathu kwezine zomzuzwana. Abashayeli abanolwazi oluncane bavame ukuthatha isikhathi eside ukuqaphela ukuthi kukhona ingozi. Ibanga lokubona ukuthi imoto ihamba ibanga elingakanani phakathi nalesi sikhathi.

 Isikhathi sokuphendula: Isikhathi sokuphendula ukuthi kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuphendula esimweni ngokuhambisa unyawo lwakho kusuka ku-accelerator pedal kuya ku-brake pedal. Isikhathi sokuphendula esimaphakathi singama-3 kowesibili. Ibanga lokuphendula ukuthi imoto ihamba ibanga elingakanani phakathi nalesi sikhathi.

 Isikhathi sokubhreka: Isikhathi sokubhreka ukuthi kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani imoto ukuma ngemva kokufakwa kwamabhuleki. Ibanga lokubhreka ukuthi imoto ihamba ibanga elingakanani phakathi nalesi sikhathi.

 Ishadi elingezansi libonisa ibanga elincane lokuma ngesivinini esihlukahlukene. Amabanga okuma ayisilinganiso sokuma endleleni ebushelelezi neyomile.

 Izinto eziningi zithinta isikhathi sakho sokuma kanye nebanga. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izimo zomgwaqo kanye nesimo sezulu. Ezinye izinto ongazilawula yilezi:
• amakhono akho okusesha ngokubona njengoba uskena umgwaqo ongaphambili
• ikhono lakho lokwenza izinqumo
• ukuqaphela kwakho kanye nezinga lokukhathala
• ukusebenzisa kwakho utshwala noma izidakamizwa
• isivinini semoto yakho
• isimo samabhuleki namathayi emoto yakho.

 Ukubhreka

 • Uma uma, qala ukubhreka kusenesikhathi. Uma ubhreka sekwephuzile kakhulu, ibanga lakho lokubhreka lingase linganele.
• Khulula ingcindezi ku-accelerator ngaphambi kokusebenzisa ibhuleki ukuze unciphise ijubane lakho.
• Ukuze uqede ukubhreka kahle, khulula ingcindezi ku-pedal yebhuleki kancane bese uphinda usebenzise ingcindezi ku-pedal ngaphambi nje kokuba ume.
• Uma kufanele ume ngokushesha, sebenzisa ibhuleki elinomkhawulo. Lokhu ukufaka amabhuleki ngaphandle kokukhiya amasondo. Yilapho ukusebenza kahle kokukhiya kusezingeni eliphezulu khona ngenkathi kukuvumela ukuthi uqondise imoto yakho. Uma amasondo ekhiya, yehlisa ingcindezi yakho ephedalini lebhuleki kancane. Ukusebenzisa amabhuleki kanzima ngokwanele ukukhiya amasondo kuzobangela ukulahlekelwa ukulawula kokuqondisa.

 Ngezimoto ezinamabhuleki alwa nokukhiya (i-ABS), bheka ulwazi eSahlukweni 6 ngaphansi kwebhuleki eliphuthumayo.

Konke ukubuyela emuva kumele kwenziwe ngesivinini sokukhasa noma sokuhamba kancane. Ngaphambi kokubuyela emuva, bheka ngemuva kwemoto bese ushayela ubuyela emuva kuphela uma indlela yakho ingenazo izimoto, abahamba ngezinyawo, nezithiyo. Ngaphambi kokubuyela emuva uphume endaweni yokungena, hamba uzungeze imoto bese uhlola izingozi ezingaba khona ngemuva kwemoto.

 Ukuze ubuyele emuva uqonde, yenza okulandelayo:
• Beka isandla sakho sobunxele phezulu kwesiteringi bese ushintshela kancane esinqeni sakho sokunene. Ukuze uthole ukwesekwa, beka isandla sakho sokunene ngemuva kwesihlalo somgibeli.
• Bheka phezu kwehlombe lakho lokunene ngefasitela langemuva. Buyela emuva kancane ngenkathi umboza i-brake pedal.
• Bheka phambili ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi ingaphambili lemoto alithinti lutho.
• Ukuze ulungise isiteringi sakho, phendula isiteringi ungadluli ikota yokujika ngendlela efanayo ofuna ingemuva lemoto yakho liye kuyo.

 Uma ubuyela emuva uye kwesobunxele noma kwesokudla, yenza okulandelayo:
• Sebenzisa izandla zombili esiteringini cishe ngo-9 ekuseni nango-3 ntambama uma udinga ukujika isikhathi esingaphezu kwesigamu sokujika.
• Ukuze ubuyele emuva uye kwesobunxele, bheka ehlombe lakho lesobunxele ngokubheka njalo ngaphambili.
• Ukuze ubuyele emuva uye kwesokudla, bheka ehlombe lakho lesokudla ngokubheka njalo ngaphambili.
• Jikisa isiteringi ngendlela ofuna ngayo ingemuva lemoto.

 Qaphela: Ingaphambili lemoto lizohamba ngendlela ehlukile ukusuka endleleni ingemuva lemoto elihamba ngayo.

 Amanye amathiphu okubuyela emuva:
• Uma ubuyela emuva uphuma emgwaqweni wokungena, qondisa imoto yakho uye emgwaqweni wethrafikhi oseduze bese uya phambili. Ungabuyeli emuva uye komunye umzila wethrafikhi.
• Akukho emthethweni ukuhambisa imoto yakho emuva iye endaweni yokuhlangana noma endaweni yokuwela abantu.

 Uma ubona izibani ezimhlophe ezibuyela emuva emotweni, qaphela ukuthi ingase ibuyele emuva. Lezi zibani zibonisa ukuthi imoto isegiya elibuyela emuva.

Lolu hlobo lokupaka lungase lubonakale lunzima ekuqaleni futhi luzodinga ukuzijwayeza. Ukuze upake endaweni ephakathi kwezimoto ezimbili eceleni komgwaqo kwesokudla, landela izinyathelo eziboniswe kulesi sithombe. Qaphela indawo yamathayi angaphambili (ngombala obomvu).

 Uma usondela endaweni yokupaka ehambisanayo ohlose ukuyipaka, hlola ngemuva kwakho ukuthi ithrafikhi ingakanani. Kancane kancane sebenzisa amabhuleki akho kusenesikhathi ngaphambi kwendawo yokupaka ukuze uqale ukwehlisa ijubane. Izibani zakho zamabhuleki zixwayisa abanye abashayeli ngenhloso yakho yokuma. Nquma ukuthi indawo yokupaka inkulu ngokwanele yini emotweni yakho.

 Yima lapho i-bumper yangemuva yemoto yakho (imoto A) ihambisana ne-bumper yangemuva yemoto B. Imoto yakho kufanele ihambisane nemoto B, ibe nesikhala esingaba yimitha elilodwa (amathathu amamitha) phakathi kwezimoto ezimbili. Beka imoto yakho igiya elibuyela emuva. Bheka phezu kwehlombe lakho langakwesokudla nangemuva kwakho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi akukho lutho futhi isikhala sisatholakala.

 Buyela emuva uqonde kancane (isivinini sokukhasa) cishe imitha elilodwa nesigamu (imitha elilodwa nesigamu amamitha). Ngenkathi usahamba kancane, jika ngokucijile uye kwesokudla kuze kube yilapho imoto yakho isise-engeli engama-degree angu-45 ukuya eceleni. Qhubeka ubheke ohlangothini oluhambayo ngenkathi ubheka phambili. Isiteringi sakho kufanele manje sihambisane nebhampa yangemuva yemoto B.

 Ngenkathi ubuyela emuva kancane kakhulu, qondisa amasondo akho angaphambili bese uqhubeka nokubuyela emuva kuze kube yilapho ikhona lesokudla lebhampa yakho yangaphambili lihambisana nebhampa yangemuva yemoto B. Qaphela ukuthi ungaxhumani nale moto.

 Jikisa isondo ngokucijile uye kwesobunxele. Qhubeka ubheke ohlangothini oluhambayo ngenkathi ubheka phambili. Buyela emuva kuze kube yilapho imoto yakho ihambisana nohlangothi oluhambayo. Qaphela ukuthi ungaxhumani nebhampa yemoto ngemuva kwakho. Umthetho udinga ukuthi amasondo emoto epakiwe angabi ngaphezu kwamasentimitha angu-50 ukusuka eceleni.

 Uma ushiya indawo yokupaka efanayo nemoto epakiwe phambi kwakho, yenza okulandelayo:
• Hlola zonke izibuko ukuze ubone ukuthi kuphephile yini ukuphuma endaweni yokupaka.
• Buyela emuva ngenkathi ubheka ihlombe lakho lesokudla ngefasitela lakho langemuva, uze usondele emotweni epakwe ngemuva kwakho, ngaphandle kokuthinta.
• Vula isignali yokujika kwesobunxele.
• Ngaphambi kokuqhubekela phambili, bheka ihlombe lakho lesobunxele ukuze ubone ukuthi izimoto nabagibeli bamabhayisikili ababonakali ezibukweni.
• Hambisa phambili kancane cishe imitha elilodwa (amathathu izinyawo) ngenkathi ushayela ngokucijile uye ngakwesobunxele. Uma kuphephile, shayela uye emzileni wokuhamba oseduze uqaphela ukuthi ungathintani nemoto epakwe ngaphambili.
• Qaphela izimoto ezisondela ngemuva.

 Ukungena nokuphuma emotweni epakwe ngokuhambisana nomgwaqo emgwaqweni onezindlela ezimbili:

 Uma ushiya imoto epakwe ngokuhambisana nomgwaqo, hlola zonke izibuko ngokucophelela ukuze ubone ukuthi kukhona yini izimoto noma abagibeli bamabhayisikili abasondela ngemuva. Hlola amahlombe akho ezindaweni ezingabonakali ngakwesobunxele. Uma kuphephile, vula umnyango ungabi banzi kakhulu ukuze uphume futhi ushiye imoto ngokushesha. Hamba uye ngemuva kwemoto ubheke izimoto ukuze ufike emngceleni.

 Uma ungena emotweni epakwe eceleni komngcele, sondela njalo usuka ngaphambili kwemoto. Bheka izimoto ezidlula emzileni oseduze ngaphambi kokuvula umnyango. Vula umnyango ungabi banzi kakhulu ukuze ungene futhi uvale umnyango ngokushesha ngemuva kwakho.

Indawo yokupaka ekhoneni ivame ukusetshenziswa ezindaweni zokupaka. Izikhala zingase zibe se-engeli engaba ama-degree angu-45 ukuya emzileni wethrafikhi.

 Izinyathelo ezilandelayo kufanele zisetshenziswe ukungena endaweni yokupaka ekhoneni ngakwesokudla:
• Vula isignali yakho yokujika kwesokudla bese wehlisa ijubane lakho.
• Shayela uhambisane nomgwaqo futhi uhlale cishe imitha elilodwa nesigamu (amafidi amahlanu amamitha) kude nengemuva lemoto epakiwe.
• Uma ubona ohlangothini lwesobunxele lwemoto epakiwe ngakwesokudla sendawo yokupaka engenalutho, jika uqonde ngakwesokudla. Bheka phakathi nendawo yetafula ngenkathi uhambisa imoto yakho kancane phambili. Imoto yakho kufanele ibe phakathi nendawo.
• Cishe maphakathi nendawo yokupaka, qondisa amasondo akho bese uqhubeka nokuya phambili kancane. Hlola i-bumper yangaphambili kwesobunxele kanye ne-bumper yangemuva yesokudla yemoto yakho, uqiniseke ukuthi aziseduze kakhulu nezimoto ezipakiwe kuzo zombili izinhlangothi.
• Qhubeka uhamba kancane phambili kuze kube yilapho isondo langaphambili lithinta kancane unqenqema noma lingaphakathi kwamasentimitha angu-50 (amasentimitha angu-20) ukusuka kunqenqema.

 Uma ushiya indawo yokupaka ekhoneni:

 Hlehlisa ngokucophelela futhi kancane. Qiniseka ukuthi akukho lutho ngemuva kwemoto yakho. Ukubuyela emuva kungaba yingozi ngoba kunzima ukubona ithrafikhi njengoba uphuma endaweni. Yeka indlela efanele njengoba ubuyela emuva bese ubheka ngokucophelela ngemuva kwemoto yakho. Hambisa kancane futhi ulungele ukuma uma kudingeka.

 Uma imoto engakwesokudla sakho inde kunemoto yakho, yima lapho ingemuva lemoto yakho lilingana nengemuva lemoto ende. Hlola ithrafikhi kanye nabahamba ngezinyawo. Qhubeka ubuyela emuva uqonde uze ubone ngale kwemoto epakiwe. Lapho ibhampa yakho engaphambili isusa ingemuva lemoto ngakwesobunxele sakho, jika isiteringi ngokucijile uye kwesokudla. Qhubeka ubuyela emuva uye emzileni wokuqala ngemuva kwemoto epakiwe. Yima lapho imoto yakho ihambisana nonqenqema. Shayela phambili emzileni wakho wamanje. Qaphela ezinye izimoto ezihamba ngaphandle kwe-angle yokupaka phambi kwakho.

Izindawo zokupaka eziqondile zise-engeli engama-degree angu-90 ukuya eceleni komgwaqo. Njengoba usondela endaweni yokupaka, gcina cishe amamitha amabili (ayisithupha amamitha) phakathi kwemoto yakho kanye nengemuva lemoto epakwe ngakwesokudla sakho. Hamba kancane kakhulu. Uma i-bumper yakho yangaphambili ilingana nohlangothi lwesobunxele lwemoto epakwe ngakwesokudla sendawo oyihlosile, bheka endaweni engenalutho. Ngenkathi ushayela kancane kakhulu, jika amasondo akho ngokushesha uye kwesokudla. Hlola ekhoneni elingaphambili kwesobunxele kanye nohlangothi lwesokudla lwemoto yakho njengoba ungena endaweni yokupaka ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi awuxhumani nanoma yiziphi izimoto ezipakwe. Bheka endaweni engenalutho, bese ushayela kancane. Qiniseka ukuthi imoto yakho iphakathi nendawo futhi isesitalini ngokuphelele.

 Kulula ukungena esitalini sokupaka esingama-degree angu-90 kwesobunxele kunesinye esingakwesokudla ngoba unesikhala esiningi sokufinyelela i-engeli efanele. Qiniseka ukuthi uhlola ithrafikhi ezayo ngaphambi kokuthi uwele umzila wethrafikhi ozayo. Bheka enkabeni yesitalini sakho njengoba ujika bese ungena kuso. Lokhu kufana nokujika kwesobunxele ungene komunye umgwaqo. Ngena kuphela endaweni yokupaka eqondile noma ekhoneni ngakwesobunxele sakho uma usesendaweni yokupaka.

Ulwazi olulandelayo lusebenza ekupaka ohlangothini lwesokudla lomgwaqo.

 Uma upaka ubheke phezulu emgwaqweni onomngcele, jika amasondo angaphambili aye kwesobunxele (enkabeni yomgwaqo). Uma amasondo ephendukile, vumela imoto yakho ibuyele emuva kancane kuze kube yilapho ithayi langaphambili lesokudla lithinta umngcele. Lokhu kusiza ukuvimbela imoto ukuthi ingangeni emotweni uma iqala ukuhamba.

 Uma upaka ubheke phezulu emgwaqweni ongenamngcele, jika amasondo akho angaphambili aye kwesokudla (emaphethelweni omgwaqo). Ngokwenza lokhu, uma imoto iqala ukuhamba izophuma emgwaqweni hhayi emotweni.

 Uma upaka ubheke phansi, hlala ujika amasondo akho angaphambili aye kwesokudla. Uma kukhona umngcele, vumela imoto yakho ihambe ize ifike lapho ithayi langaphambili lesokudla lithinta khona. Uma amathayi ephendukele kwesokudla, uma imoto iqala ukuhamba izophuma emgwaqweni hhayi emotweni.

 Ukuze uvimbele imoto epakiwe ukuthi ingagingqiki egqumeni, hlala ubeka ibhuleki lakho lokupaka bese ubeka i-gearbox yakho endaweni yokupaka (ukuze i-automatic transmission) noma igiya eliphansi (ukuze i-manual transmission). Uma upaka ohlangothini lwesobunxele lomgwaqo, jikisa amasondo angaphambili ngakolunye uhlangothi.

Ungayipaki imoto yakho:
• eceleni kwendlela noma e-boulevard
• endaweni yokuwela abantu noma kunoma iyiphi ingxenye yendlela yokuwela abantu
• ngaphakathi kwesiphambano
• ngaphakathi kwemitha elilodwa nesigamu (amafidi amahlanu amamitha) yokufinyelela egalaji, emgwaqweni wangasese, noma endleleni yokungena
• eceleni noma ngaphesheya kwanoma yikuphi ukwakhiwa komgwaqo noma isivimbelo lapho ukuma noma ukupaka kungavimba ithrafikhi
• ebhulohweni noma endaweni engaphansi noma ezindleleni eziya ebhulohweni noma endaweni engaphansi
• lapho idivayisi yokulawula ithrafikhi ivimbela ukuma noma ukupaka
• ngaphakathi kwamamitha amahlanu (amafidi angu-16 amamitha) yesibonakaliso sokuma noma uphawu lokuvula
• ngaphakathi kwamamitha amahlanu ohlangothini oluseduze lwendlela ephawulwe
• ngaphakathi kwamamitha amahlanu ye-fire hydrant. Uma i-hydrant ingekho eceleni komgwaqo, ungapaki ngaphakathi kwamamitha amahlanu yephuzu eceleni komgwaqo eduze kwe-hydrant.
• eceleni kwezinye izimoto lapho ungase upake khona kabili
• eduze kwamamitha amahlanu onqenqemeni lomgwaqo ohlanganayo, ngaphandle kwalapho kukhona inkomba yokuthi ukupaka kuvunyelwe, njengokusebenzisa imitha yokupaka
• endaweni noma eduze nendawo lapho umlilo, ukuqhuma, ingozi yemoto, noma esinye isigameko, lapho ukupaka kungavimba khona ithrafikhi noma abasebenzi kanye nemishini yokusabela eziphuthumayo.

 Emgwaqweni ongaphandle kwendawo yasemadolobheni, ungapaki:
• emgwaqweni, emzileni wokupaka, noma ehlombe lomgwaqo omkhulu ngaphandle kwalapho:
• imoto yakho ingakwazi ukuhamba ngamandla ayo,
• kuvela isimo esiphuthumayo, noma
• kuvunyelwe ngumthetho.
• ngaphandle kokuthi kunendlela ecacile yezinye izimoto, kanye
• imoto yakho ingabonakala amamitha angu-60 (200 amamitha ) eceleni komgwaqo kuzo zombili izinhlangothi.

Ukushayisana kungenzeka lapho imigwaqo ihlangana khona futhi ihlangana khona. Kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi ubani okufanele aqhubeke nokuthi ubani okufanele ame ukuze kuvinjelwe ukushayisana. Imithetho yokungena ifuna umuntu oyedwa ukuba ayeke bese evumela omunye ukuba aqhubeke. Izimpawu, amasignali, futhi ngezinye izikhathi indawo yemoto yakho kwezinye izimoto endaweni yokuhlangana kwemigwaqo inquma imithetho. Kodwa-ke, noma ngabe unelungelo lokungena, usenesibopho sokwenza konke ongakwenza ukuvimbela ukushayisana.

Indawo yokuhlangana kwemigwaqo yilapho kuhlangana khona imigwaqo emibili noma ngaphezulu, okudala ukungqubuzana okungenzeka phakathi kwezimoto kuleyo migwaqo kanye nabahamba ngezinyawo abawela imigwaqo. Lezi yizindawo eziyingozi kakhulu zokushayisana.

 Izindawo zokuhlangana zingalawulwa izimpawu zomgwaqo, izibani zezimpawu zomgwaqo, noma kokubili. Izindawo zokuhlangana ezingalawulwa izimpawu noma izimpawu zilawulwa imithetho nemigomo. Ukuze ushayele ngokuphepha ezindaweni zokuhlangana ezilawulwayo nezingalawulwayo, kufanele wazi imithetho nemigomo enquma ukuthi ubani onelungelo lokungena.

 Hlala uqaphela. Abanye abashayeli bangase banganaki izimpawu nezimpawu, noma bangase bangazi ngemithetho ezindaweni zokuhlangana ezingenazo izimpawu noma izimpawu.

 Qaphela: Ukuze uthole ulwazi mayelana nezimpawu zomgwaqo nezimpawu zomgwaqo, bheka iSahluko 2. Iziqondiso ezinikezwa yisikhulu sokuthula noma iphoyisa kumele zilandelwe kunezimpawu noma izimpawu zomgwaqo.

 Izindawo zokuhlangana ezilawulwa izimpawu

 Izimpawu zokuma: Uphawu lokuma lubonisa ukuthi imoto yakho kumele ime ngokuphelele. Ngemva kokuma, hlola indawo yokuhlangana ngokunakekela abahamba ngezinyawo kanye nezinye izimoto. Uma kuphephile, ungaqhubeka. Kunemithetho mayelana nokuthi kufanele uyimise kuphi imoto yakho uma ufika ophawini lokuma.

 Imithetho yokuma ezindaweni zokuhlangana:

 Lapho umugqa wokuma ubekwe uphawu, yimisa imoto yakho ngokuphelele ngaphambi komugqa wokuma. Ngaphambi kokuqhubekela phambili, nika abahamba ngezinyawo futhi bagibele ilungelo lendlela.

 Yima ngaphambi komugqa wokuma endaweni yokuhlangana ephawulwe uphawu. Lapho kungekho umugqa wokuma, yima ngaphambi kwendawo yokuhlangana ephawulwe uphawu.

 Uma kungekho umugqa wokuma noma indawo yokuhlangana ephawulwe uphawu, kufanele ume ngaphakathi kwamamitha amathathu (10 amamitha ) ukusuka emgwaqweni ohlangana. Yima lapho ungeke uphazamise abahamba ngezinyawo abawela noma abazowela umgwaqo.

 Izindawo zokuhlangana ezintathu nezine zokuma, lapho izimpawu zokuma zitholakala kuzo zonke izingqimba, ngezinye izikhathi zibizwa ngokuthi “amakhona anesizotha”. Izimoto ezisondelayo zivela ohlangothini ngalunye kudingeka zime. Bonke abashayeli kumele basebenzise inhlonipho nokuqapha. Inhlonipho iwukuvumela imoto efike kuqala ukuthi iqhubeke kuqala. Uma izimoto ezimbili zifika ngesikhathi esisodwa, inhlonipho ivumela imoto engakwesokudla ukuthi iqhubeke kuqala. Akumelwe uqhubeke ngaphandle kokuthi ungakwenza lokho ngokuphepha.

 Izimpawu zokwehla: Isibonakaliso sokwehla sisho ukuthi kufanele uvumele ezinye izimoto ezingabhekene nesibonakaliso sokwehla zibonise ilungelo lokuhamba. Uma usondela uphawu lokwehla, yehlisa isivinini njengoba usondela endaweni yokuhlangana futhi ulungele ukuma. Kungase kudingeke ukuthi ume futhi uvumele ilungelo lokuhamba kuthrafikhi noma kwabahamba ngezinyawo. Lindela isikhala esiphephile emgwaqweni ngaphambi kokuqhubeka. Uma kungekho bantu abahamba ngezinyawo noma ithrafikhi okudingeka ukuthi uwele kuyo, ungaqhubeka endaweni yokuhlangana ngaphandle kokuma ngokuphelele.

 Indlela yakho kumele ibe ngesivinini esikuvumela ukuthi ume kalula ukuvimbela ukungqubuzana nenye imoto noma umuntu. Imoto esibonakaliso sokwehla ivumela enye imoto ukuthi idlule.

Ezinye izindawo zokuhlangana azinazimpawu zomgwaqo futhi azinazo izibani zezimpawu zomgwaqo. Kulezi zindawo zokuhlangana, kufanele unikeze imoto engakwesokudla indlela eya kwesokudla.

 Hlola ukuthi izimoto zisondela ngakwesobunxele nangakwesokudla uma usondela endaweni yokuhlangana ngaphandle kwedivayisi yokulawula ithrafikhi. Njengendawo yokuhlangana elawulwa uphawu lokuma, lungisa isivinini sakho ukuze sibonakale futhi sivumelane nezimo zomgwaqo. Umbono wakho ungase uvinjwe uthango, izihlahla, noma izimoto ezipakiwe. Kufanele wehlise isivinini sakho ngokwanele ukuze ukwazi ukumisa imoto yakho kalula. Uma izimo zomgwaqo zishelela, yehlisa isivinini sakho ukuze uvumele ibanga lokuma elikhuphukile.

 Qaphela futhi wahlulele kuzo zonke izindawo zokuhlangana ngaphandle kwezimpawu noma izimpawu. Ngisho noma unelungelo lokungena, qiniseka ukuthi enye imoto izokwehla ngaphambi kokuba uqhubeke.

 A iyancipha ku-B: Le ndawo yokuhlangana ayinazimpawu noma izimpawu futhi u-B ungakwesokudla ku-A.

 A iyancipha ku-B: U-A uzobe ewela indlela ka-B futhi akekho ongakwesokudla komunye.

 Uma uphuma emigwaqweni yesevisi, ezindleleni ezinde, ezindaweni zokupaka, nasezindleleni zokungena, kufanele:
• ume ngaphambi kwanoma yikuphi ukuwela eceleni kwendlela
• ume ngaphambi kokungena emgwaqweni omkhulu
• vumela abahamba ngezinyawo.

 Izikhumbuzo zezindawo zokuhlangana:
• Umshayeli ojika ngakwesobunxele endleleni yemoto esondelayo akanakujika ngakwesobunxele kuze kube yilapho iphephile.
• Izindawo zokupaka zinezindawo zokuhlangana ngaphandle kwezimpawu noma izimpawu, futhi imithetho yendlela iyasebenza.
• Zonke izindawo zokuhlangana zinezindawo zokuhlangana ezingase zimakwe noma zingamakwe futhi akumelwe udlule enye imoto emi ngezinyawo.

 A vumela ku-B: Le ndawo yokuhlangana ayinazimpawu noma izimpawu futhi u-B ungakwesokudla kuka-A.

 Indawo yokuhlangana kuka-T engenazimpawu noma izimpawu (eyaziwa nangokuthi indawo yokuhlangana engalawulwa) iyisimo esiyingqayizivele. Azikho izimpawu zokulawula ithrafikhi noma izimpawu, ngakho-ke umshayeli ongakwesokudla (imoto B) unelungelo lokungena. Qaphela kulesi simo uma umshayeli ehamba ngqo (imoto A) ethatha ilungelo lokungena ngendlela ngendlela engafanele.

Ungangeni endaweni yokuhlangana kuze kube yilapho usukwazi ukuyisusa ngokuphelele. Uma ithrafikhi ilibaziseka endaweni yokuhlangana, ungangeni endaweni yokuhlangana kuze kube yilapho usukwazi ukuyisusa ngokuphelele indawo yokuhlangana kanye nendawo yokuhlangana kolunye uhlangothi.

 Imoto A isendaweni efanele. Imoto B ivimbe indawo yokuhlangana komgwaqo. Izimoto C kanye no-D zisebenzise ukwahlulela okubi futhi kwadingeka zime endaweni yokuhlangana komgwaqo. Ithrafikhi ehlukene ithintekile. Qinisekisa ukuthi kunesikhala esanele sokuvumela imoto yakho ukuthi isuse ngokuphelele indawo yokuhlangana kanye nendawo yokuhlangana komgwaqo ngaphambi kokungena.

Iziyingi zomgwaqo kanye nezindawo ezizungezile kuyizindawo ezizungezile ezenzelwe ukuthuthukisa ukuhamba kwezimoto kanye nokuphepha. Izimoto zihlala zijikeleza ngendlela ephambene newashi zizungeze isiqhingi esiphakathi. Izimoto ezingena endaweni ezungezile kumele zivumelane nezimoto esezivele zisendingilizini.

 Kukhona umehluko phakathi kweziyingi zomgwaqo kanye nezindawo ezizungezile. Isiqhingi esiphakathi nendawo esizungezile sincane kunesiqhingi esiphakathi nendawo esizungezile. Indawo ezungezile yaklanywa ngejika eliqinile elizungeze isiqhingi ukukhuthaza isivinini esiphansi futhi ingaba nomngcele othambekele ukuvumela indawo eyengeziwe yezimoto ezinkulu zezentengiselwano. Izindawo ezizungezile zingafika ngezimo nobukhulu obuhlukahlukene. Abashayeli kumele baqaphele futhi balalele izimpawu zomgwaqo kanye noma izimpawu zendlela. Izindawo zokuwela zabahamba ngezinyawo ezindaweni ezizungezile zitholakala kude nendawo ezungezile ukuze kuphephe, kanye nemigqa ethuthukisiwe yokubona abashayeli bezimoto kanye nabahamba ngezinyawo.

 Abashayeli kumele balandele imithetho efanayo lapho besebenzisa izindawo ezizungezile noma izindawo ezizungezile.

 Indawo ejikelezayo yomgwaqo enomzila owodwa

Ukungena ezimpambanweni ezijikelezayo: Abashayeli abangena esiphambanweni esijikelezayo somzila owodwa kumele bavumele abashayeli asebevele besesindingilizini. Uma sebesesindingilizini, abashayeli kumele basebenzise isignali efanele lapho belungiselela ukuphuma.

 Ukuphuma ezimpambanweni ezijikelezayo: Njalo linda ukuze usebenzise isignali yakho yokujika kwesokudla ngemva kokudlula indlela yokuphuma engaphambi kokuphuma kwakho okuhlosiwe. Lokhu kutshela abanye abashayeli ukuthi uhlose ukushiya isindingilizi ekuphumeni okulandelayo.

 Uma uhlose ukuphuma ekuphumeni kokuqala okutholakalayo:
• Sebenzisa isignali yakho yesokudla njengoba usondela. Yishiye ivuliwe uze uphume esindingilizini.
• Njengoba usondela, skena abahamba ngezinyawo nabahamba ngamabhayisikili ezimpambanweni ezingenela naseziphumeni zesindingilizini.

 Uma uhlose ukuphuma kunoma iyiphi enye indlela yokuphuma:
• Njengoba usondela, skena abahamba ngezinyawo nabahamba ngamabhayisikili ezimpambanweni ezingenela naseziphumeni zesindingilizini.
• Sebenzisa isignali yakho yesokudla uma usondela endleleni yokuphuma ofuna ukuyisebenzisa.

 Indilinga yethrafikhi enemizila emibili / umjikelezo

 Ukungena ezimpambanweni zemigwaqo eziyindilinga: Abashayeli abangena esiphambanweni semigwaqo eyindilinga kumele bavumele abashayeli asebevele besendingilizini. Uma sebesendingilizini, abashayeli kumele basebenzise isignali efanele lapho belungiselela ukuphuma.

 Ukusebenzisa umzila wesokudla ukungena nokuphuma: Abashayeli abangena esiphambanweni besuka emzileni wesokudla kumele benze kanjalo uma kuphephile futhi bahlale emzileni wesokudla ngenkathi besendingilizini. Kumele baphume besebenzisa umzila wesokudla.

 Ukusebenzisa umzila wesokudla ukungena nokuphuma: Abashayeli abasebenzisa umzila wesokudla ukungena endingilizini kumele benze kanjalo uma kuphephile futhi bahlale emzileni wesokudla ngenkathi besendingilizini/ umjikelezo. Kumele baphume besebenzisa umzila wesokudla. Abashayeli abahlela ukuhamba bedlula indlela yokuqala yokuphuma kufanele basebenzise umzila wesokudla ukungena nokuphuma.

 Ezimpambanweni zemigwaqo eziyindilinga: Ngesikhathi besendingilizini, abashayeli abangakwesokudla kumele bavumele abashayeli abangakwesokunxele. Sebenzisa isignali efanele uma ulungiselela ukuphuma. Qaphela lapho uphuma futhi uwela umzila ongakwesokudla (ngaphandle).

 Ungayishintshi imizila endulunguleni. Izimoto emigwaqweni ebomvu (imicibisholo emhlophe) kumele zihambisane nezimoto emigwaqweni ephuzi (imicibisholo emnyama). Izimoto ezingena endulunguleni (imizila empunga) kumele zihambisane nezimoto endulunguleni (imizila ebomvu nephuzi).

 Imigwaqo ephumayo eyindilinga: Njalo linda ukuze usebenzise isignali yakho yokujika kwesokudla ngemva kokudlula indlela yokuphuma engaphambi kokuphuma kwakho okuhlosiwe. Lokhu kutshela abanye abashayeli ukuthi uhlose ukushiya indilinga ekuphumeni okulandelayo.

 Uma uhlose ukuphuma ekuphumeni kokuqala okutholakalayo:
• Sondela endulunguleni usebenzisa umzila ongakwesokudla.
• Sebenzisa isignali yakho efanele njengoba usondela. Yishiye ivuliwe uze uphume endulunguleni.
• Njengoba usondela, skena abahambi ngezinyawo nabahamba ngamabhayisikili ezindaweni zokuwela abantu emnyango nasezindaweni zokuphuma zendulungu.
• Zivumelanise nezimoto endulunguleni.
• Phuma endundumeni usebenzisa umzila wesokudla.

 Uma uhlose ukuhamba kunoma iyiphi enye indlela yokuphuma:
• Sondela endundumeni usebenzisa umzila wesobunxele.
• Sebenzisa isignali yakho yesobunxele ukuze ubonise ukuthi awuhleli ukusebenzisa indlela yokuphuma yokuqala.
• Njengoba usondela, skena abahamba ngezinyawo nabahamba ngamabhayisikili ezindaweni zokuwela abantu abahamba ngezinyawo emnyango nasezindaweni zokuphuma zendilinga.
• Zithobe kuthrafikhi endundumeni.
• Phuma endundumeni usebenzisa umzila wesobunxele.

 Khumbula, uma uphuma usebenzisa umzila wesobunxele:
• Sebenzisa isignali yakho yesokudla uma udlula indlela yokuphuma engaphambi kokuphuma ozoyisebenzisa.
• Hlola ithrafikhi endundumeni yesokudla engase iqhubeke izungeze indilinga.
• Bheka phambili abahamba ngezinyawo endaweni yokuwela abantu abahamba ngezinyawo lapho uzophuma khona.
• Phuma endundumeni usebenzisa umzila wesobunxele.
• Uma ungakwazi ukuma noma ukuphuma ngokuphepha, hlala emzileni wakho bese uhambahamba uzungeze indilinga/i-roundabout futhi.

Ukushayisana okuningi kubangelwa abashayeli abahluleka ukujika ngokuphephile.

 Ukujika kwesokudla

 Khumbula ukuthi imizila yokuhamba ayiphawulwa njalo ngemigqa emgwaqweni noma izimpawu. Umzila wokuhamba uyingxenye yomgwaqo ebanzi ngokwanele ukuvumela ukudlula komugqa owodwa wezimoto. Lokhu kufaka phakathi umzila womgwaqo ogcwele indawo yokupaka amamitha . Umzila oseduze nomgwaqo lapho ukupaka khona izimoto ubizwa kangcono ngokuthi umzila womgwaqo, hhayi umzila wokupaka. Imizila yomgwaqo ayiyona nje yokupaka. Isetshenziselwa ukuvala umgwaqo nokungena emgwaqweni.

 Lungiselela ukujika kusenesikhathi. Uma ungekho emgwaqweni ofanele wokujika, hlola izibuko zakho zangemuva nezangaphandle bese uhlola amahlombe. Shintshela futhi ushintshe imizila uma kuphephile. Kufanele ube semzileni wakho ofanele wokujika okungenani amamitha ayi-15 (50 [ amamitha ) ngaphambi komgwaqo.

 Khumbula ukunikeza abahambi ngezinyawo nezimoto ithuba lokungena emgwaqweni onqamulayo. Ngaphambi kokujika, hlola umgwaqo ojika kuwo bese unquma ukuthi kunendawo eyanele yini yokungena emgwaqweni onqamulayo. Hlola abagibele amabhayisikili nabahamba ngezinyawo abasondela emgwaqweni onqamulayo.

 Uma ujika ngakwesokudla usuka emgwaqweni onezindlela ezimbili ungene komunye umgwaqo onezindlela ezimbili, hlala uphakathi emgwaqweni ojikayo, kungabi ngaphezu kwemitha elilodwa (amathathu amamitha) kude nomgwaqo onqamulayo noma onqenqemeni lomgwaqo. Gcina leli banga njengoba usondela emgwaqweni onqamulayo, ngenkathi ujika, futhi njengoba usuka kuwo.

 Khumbula okulandelayo lapho ujika:
• Vumela abahambi ngezinyawo bawele emgwaqweni onqamulayo.
• Ungangeni emgwaqweni onqamulayo ukuze ujike kuze kube yilapho abahambi ngezinyawo sebephumile emgwaqweni onqamulayo.

 Uma kuphephile, qedela uhambo lwakho ngokujika ungene emgwaqweni wokuqala wethrafikhi otholakalayo ngakwesokudla uma kunesikhala sokukuvumela ukuthi usheshise kancane futhi ushintshe imizila. Ngemva kokuphothula ukujika, bheka phambili endleleni ohlose ukuyihamba.

 Uma imoto epakiwe noma isivimbelo sikude ngokwanele, qedela ukujika emzileni ongemuva kwemoto noma isivimbelo. Bese ushintsha imizila uye kwesobunxele uma kuphephile. Kunconywa ukuthi umzila onqenqemeni ungabi nezimoto ezipakiwe okungenani isigamu sebhulokhi uma wenza lolu hlobo lokujika.

 Uma umzila wokuqala emgwaqweni ojika kuwo unemoto epakiwe noma isivimbelo eduze nekhoneni, jika uye emzileni wokuqala otholakalayo kwesobunxele semoto epakiwe. Uma umzila usucacile, jika ungene ngqo kuwo. Qaphela: Yehla uye kwezinye izimoto ezisondela ngakwesobunxele sakho ezihamba emzileni ozongena kuwo. Ungajiki ubanzi futhi uhlale emigwaqweni emibili lapho ujika.

 Ngaphandle kokuthi kuvinjelwe uphawu, ungajika ngakwesokudla ngesibani esibomvu ngemva kokuma ngokuphelele endaweni efanele yokuma (umugqa wokuma noma indawo yokuwela).

 Ukujika kwesobunxele

 Ukwahlulela isikhathi nendawo kabi lapho ujika ngakwesobunxele kuyimbangela ehamba phambili yokushayisana. Ukujika ngakwesobunxele kungaba yingozi ngoba kungase kube nezimoto ezisondelayo ezivela ezinhlotsheni eziningi futhi imoto yakho iwela imizila yezimoto ezizayo.

 Lungiselela kahle kusenesikhathi. Kufanele ube semzileni wakho ofanele wokujika okungenani amamitha ayi-15 (50 izinyawo) ngaphambi kwempambanandlela. Uma ujika usuka emgwaqweni onezindlela ezimbili uye komunye umgwaqo onezindlela ezimbili onomzila owodwa wokujika ngakwesobunxele, shayela emzileni ngakwesokudla komugqa ophuzi. Hlala ngemuva kompambanandlela uma kunendawo yemoto eyodwa kuphela ngaphambi komzila wakho empambanandlela. Uma kusemthethweni ukwenza kanjalo, ngena empambanandlela lapho imoto ephambi kwakho isusa umpambanandlela.

 Uma kufanele ume empambanandlela ngaphambi kokuqeda ukujika ngakwesobunxele, hlala ngakwesokudla komugqa ophuzi bese ugcina amasondo akho angaphambili eqonde phambili. Ukwenza kanjalo kuvimbela imoto ekucindezelweni emgwaqeni ozayo uma ushayiswa ngemuva. Hlola umgwamanda owela kuwo abahamba ngezinyawo nabahamba ngamabhayisikili. Bheka kahle endleleni ohlose ukuyihamba. Uma kuphephile, jika imoto ngakwesobunxele endaweni yokuhlangana. Qedela ukujika ngokushayela uye ohlangothini lwesokudla lomugqa ophuzi womgwaqo owungenile. Ungajiki ube banzi bese uthatha imizila emibili uma ujika.

 Ngaphambi kokujika ngakwesobunxele usuka emgwaqweni omkhulu onemizila emibili, hlola ihlombe ngakwesobunxele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi awudluliswa enye imoto ngakwesobunxele sakho.

 Indlela ezimbili ungene ngezindlela ezimbili

 Uma kuphephile futhi kusemthethweni, jika usuka emzileni oseduze nangakwesokudla komugqa ophuzi. Jikela emzileni oseduze nangakwesokudla komugqa ophuzi. Qiniseka ukuthi unesikhathi esanele nendawo yokujika ngokuphephile uma kukhona izimoto ezizayo. Zithobe ezimotweni ezizayo kanye nabahamba ngezinyawo abawela ngakwesobunxele sakho.
Indlela ezimbili ungene ngendlela eyodwa

 Uma kuphephile futhi kusemthethweni, jika usuka emzileni oseduze nomugqa ophuzi. Jikela emzileni wokuqala otholakalayo ohlangothini lwesobunxele lomgwaqo. Zithobe ezimotweni ezizayo kanye nabahamba ngezinyawo abawela ngakwesobunxele sakho.

 Indlela eyodwa uye endleleni ezimbili

 Uma kuphephile futhi kusemthethweni, jika usuka emzileni oseduze nohlangothi lwesobunxele lomgwaqo. Jikela emzileni oseduze kwesokudla somugqa ophuzi. Zithobe kwabahamba ngezinyawo ngakwesobunxele sakho.

 Indlela eyodwa uye endleleni eyodwa

 Uma kuphephile futhi kusemthethweni, jika usuka emzileni oseduze nohlangothi lwesobunxele lomgwaqo. Jikela emzileni oseduze nohlangothi lwesobunxele lomgwaqo. Zithobe kwabahamba ngezinyawo abawela ngakwesobunxele sakho. Uma ukukhanya kubomvu, uma kungekho zimpawu ezivimbela ukujika, ungajika ngakwesobunxele usuka endleleni eyodwa uye kwenye indlela eyodwa ngemva kokuma ngokuphelele endaweni efanele yokuma (umugqa wokuma noma oweqayo) futhi ukujika kungaqedwa ngokuphephile. Lokhu kusebenza nasekujikeni kwemizila emibili. Zithobe kwabahamba ngezinyawo abawela ngakwesobunxele sakho.

Eminye imizila ibizwa ngokuthi imizila yokujika. Njengoba usondela endaweni yokuhlangana, hlola njalo izimpawu nezimpawu zendlela. Qiniseka ukuthi usemzileni ofanele ukujika noma ukuya phambili.

 Ukujika kwemizila emibili

 Uma ujika kwesokudla noma kwesobunxele lapho ukujika kwemizila emibili kukhonjiswa khona izimpawu zendlela noma izimpawu, sondela endaweni yokuhlangana kwenye yemizila ephawuliwe bese ujika uye emzileni ohambisanayo.

 Ukujika kwemizila emibili kungenziwa kuphela lapho kuboniswe khona. Ungalokothi ujike ububanzi noma ushintshe imizila ezindaweni zokuhlangana zokujika kwemizila emibili njengoba enye imoto ingase ijike eceleni kwakho. Bukela imoto ijika eceleni kwakho, njengoba ingase ijike ububanzi iye emzileni wakho.

 Ngaphandle kokuthi kuvinjelwe uphawu, ungajika ngakwesokudla esibanini esibomvu endaweni yokuhlangana yokujika kabili kwesokudla ngemva kokuma ngokuphelele endaweni efanele yokuma (umugqa wokuma noma indawo yokudlula) futhi ukujika kungaqedwa ngokuphephile.

 Ngemva kokuqeda ukujika, imizila yokujika emibili ingahlangana ibe umzila owodwa. Umshayeli osemgqeni ophelayo kumele ashintshele emzileni otholakalayo ngokulandela izinyathelo ezifanele zokushintsha umzila.

 Imizila yokujika kwesobunxele enezindlela ezimbili

 Umzila wokujika kwesobunxele onezindlela ezimbili uvumela izimoto ezivela ohlangothini ngalunye ukuthi zijike kwesobunxele zisebenzisa umzila ofanayo. Izimoto ezivela kuzo zombili izinkomba zabelana ngalo mzila ophakathi ukuze zijike kwesobunxele. Kuvunyelwe ukuwela umugqa ophuzi oqinile ukuze ungene emzileni wokujika ohlanganyelwe. Ngena kuphela emzileni wokujika eduze kwalapho uzobe ujika khona. Qaphela izimoto ezizayo emzileni wakho.

 Izikhumbuzo zokujika ngokuphephile:
• Hlola ithrafikhi, hlola amahlombe, faka isignali, futhi uma uphephile, ngena emzileni ofanele.
• Faka isignali ngesikhathi esanele sokunikeza isexwayiso esifanele kwabanye abashayeli kanye nabahamba ngezinyawo ngenhloso yakho.
• Hlola ithrafikhi ezayo kanye neyamanqamu kanye nendawo yokuwela eya ngakwesobunxele sakho yabahamba ngezinyawo. Qaphela kokubili ithrafikhi yezimoto kanye nabahamba ngezinyawo.

Ukujika kwe-U kwenziwa ngokujika imoto yakho endaweni yokupaka izimoto ukuze iye kolunye uhlangothi ngokusebenzisa imizila ezayo.

 Ungenzi ukujika kwe-U ngaphandle kokuthi kungenziwa ngokuphephile.

 Ukujika kwe-U akuvunyelwe:
• endaweni yokupaka izimoto elawulwa isignali yokulawula ithrafikhi (izibani zethrafikhi) ngaphandle kokuthi kuvunyelwe yidivayisi yokulawula ithrafikhi
• lapho uphawu luvimbela ukujika kwe-U.

 Ezindaweni zasemadolobheni ukujika kwe-U akuvunyelwe:
• emgwaqweni ophakathi kwezindawo yokupaka izimoto
• endaweni yokupaka izimoto emgwaqweni
• endaweni yokupaka izimoto lapho omunye noma eminingi yemigwaqo iyindlela yokufinyelela endaweni yokupaka yomphakathi noma yangasese umphakathi ongayifinyelela.

 Ngaphandle kwezindawo zasemadolobheni (zasemakhaya) Ukujika kwe-U akuvunyelwe:
• ekhoneni
• lapho usondela noma eduze kwentaba lapho umshayeli wenye imoto engakwazi ukukubona khona okungaphakathi kwamamitha angu-150 usondela kunoma iyiphi indlela.
