description:
Iningi lemigwaqo emikhulu kanye nemigwaqo emikhulu ihlukaniswe ngemizila, enemigqa ebusweni bomgwaqo ekhombisa ukuthi imoto yakho kufanele ihambe kuphi kanye nemithetho yokushayela emgwaqweni okufanele uyilandele. Khetha umzila ohlangabezana kangcono nezidingo zakho zokuphepha nokufika lapho uya khona. Hlela kusengaphambili. Ungashiyi izinguquko zomzila kuze kube umzuzu wokugcina. Uma umgwaqo uhlukaniswe ngemizila ngemigqa ebonakalayo emaka ebusweni bomgwaqo, kufanele ushayele phakathi komzila wakho.

 Izindawo ezingaboni

 Izibuko zakho zangemuva zangaphakathi nezangaphandle zizokukhombisa ithrafikhi engemuva kwemoto yakho. Ngeke zikubonise konke emaceleni noma okulungile eceleni nangemuva kancane emigwaqweni eseduze kwakho. Lezi izindawo ezingaboni

 Umbono esibukweni sakho sangemuva sangaphakathi kufanele ubonise umbono omkhulu ngangokunokwenzeka ngefasitela lakho langemuva. Izibuko zangemuva zangaphandle kufanele zibonise imoto yakho encane ohlangothini lapho isibuko sinamathiselwe khona, kanye nendawo engemuva kwakho emzileni oseduze kwakho. Kufanele zibekwe ngendlela yokuthi kusukela endaweni yakho yokushayela ubone umkhathi ngemuva kwakho phakathi kwesibuko ngasinye. Qiniseka ukuthi izibuko zakho zangemuva zangaphakathi nangaphandle zilungiswe kahle ukuze kuncishiswe izindawo ezingaboni. Izithombe ezilandelayo zibonisa ukuthi yini engabonakala ezibukweni ezilungiswe kahle.

 Ukushintsha imizila

 Ukuze ubheke izindawo ezingaboni, kufanele uhlole amahlombe ngaphezu kokuhlola isibuko ngaphambi kokushintsha imizila. Ukuze uhlole kahle amahlombe, bheka ngokushesha emuva phezu kwehlombe lakho ngamafasitela aseceleni angemuva ngendlela ohlose ukuyihamba. Lokhu kukuvumela ukuthi ubone indawo ongakwazi ukuyibona ezibukweni zakho. Uma ungenawo amafasitela aseceleni kwesihlalo sangemuva noma ifasitela langemuva, udinga ukusebenzisa izibuko zakho zangaphandle ezinesibuko esihlanganisiwe esinamathiselwe.

 Uma usuka komunye umzila uye komunye, yenza okulandelayo:
• Qiniseka ukuthi ukushintsha umzila kuvunyelwe.
• Hlola ithrafikhi ngokubheka ezibukweni zakho zangemuva zangaphakathi nangaphandle.
• Hlola phezu kwehlombe lakho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi azikho izimoto noma abagibeli bamabhayisikili ezindaweni ongaboni kuzo.
• Vula isibani sesignali esifanele.
• Uma kuphephile, shintsha imizila ngenkathi ugcina ijubane lakho ngangokunokwenzeka.
• Qinisekisa ukuthi isibani sakho sesignali sivaliwe.

 Umbhalo ezithombeni:
• Esebenzisa isibuko sangemuva sangaphakathi, umshayeli weMoto A angabona iMoto B.
• Esebenzisa isibuko sangaphandle kwesobunxele, umshayeli weMoto A angabona iMoto C.
• Esebenzisa izibuko zangaphandle kanye nesibuko sangemuva sangaphakathi, umshayeli weMoto A angabona iMoto B, C, kanye no-D. Umshayeli weMoto A akakwazi ukubona iMoto E no-F, kungaba ezibukweni noma ngokubona okungaphandle (ohlangothini). Izimoto E no-F zisezindaweni ezingaboni zeMoto A. Umbala obomvu ubonisa izindawo ezingaboni kumshayeli weMoto A.

Ukudlula emgwaqweni omkhulu onemizila eminingi

 Emgwaqweni omkhulu onemizila eminingi, ithrafikhi ehamba kancane kufanele isebenzise umzila wokuhamba oqhele kakhulu ngakwesokudla (ngaphandle kokuthi kudingeke umzila wesobunxele ujike kwesobunxele). Lokhu kushiya umzila wesobunxele utholakala kwabanye abashayeli ukuze bawusebenzisele ukudlula.

 Imizila yokudlula

 Umzila odlulayo umzila owengezwe emgwaqweni omkhulu ukuze uvumele ukudlula, ngokuvamile ezintabeni. Izimoto ezihamba kancane zihamba zingene emgwaqweni odlulayo ngakwesokudla, okuvumela ezinye izimoto ukuba zidlule ngokuphepha emgwaqweni wesobunxele. Izimpawu zizokwazisa abashayeli ngomzila odlulayo ongaphambili.

 Lapho besondela ekupheleni komzila odlulayo, abashayeli abasendleleni yesokudla kumele bahlangane ngokuphephile nethrafikhi eya kwesobunxele. Abashayeli abasendleleni yesokudla kumele babambisane ukuvumela abashayeli abasuka emgwaqweni wesokudla bahlangane. Izimpawu zifakwa ukuxwayisa abashayeli ukuthi umzila odlulayo uyaphela.

 Ukudlula emgwaqweni omkhulu onemizila emibili

 Emgwaqweni omkhulu onemizila emibili (umzila owodwa wethrafikhi ohlangothini ngalunye), ukudlula enye imoto kungaba nzima futhi kube yingozi. Amaphutha ekuhluleleni angabangela ukushayisana ngqo, futhi lokhu kuvame ukubangela ukufa. Ukudlula kufanele kwenziwe kuphela lapho kusemthethweni, lapho kudingeka, futhi ngokuqapha okukhulu.

 Ngaphambi kokudlula enye imoto emgwaqweni onemizila emibili, yenza okulandelayo:
• Dlula kuphela lapho kuvunyelwe khona.
• Gcina ibanga eliphephile ngemuva kwemoto ohlose ukuyidlula.
• Dlula izimoto kuphela uma kungekho thrafikhi ezayo ukuze uthole ibanga eliphephile.
• Hlola izibuko zakho zangemuva zangaphandle nezangaphakathi.
• Hlola ehlombe lakho ngakwesobunxele ukuze ubheke izimoto ezingase zikudlule ngakwesobunxele. Lezi zimoto zingase zibe sendaweni ongayiboni.
• Vula isibani sakho sesignali sobunxele.
• Ngaphambi kokuthi uzame ukudlula, hlola futhi ukuthi azikho ithrafikhi ezayo nokuthi ungaqedela i-pass ngenkathi ivunyelwe.
• Akukho emthethweni ukudlula umkhawulo wejubane uma udlula enye imoto.
• Uma imoto oyidlulile isibonakala esibukweni sakho sangemuva sangaphakathi, hlola ihlombe ngakwesokudla.
• Vula isibani sakho sesignali kwesokudla.
• Buyela emzileni wakho wokuqala ngenkathi ugcina ijubane lakho.
• Qinisekisa ukuthi isibani sakho sesignali sivaliwe.

 Uma udlula emgwaqweni omkhulu onemizila emibili, siza umshayeli odlulayo ngokuhlala emzileni wakho. Hamba uye ohlangothini lwesokudla lomzila wakho ukuze unikeze omunye umshayeli umbono ongcono womgwaqo ongaphambili.

 Kunini lapho kungekho emthethweni ukudlula enye imoto?

 Ungadluli uma:
• izimoto ezizayo ziseduze kakhulu. Uma unokungabaza ngokugcwalisa iphasi ngokuphepha, ungazami ukudlula
• umugqa ophuzi oqinile ukhona ohlangothini lwakho lomugqa ophakathi nendawo
• uphawu lubonisa indawo engadluli
• usesikoleni noma endaweni yokudlala ngesikhathi sesikole noma sendawo yokudlala
• enye imoto iyamiswa ukuze kuvunyelwe umuntu ohamba ngezinyawo ukuba awele endaweni yokuwela abantu abahamba ngezinyawo ephawulwe noma engaphawulwe
• ibhasi lesikole linezibani ezibomvu ezikhanyayo kanye nengalo yokuma enwetshiwe ekhombisa ukuthi ibhasi lesikole limile. (Akuyona indlela ephephile ukudlula ibhasi lesikole elinezibani eziphuzi ezikhanyayo, okubonisa ukuthi kunciphisa isivinini, ngoba kungase kube ukuthi liyama ukuze abagibeli bangene futhi baphume ebhasini lesikole. Uma uqhubeka, kwenze ngokucophelela.)

 Umbhalo ezithombeni:
• Indlela edlulayo ivumela ezinye izimoto ukuba zidlule ngokuphephile
• Ukudlula emgwaqweni omkhulu onemizila emibili

Ingxenye yomgwaqo omkhulu ophakathi konqenqema lomgwaqo nomzila wokuqala wokuhamba, ngezinye izikhathi obizwa ngokuthi ihlombe, ingeyabashayeli okudingeka bame ngenxa yesimo esiphuthumayo noma ngoba banezinkinga ngemoto yabo.

 Ungashayeli emzileni wokuma ophuthumayo womgwaqo omkhulu. Ungadluli noma usize enye imoto ukuthi ikudlule ngokusebenzisa lo mzila.

 Umbhalo esithombeni:
• Umzila wokuma ophuthumayo
• Umgwaqo omkhulu
• Umzila wokuma ophuthumayo
• • Imizila yokuma ophuthumayo igudla imizila yokuhamba emgwaqweni omkhulu.

Ukuhlanganisa

 Ukuhlanganisa kwenziwa lapho imigwaqo emibili ihlangana ibe yinye futhi ithrafikhi emgwaqweni omkhulu kumele ibambisane ukuze kuvunyelwe isikhala esanele sokuba izimoto zingene zisuka emzileni ohlanganayo. Imoto ehlanganayo noma izimoto esezisemgwaqweni omkhulu azinalo ilungelo lokuhamba. Ukuhlanganisa kuwumthwalo wemfanelo ohlanganyelwe phakathi kwezimoto ezijoyina umgwaqo kanye nezimoto esezisemgwaqweni kakade.

 Gwema ukunciphisa ijubane lakho ngokuzumayo noma ukuma lapho uhlangana. Ukuhlanganisa imizila kuklanyelwe ukuvumela imoto yakho ukuthi ifinyelele umkhawulo wejubane obekwe eceleni womgwaqo ohlangana kuwo. Abashayeli abangemuva kwakho balindele ukuthi uqhubeke uhamba phambili. Uma wehlisa noma umisa imoto yakho ingase ishaywe ngemuva.

 Amanye amathiphu okuhlanganisa ngokuphephile:
• Ukuhlanganisa kudinga ukuthi uhlele futhi ubeke isikhathi sokusondela kwakho ukuze uhlangane kahle nethrafikhi, ngaphandle kokuma noma ukunciphisa ijubane lakho ngokuzumayo.
• Hlola ukuhamba kwethrafikhi emgwaqweni omkhulu ngokushesha nje lapho ubona umzila lapho uzohlangana khona.
• Khetha isikhala sakho kuthrafikhi, bese uqala ukulungisa isivinini sakho, uma kudingeka. Qhubeka ubheka isikhala osikhethile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wenza isivinini kanye nokulungiswa kwesikhathi okudingekayo ukuze uhlangane ngokuphephile ngaphandle kokuthinta ithrafikhi.
• Sebenzisa isibani sakho sesignali ngaphambi noma uma usemzileni wokusheshisa.
• Sheshisa isivinini sethrafikhi emgwaqweni omkhulu.
• Hlala uhlola amahlombe ukuze ubuke isikhala bese ubheka esibukweni sakho sangemuva ukuthi ubone izimoto ezikulandelayo.
• Uma kuphephile futhi kusemthethweni, ngena esikhaleni ngemva kokuthi usudlule umugqa omhlophe oqinile womzila wokusheshisa. Gcina isivinini sakho siseduze noma siseduze nesivinini sezinye izimoto.
• Qinisekisa ukuthi isibani sakho sesignali sivaliwe.

 Uma usemzileni omkhulu, futhi ithrafikhi ihlangana, hamba kwesobunxele uye emzileni olandelayo uma kuphephile. Lokhu kushiya umzila wokuhamba ofanele ucacile ukuze izimoto ezihlanganayo zingene.

 Ukuphuma

 Amanye amathiphu okuthi ungaphuma kanjani emgwaqweni omkhulu noma emgwaqweni omkhulu ngokuphephile:
• Hlela kusengaphambili. Yiba semzileni ofanele ngaphambi kokuba ufike endleleni yakho yokuphuma.
• Sebenzisa isignali yakho yokujika kusenesikhathi ngaphambi kokuphuma ukuze uxwayise abanye abashayeli.
• Ngena emzileni wokudedela uma ukhona.
• Uma kungenzeka, yenza okuningi kokunciphisa umzila wokudedela. Eminye imizila yokudedela imfushane; kungase kudingeke uqale ukunciphisa ijubane lakho usesemgwaqweni omkhulu.
• Uma usuphumile, qiniseka ukuthi isibani sakho sesiginali sivaliwe.
• Uma uphuthelwa indlela yakho yokuphuma, ungayeki. Qhubeka uye endleleni elandelayo yokuphuma bese wenza izinhlelo zokubuyela emzileni wakho. Ungami bese ubuyela emuva emgwaqweni omkhulu, emgwaqweni wokuma ophuthumayo, noma ehlombe.

 Izindawo zokweluka

 Kwezinye izindawo zokushintshana komgwaqo, kunezindawo lapho indlela yokungena neyokuphuma emgwaqweni omkhulu isebenzisa khona indlela efanayo. Indlela yokungena neyokuphuma ingasondelana. Lezi zindawo zidinga ukuqapha nokubambisana ngoba izimoto zabelana ngomzila ofanayo ukuze zihambe kancane ukuze ziphume emgwaqweni omkhulu kuyilapho ezinye izimoto ziwusebenzisa ukwandisa isivinini sokungena emgwaqweni omkhulu. Indawo ehlanganyelwa yilezi zimoto ibizwa ngokuthi indawo yokweluka.

 Ezindaweni zokweluka, lawula isivinini sakho kanye nesikhathi sokushintsha komzila wakho ukuze uhlangane neminye ithrafikhi. Lokhu kudinga ukusetshenziswa kwesikhathi nendawo ngobuhlakani. Qaphela ezindaweni zokweluka ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izimoto zingaphuma futhi zingene emgwaqweni omkhulu ngokuphephile.

 Amajika

 Amajika adinga ukunakwa okukhethekile. Ukuze ushayele emajika ngokuphephile, abashayeli kufanele bakhumbule:
• Uma udinga ukunciphisa isivinini sakho, kwenze ngaphambi kokungena ejika, futhi uhlale uphakathi komzila wakho.
• Ukuze uhlale uphakathi komzila wakho, bheka phambili naseduze kwejika. Lokhu kuzokusiza ngokuqondisa nokulawula isivinini.
• Gcina isivinini esiphephile nesizinzile ngemva kokungena ejika.
• Ungadlulisi izimoto ezigobileni emigwaqweni emikhulu enomzila owodwa ohlangothini ngalunye. Akuphephile futhi akuvumelekile ngokomthetho.
• Imigwaqo emanzi noma ebandayo ingenza amajika ashelele futhi yandise ingozi ngenkathi ushayela.

 Ngenxa yamandla e-kinetic, imoto yakho izofuna ukuhamba iqonde phambili egobileni yize uphendula amasondo. Uma amathayi akho elahlekelwa ukubambelela komgwaqo njengoba ungena noma uhamba uzungeze igobile ngakwesobunxele (Imoto A kumdwebo ongenhla), imoto yakho ingase ishelele ngakwesokunene somgwaqo. Uma lokhu kwenzeka, hlala kude ne-accelerator kanye ne-brake. Uma amathayi akho elahlekelwa ukubambelela komgwaqo njengoba ungena egobileni ngakwesokunene (Imoto B kumdwebo ongenhla), imoto yakho ingase ishelele ezimotweni ezizayo. Uma usheleleka egobileni, hlala kude ne-brake kanye ne-accelerator. Qhubeka ubheke ohlangothini ofuna ukuya kulo, futhi wenze ukulungiswa okuncane kokuqondisa ukuze uphume e-skid.

 Amagquma

 Amagquma nawo adinga ukunakwa okukhethekile. Khumbula okulandelayo uma uhamba ukhuphuka igquma:
• Qaphela bese udlulela ngakwesokudla emzileni wakho njengoba usondela esiqongweni segquma. Lokhu kungakuvimbela ukuthi ungashayiswa yimoto ezayo eye yawela umugqa ophakathi futhi isemzileni wakho.
• Ungadluli eduze kwesiqongo segquma emgwaqweni omkhulu onemizila emibili, njengoba ungakwazi ukubona okuphambi kwakho.

 Khumbula okulandelayo uma uhamba wehla igquma:
• Uma igquma liphakeme kakhulu, lungisa isivinini sakho. Isikhathi esikuthathayo ukuze ume sizokhula uma uhamba wehla igquma.
• Emotweni enegiya elijwayelekile, ukushintshela egiya eliphansi kunganciphisa ingozi yokuthi amabhuleki akho ashise kakhulu.

Kunezikhathi lapho kwenzeka into engalindelekile edinga ukuthi ubhuleke ngokuzumayo. Isihluthulelo sokubhuleka okuphuthumayo ukumisa imoto ngokushesha ngangokunokwenzeka ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa ukulawula imoto yakho.

 Uma imoto yakho inamabhuleki e-ABS

 Izimoto eziningi zifakwe uhlelo lokubhuleka oluvimbela ukukhiya (i-ABS). I-ABS ikuvumela ukuthi uqondise ngenkathi amabhuleki esetshenziswa. I-ABS isebenzisa ingcindezi yamabhuleki esondweni ngalinye, isuka ekukhiyeni iye ekugingqikeni kancane. Uzokuzwa lokhu njengokudlidliza nge-pedal yebhuleki. Nge-ABS ungabhuleka kakhulu ngangokunokwenzeka ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa ikhono lakho lokuqondisa.

 Ukuze ubhuleke esimweni esiphuthumayo, landela lezi zinyathelo:
• Faka ingcindezi eqinile eqinile ephedalini lebhuleki.
• Ungapompi noma ukhulule i-pedal yebhuleki.
• Bheka bese uqondisa ohlangothini ofuna ukuya kulo.

 Hlola incwadi yemiyalelo yomnikazi wemoto yakho ukuthola ulwazi olwengeziwe ngamasu okubhuleka okuphuthumayo.

 Uma imoto yakho ingenawo amabhuleki e-ABS

 Ezimotweni ezingenayo i-ABS, ukubhuleka ngamandla kungabangela amasondo ukuba `avaleke` futhi ayeke ukugingqika. Lokhu kungabangela ukuthi ulahlekelwe ukulawula ukuqondisa. Uma amasondo akho evaleka, yehlisa i-pedal yebhuleki. Bhaleka futhi kodwa hhayi kakhulu.

 Ukuze ubhuleke esimweni esiphuthumayo, landela lezi zinyathelo:
• Cindezela ngokuqinile i-pedal yebhuleki kuze kube seqophelweni ngaphambi nje kokuba amasondo avale. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi i-threshold braking.
• Uma amasondo evaleka, khulula i-pedal yebhuleki kancane ukuze uthole ukulawula ukuqondisa.
• Cindezela i-pedal yebhuleki ngokuqinile futhi ngaphandle kokukhiya amasondo.
• Bheka bese uqondisa ohlangothini ofuna ingaphambili lemoto liye kulo

Ubuso bomgwaqo, isivinini semoto yakho, ukujika, kanye nesimo samathayi akho kungabangela ukushelela. Ukushelela kusho ukuthi ulahlekelwe ukulawula imoto. Ukuze uphinde uyilawule, ungathinti ibhuleki noma i-accelerator. Bheka bese uqondisa lapho ufuna khona ingaphambili lemoto.

 Ukushelela okuningi kubangelwa iphutha lomshayeli. Ukushelela kungenzeka uma:
• ushayela ngokushesha kakhulu ezimweni ezimbi zomgwaqo njengeqhwa, iqhwa, imvula, udaka, isihlabathi, noma amatshe
• uphendula isondo lokuqondisa ngokucijile kakhulu
• uphendula isondo lokuqondisa kakhulu ngesivinini osihambayo
• ubhuleka ngokuqinile kakhulu
• usheshisa ngokushesha kakhulu.

 Ukuvuselelwa kokushelela

 Shayela ngendlela enciphisa amathuba okuba imoto yakho ishelele. Hlela kusengaphambili ukuze ungaphoqeleki ukushelela noma ukuqondisa ngokuzumayo. Ukushayela ngendlela ebushelelezi nelawulwayo kuzonciphisa amathuba okushelela. Uma umgwaqo ungawujwayele noma izimo zingahambi kahle, yehlisa ijubane lakho.

 Kubaluleke kakhulu ukugcina unyawo lwakho lungekho kwi-pedal yebhuleki uma uqala ukushelela. Indlela oshayela ngayo incike ekuqondeni kwe-skid. Bheka futhi uqondise ohlangothini ofuna ingaphambili lemoto liye kulo. Khomba amathayi maphakathi nomzila wakho futhi ungenzi ukulungiswa okukhulu kokuqondisa.

 I-Braking skid (engeyona i-ABS)

 Uma imoto yakho ingenayo i-ABS, i-braking skid ingenzeka uma usebenzisa amabhuleki akho ngokuqinile, okubangela ukuthi amasondo avale. Ukulawula ukuqondisa kuzolahleka. Uma uhlangabezana ne-braking skid, yenza okulandelayo:
• Susa unyawo lwakho kwi-brake pedal. Lapho amasondo emoto eqala ukugingqika, ukulawula ukuqondisa kuzobuya.
• Bheka futhi uqondise ohlangothini ofuna ingaphambili lemoto liye kulo.
• Uma udinga ukufaka amabhuleki futhi, sebenzisa umfutho oqinile kodwa hhayi oqinile ngokwanele ukukhiya amasondo.

 Ukusheshisa kwamandla (ukusheshisa)

 Ukusheshisa kwamandla kwenzeka uma usheshisa ngokushesha kakhulu, okubangela amasondo ukuba ajikeleze. Uma uzwa ukusheshisa kwamandla, yenza okulandelayo:
• Susa unyawo lwakho ephedalini likaphethiloli ukuze uvumele amasondo ukuthi ayeke ukuzungeza.
• Yenza noma yikuphi ukulungiswa kokuqondisa okudingekayo. Bheka futhi uqondise ohlangothini ofuna ingaphambili lemoto liye kulo.
• Qaphela ukuthi ungalungisi kakhulu isiteringi sakho noma ungase ushelele ohlangothini oluphambene.
• Sebenzisa ukusheshisa okuncane ukuze uqhubeke phambili.

 Ukusheshisa okugobile

 Ukushelela okugobile kwenzeka uma uhamba ngokushesha kakhulu lapho ujika, okwenza imoto ishelele eceleni. Isivinini, isimo sethayi, indawo yomgwaqo, kanye nokwehla komgwaqo konke kungadlala indima kulolu hlobo lokushelela. Uma uhlangabezana nokushelela okugobile, yenza okulandelayo:
• Susa unyawo lwakho ephedalini likaphethiloli. Ungasebenzisi amabhuleki akho.
• Bheka bese uqondisa ngakwesokunene semoto ofuna ukuthi ingaphambili liye kuso.

 Ukubuyiselwa emgwaqweni ongaphandle komgwaqo

 Uma ushayela usuka engxenyeni egandayiwe yomgwaqo, yenza okulandelayo:
• Gcina isiteringi siqinile.
• Ungazami ukubuyisela imoto emgwaqweni ngokushesha.
• Susa unyawo lwakho ephedalini likaphethiloli ukuze wehlise ijubane lakho.
• Zama ukugwema ukubhuleka. Uma udinga ukubhuleka, sebenzisa ukucindezela kancane kancane ephedalini likaphethiloli ukuze ugcine ukulawula.
• Hlola ukuthi imoto ishayela kahle yini ngaphambi kokuzama ukubuyisela imoto emgwaqweni.
• Ngejubane elilawulwayo, buyela emgwaqweni kancane kancane bese uqondisa imoto yakho ngendlela efanele yokuhamba.

 Umbhalo othathwe ezithombeni:
• Bheka bese uqondisa indlela ofuna ingaphambili lemoto liye ngayo. Qaphela indawo yamathayi angaphambili (ngombala obomvu).
• Ukubuyela kancane kancane emgwaqweni.

Kubalulekile ukugcina imoto yakho isebenza kahle. Uma imoto yakho iphuka ngenkathi ushayela, ingaba yingozi futhi ingahambi kahle.

 Uma imoto yakho inezinkinga zemishini ezidinga ukuthi ume, khumbula okulandelayo ukuze uphephe:
• Shintsha imizila ngokuphepha bese upaka endaweni ephephile, uma kungenzeka.
• Ungami ebhulohweni noma emhubheni. Lokhu kungaba yingozi kakhulu.
• Uma imoto ishiywe endaweni engaba yingozi, vula izibani zakho zengozi (ama-flashers amane).
• Phakamisa i-hood yakho.
• Phatha onxantathu abakhanyayo. Emgwaqweni omkhulu noma endaweni engaba yingozi, beka onxantathu abakhanyayo ngokuphephile ngemuva kwemoto yakho, cishe amamitha ayi-10 kuya kwangu-20 (33 kuya ku-66 izinyawo ) ahlukene.
• Ungazami ukulungisa eceleni komgwaqo emigwaqweni emikhulu egcwele abantu noma ehamba ngokushesha.
• Uma kuyisimo esingaba yingozi, cela bonke abagibeli baphume emotweni balinde endaweni ephephile ngemuva nakude nemoto, njengoba kuboniswe kumdwebo.

 Uma umshayeli ema ukuze anikeze usizo, ungabacela ukuba bacele usizo.

 Ukwehluleka kwamabhuleki

 Izimoto eziningi ziza nohlelo lwamabhuleki oluzokuvikela ekuhlulekeni kwamabhuleki akho ngokuphelele. Isibani sokuxwayisa kuphaneli yakho yezinsimbi sizokhanya uma kunenkinga. Kufanele sikhanye ngaphambi kokuba amabhuleki akho ayeke ukusebenza. Uma ubona isibani sokuxwayisa samabhuleki sikhanya, futhi usuhlolile ukuthi ibhuleki lokupaka selikhishiwe, hamba uye eceleni komgwaqo ngokushesha nje lapho kuphephile ukwenza kanjalo.

 Uma unemoto enamabhuleki anamandla, uhlelo lwamandla lungahluleka. Lokhu kungenzeka uma injini yakho ima ngenkathi usahamba. Uma imoto ingasheshi ngokucindezela okuvamile ebhulekini, cindezela i-pedal yamabhuleki kakhulu bese usebenzisa ukucindezela okuzinzile.

 Uma amabhuleki akho ehluleka, namasondo akho engaphendulwanga, sebenzisa ibhuleki lakho lokuma ngokucophelela ukuze unciphise imoto yakho. Ungase ukwazi ukushintsha uye egiya eliphansi ukuze imoto yakho ime ngokuphephile nangokulawulwayo. Hlola incwadi yemiyalelo yomnikazi wemoto yakho ukuze uthole ulwazi olwengeziwe.

 Paka imoto yakho endaweni ephephile. Ungashayeli kuze kube yilapho amabhuleki esehloliwe futhi elungisiwe kahle.

 Ukwehluleka kokuqondisa ngamandla

 Uma ukuqondisa ngamandla kwakho kwehluleka, usengakwazi ukuqondisa imoto. Kuzodingeka usebenzise umzamo owengeziwe ukuze uphendule isiteringi.

 Ukwehluleka kwamathayi

 Uma ithayi linomoya ovuzayo ongase uwuzwe, imoto iqala ukudonsa kanye nokudlidliza njengoba ubamba isiteringi. Uma ukuvuza komoya kungalungiswa maduze, ithayi lizoba buthakathaka. Uma ithayi langaphambili libuthakathaka, imoto izodonsa ngamandla ohlangothini olunethayi elibuthakathaka. Ithayi langemuva elibuthakathaka lingenza imoto yakho iluke. Ungase ukuthole kunzima ukuqondisa.

 Uma ithayi liphambuka ngenkathi ushayela:
• Melana nesifiso sokusebenzisa amabhuleki ngokushesha.
• Susa unyawo lwakho kuphedali yegesi bese uvumela injini ukuthi inciphise ijubane lemoto.
• Bamba isiteringi ngokubamba ngokuqinile. Gcina imoto iqonde ngokubheka nokuqondisa ngendlela ofuna ukuya ngayo.
• Uma imoto ilawulwa futhi ijubane linciphile, faka ibhuleki ngokucindezela okuthambile nokungaguquguquki.
• Yiya ngokuphephile endaweni yokuma ephuthumayo noma onqenqemeni lomgwaqo, bese upaka endaweni ephephile.
• Vula izibani zakho zokuxwayisa ngengozi.

 Ukwehluleka kwesibani sangaphambili

 Uma zombili izibani zangaphambili zingasebenzi:
• Vula izibani zakho zengozi.
• Cima futhi uvule isilawuli sesibani sangaphambili.
• Uma izibani zangaphambili zingakavulwa, yehlisa isivinini sakho, hamba ngokuphepha uye endaweni yokuma ephuthumayo noma onqenqemeni lomgwaqo, bese upaka endaweni ephephile.

 Qaphela: Shintsha isibani sangaphambili noma isibani sangaphambili ngokushesha nje lapho siphela. Ukushayela ngesibani sangaphambili esisodwa kuphela kwandisa ingozi yokuba ngaphandle kwezibani zombili

 Umbhalo ezithombeni:
• Ungalindi kule ndawo.
• Suka emotweni ngenkathi ulinde usizo.

Uma izimo zomgwaqo zimbi ngenxa yesimo sezulu esibi, vumela isikhathi esengeziwe sohambo lwakho. Khulisa ibanga lakho elilandelayo, wehlise isivinini sakho, futhi ulondoloze indawo yakho.

 Ukushayela ebusuku:

 Uma ushayela ebusuku noma nganoma yisiphi isikhathi lapho ungakwazi ukubona kahle amamitha angu-150 (500 izinyawo) phambi kwakho, kufanele uvule izibani zakho zangemuva. Izibani zokugijima zasemini azikhanyi ngokwanele ukuthi zisetshenziswe ebusuku, futhi izibani zangemuva nezibani zamaphaneli ezinsimbi ngeke zivulwe.

 • Sebenzisa izibani zakho zangemuva ezinemisebe ephansi uma kunezimoto ezingaphambili, noma ngabe umgwaqo omkhulu uhlukene.
• Qiniseka ukuthi izibani zakho zangemuva ziqondiswe kahle ukuze zingaphazamisi noma ziphazamise abanye abashayeli.
• Gcina izibani zakho zangemuva zihlanzekile.
• Gwema ukubheka ngqo izibani zangemuva ezingaphambili ukuze zingakuboni. Bheka phansi kancane nangakwesokudla komgwaqo wakho wokushayela

 Ukubonakala kuncipha ebusuku. Ungashayeli kakhulu izibani zakho zangaphambili. Hamba ngesivinini esikuvumela ukuthi uphendule ngokuphephile noma ume ibanga elikhanyiswa izibani zakho zangaphambili.

 Ukukhanya:

 Ukukhanya kwelanga, ukubonakaliswa, kanye nezibani zezinye izimoto kungathinta umbono wakho emini noma ebusuku. Uma ukukhanya kwenza kube nzima ukubona umgwaqo, yehlisa ijubane lakho. Qinisekisa ukuthi amafasitela emoto yakho ahlanzwe kahle ngaphakathi nangaphandle ukuze uthuthukise ukubonakala.

 Intuthu nenkungu:

 Sebenzisa izibani zangaphambili ezikhanyayo eziphansi entuthwini nasenkungu, njengoba izibane eziphakeme zibuyisela ukukhanya kuwe, zidale ukukhanya. Uma ukubonakala kuba kubi kangangokuthi akusaphephile ukuqhubeka nokushayela, yehlisa ijubane bese ususa imoto yakho emgwaqweni uye endaweni ephephile. Vula izibani zakho zokuxwayisa ngengozi. Ungazami ukushayela kuze kube yilapho izimo zithuthuka. Uma indawo ephephile yokupaka ingatholakali, qiniseka ukuthi wena nabagibeli bakho nithuthela endaweni ephephile kude nemoto uma kwenzeka ishayiswa.

 Izimo zomphezulu womgwaqo ezithinta ukubambelela

 Iqhwa elimnyama:

 Iqhwa elimnyama libangelwa ukubanda komswakama ebusweni bomgwaqo. Ngokuvamile umshayeli akakwazi ukulibona. Kodwa-ke, uma i-asphalt ibukeka icwebezela futhi imnyama esikhundleni sokuba ngwevu-mhlophe, qaphela, futhi wehlise ijubane lakho ngaphandle kokubhuleka.

 Izindawo ezinomthunzi:

 Izindawo ezinomthunzi zingase zibe neqhwa ngisho nangemva kokuba ilanga selincibilikisile iqhwa kwezinye izingxenye zomgwaqo.

 Amabhuloho nezindawo zokudlula:

 Ama-deck namabhuloho ezindawo zokudlula avame ukwakha ama-patches ashelelayo kalula kunezinye izindawo zomgwaqo. Qaphela kakhulu futhi uzame ukugwema ukushintsha komzila noma isivinini okungadingekile.

 Imvula kanye ne-hydroplaning:

 Uma lina, sebenzisa izibani zokukhanya eziphansi, njengoba imigqa ephezulu ibuyisela ukukhanya kuwe, idale ukukhanya. Imoto yakho ingafuthwa ngamanzi nodaka, okuphazamisa umbono wakho ngefasitela nasemafasiteleni. Qaphela ukuthi ungafafazi ezinye izimoto kanye nabahamba ngezinyawo.

 Emigwaqweni emanzi amathayi akho angase alahlekelwe ukuxhumana nomgwaqo. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi i-hydroplaning. Ukulahlekelwa ukuxhumana phakathi komgwaqo namathayi akho kungabangela ukuthi ulahlekelwe ukulawula imoto yakho. Uma lokhu kwenzeka, ungabhuleki. Khulula ingcindezi ku-accelerator ukuze uvumele imoto ukuthi ihambe kancane. Bheka futhi uqondise lapho ufuna khona ingaphambili lemoto.

 Iqhwa neqhwa:

 Ebusika ungabhekana nezimo zezulu ezimbi ezingenza ukushayela kube yingozi kakhulu. Izimo zasebusika zifaka phakathi imvula ebandayo, amazinga okushisa aphansi kakhulu, iqhwa elivunguzayo, ukubanda komoya okukhulu, iziphepho ezinkulu, kanye nokuwa kweqhwa okukhulu.

 Gcina imoto yakho. Yilungise ngaphambi kokuba kufike ubusika. Qiniseka ukuthi ibhethri lemoto yakho, amathayi, uhlelo lokukhipha umoya, ama-wiper e-windshield, kanye nohlelo lokushisa kusesimweni esihle sokusebenza.

 Izindawo zokuhlangana zingase zibe neqhwa ngokushesha ngenxa yokukhishwa kwegesi emotweni, ukushisa kwenjini, kanye nezimoto ezijikeleza amasondo azo noma ukushelela. Vumela isikhathi esengeziwe nebanga lokuma nokuqala. Into ebaluleke kakhulu ukunciphisa ijubane lakho.

 Lapho izinga lokushisa likhuphuka lize lifike lapho iqhwa liqala ukuncibilika khona, imigwaqo ingaba bushelelezi kakhulu. Lapho iqhwa liqala ukuphuma emhlabathini, kwakheka ungqimba oluncane lwamanzi phezu komgwaqo.

 Qaphela: Ungasebenzisi i-cruise control lapho isimo sezulu kanye nezimo zomgwaqo zimbi. Lapho amathayi akho ethinta iqhwa, i-cruise control izoqhubeka nokusebenzisa i-accelerator futhi ungalahlekelwa yi-control.

 Qinisekisa ukuthi amafasitela ne-windscreen yemoto yakho akuvinjelwa yiqhwa, iqhwa, umusi, udaka, noma yini enye engenza ukushayela kube yingozi.

 Uma uzithola uvaleleke emgwaqweni omkhulu futhi imoto yakho isendaweni ephephile, ngokuvamile kuphephile ukuhlala nemoto yakho. Sebenzisa injini ngokwanele ukuze uhlale ufudumele. Gcina imoto inomoya ngenkathi injini isebenza. Vula ifasitela kancane ukuze usize ukugeleza komoya ukuze uvimbele ubuthi be-carbon monoxide.

 I-Carbon monoxide ingangena emotweni yakho isuka ohlelweni lokukhipha umoya oluvuzayo. I-Carbon monoxide iyigesi enobuthi eyingozi kakhulu njengoba ingenambala, ayinaphunga, futhi ayinambitheki. Qiniseka ukuthi uhlelo lwakho lokukhipha umoya luyahlolwa noma nini lapho uyisa imoto yakho ukuze ilungiswe.

 Izinto eziphuthumayo zasebusika okufanele uziphathe emotweni yakho:
• izingubo zokulala nezingubo ezengeziwe
• isihlabathi noma usawoti womgwaqo
• ifosholo
• umthombo wokushisa, ikhandlela, umentshisi, kanye nethini elijulile lokubamba ikhandlela
• i-ice scraper kanye nebhulashi leqhwa
• izintambo zamathayi.

 Umbhalo ezithombeni:
• Uma ushayela ebusuku.
• Ngaphakathi kwamamitha ayi-15.
• Sebenzisa izibani zakho zokukhanyisa ezikhanyayo uma ulandela ngaphakathi kwamamitha angu-150 (ibhulokhi yedolobha elilodwa nengxenye) ukusuka kwenye imoto.
• Ubuncane bamamitha angu-300.
• Sebenzisa izibani zakho zokukhanyisa ezikhanyayo uma ungaphakathi kwamamitha angu-300 ukusuka ezimotweni ezizayo.

Cabanga ukuba nezinto ezilandelayo eziphuthumayo emotweni yakho ngaso sonke isikhathi:
• ikhithi yosizo lokuqala
• amadivayisi okuxwayisa avunyiwe njengonxantathu abakhanyayo
• izintambo zokuqinisa
• ukudla okungaboli
• i-jack kanye nethayi eliyisipele elivuvukele
• ithoshi elinamabhethri engeziwe
• intambo yokudonsa
• amabhalbhu okufaka isibani sangaphambili.

Ukuze unciphise amathuba okushayisana nesilwane, yenza okulandelayo:
• Yehlisa ijubane lakho, bheka phambili, futhi uqaphele ezindaweni ezinezimpawu zokuxwayisa izilwane zasendle.
• Skena izinhlangothi zomgwaqo ukuze ubone izilwane.
• Qaphela lapho kuhwalala futhi kusa njengoba izilwane zivame ukuba matasa kakhulu ngalezi zikhathi.
• Qaphela izindawo ezingavamile zokukhanya emgwaqweni noma eduze komgwaqo ebusuku. Lokhu kungaba ukubonakaliswa kwezibani zakho zangaphambili emehlweni esilwane.
• Ngezinye izikhathi izilwane zihamba ngamaqembu. Uma ubona isilwane esisodwa, kungase kube nezinye.

 Uma isilwane sivele phambi kwakho ngokuzumayo, bhukha ngamandla bese ulungiselela ukuthatha isinyathelo sokugwema. Khetha indlela yokubaleka kude nezimoto ezizayo.

Uma ungumuntu wokuqala endaweni yengozi, yeka ukushayisana endaweni ephephile. Nikeza usizo uma kungenzeka, futhi uvikele indawo yengozi ngezibani eziyingozi ezikhanyayo kanye nonxantathu abakhanyayo ukuze ezinye izimoto zingabandakanyeki.

 Uma kudingeka ukwazisa amaphoyisa noma izinsizakalo zezokwelapha eziphuthumayo, qinisekisa ngangokunokwenzeka, ikakhulukazi ngesimo sanoma yibaphi abantu abalimele nendawo yengozi.

 Uma uhilelekile engozini:
• Nikeza usizo lapho ungakwazi khona, uvikele indawo yengozi, futhi wazise usizo oluphuthumayo uma kudingeka.
• Shintshana ngamagama, ulwazi lokuxhumana, kanye nemininingwane yomshuwalense nabanye abashayeli abathintekayo.
• Bhala amagama nolwazi lokuxhumana lwabo bonke ofakazi.
• Ungaxoxi ngokuthi ubani obenephutha.
• Bhala phansi isikhathi, indawo, isimo sezulu, kanye nanoma yimiphi eminye imininingwane engabaluleka.
• Yazisa inkampani yakho yomshuwalense ngokushesha okukhulu.

 Kudingeka ubike zonke izingozi emaphoyiseni noma emaphoyiseni endawo uma:
• kukhona olimele
• kukhona oshonile
• umonakalo ophelele udlula u-$5000 (bheka i-alberta.ca/automobile-collisions-insurance ukuqinisekisa umkhawulo wamanje wengozi yengozi yempahla (PDC))
 • noma yimuphi umonakalo owenziwe kunoma iyiphi idivayisi yokulawula ithrafikhi, imitha yokupaka, noma impahla yomphakathi.

 Uma amaphoyisa ebizelwa endaweni yesehlakalo, bonke abashayeli kumele bahlale.

description:
Uma ushayela ungase uhlangane nezigameko ezibangela ukuvalwa kwemizila noma imizila emincane. Lezi zigameko zingafaka izingozi zomgwaqo, izimoto ezikhubazekile, imithwalo echithekile, kanye nokulungiswa noma ukwakhiwa komgwaqo omkhulu.

 Uma ubona izibani ezikhanyayo ezivela ezimotweni zezimo eziphuthumayo noma izisebenzi zaseceleni komgwaqo ezifana namaloli okudonsa, ama-snowplow, noma izimoto zokulungisa umgwaqo omkhulu, kusho ukuthi kukhona isimo esingaphambili esidinga ukunakwa kwakho nokuqapha. Landela iziqondiso ezinikezwa abasebenzi bezimo eziphuthumayo abaqondisa ithrafikhi. Qaphela ukuthi imoto ephambi kwakho ingase ime noma yehlise isivinini ngokungazelelwe ukuze ubuke indawo yesehlakalo.

 Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu ezihambisana nalezi zinhlobo zezigameko ingozi yokuthi abasebenzi bezokusabela noma imishini ishayiswe yizimoto ezidlulayo.

 Izinsizakalo ezivame ukuphendula ezigamekweni zomgwaqo omkhulu zifaka:
• abomthetho
• i-ambulensi
• umlilo
• ukudonsa.

 Abashayeli bezimoto kumele banciphise isivinini sibe ngu-60 km/h noma isivinini esibekiwe, noma ngabe singaphansi, lapho bedlula izimoto eziphuthumayo noma amaloli okudonsa amiswa nezibani zawo zikhanya. Lo mthetho usebenza emizileni eseduze nezimoto ezimisiwe. Inhlawulo yokuhamba ngesivinini kulezi zindawo iphindwe kabili.

 Uma ungekho emzileni eduze kwezimoto ezimisiwe, kusadingeka uqaphele futhi uqaphele. Nciphisa isivinini sakho futhi ushiye isikhala esiningi phakathi kwakho nabasebenzi bezimo eziphuthumayo kanye nemishini endaweni yesehlakalo. Futhi, qaphela ukunyakaza kwabasebenzi endaweni yesehlakalo

 Umbhalo esithombeni:
• Yehlisa ijubane bese udlula.
• Ubuningi obungu-60.
• Ezimotweni ezimisiwe ezinezibani ezikhanyayo.

Uma imoto yezimo eziphuthumayo ye-ambulensi, yomlilo, noma yamaphoyisa isondela kunoma iyiphi indlela futhi ikhala i-siren, kufanele uyiyeke indlela efanele:
• Hambisa imoto yakho ngokuphephile ukuze imoto yezimo eziphuthumayo idlule.
• Shayela eduze ngangokunokwenzeka uye onqenqemeni lwesokudla noma onqenqemeni lomgwaqo onezindlela ezimbili.
• Hamba ngakwesokudla noma kwesobunxele uye onqenqemeni oluseduze emigwaqweni enezindlela eyodwa.
• Yima kuze kube yilapho imoto yezimo eziphuthumayo idlula.

 Hlola ukuthi azikho ezinye izimoto zezimo eziphuthumayo ezisondelayo.

 Uma ubona imoto enezibani eziluhlaza ezikhanyayo, yiphathe njenganoma iyiphi enye imoto yezimo eziphuthumayo. Kwamanye omasipala, abacimi bomlilo abazithandelayo basebenzisa izibani eziluhlaza ezikhanyayo ezimotweni zabo zokusabela eziphuthumayo lapho besabela emlilweni noma kwezinye izimo eziphuthumayo.

 Umbhalo esithombeni:
• Iseduze kakhulu.
• I-ambulensi.
• Hamba uye ume.
• Hlala uvumela izimoto zezimo eziphuthumayo ezine-siren noma izibani ezisebenzayo. Gcina ibanga eliphephile lokulandela okungenani amamitha angu-150 (500 amamitha).

Izimoto zokulungisa nokwakha imigwaqo zingasetshenziswa noma zipakwe kunoma iyiphi ingxenye yomgwaqo. Uzonikezwa isixwayiso esanele ngaphambi kwemoto enjalo. Kudingeka ukuthi ulalele wonke amadivayisi okulawula ithrafikhi kanye neziqondiso zabantu abaphethe ifulegi.

 Izimpawu zizobekwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi eside indawo yokwakha ekuxwayisa ngokunciphisa umzila, ukuvalwa komzila, noma abasebenzi abazayo. Ezindaweni zokwakha, abashayeli bezimoto kumele baqaphele isivinini esibekiwe futhi balalele umuntu ophethe ifulegi. Uma abasebenzi bekhona, izinhlawulo zokuhamba ngesivinini esikhulu kulezi zindawo zizophindwa kabili.

 Ukumisa imoto yakho ngokuphepha ngenxa yamaphoyisa

 Uma iphoyisa lingemuva kwakho, nezibani eziphuthumayo zikhanya, kudingeka ukuthi uye endaweni ephephile ukuze uvumele imoto yamaphoyisa ukuthi idlule noma ume ngokuphephile ngemuva kwemoto yakho.

 Emgwaqweni onezindlela ezimbili, misa imoto yakho ngokucophelela nangokomthetho endaweni ephephile emaphethelweni kwesokudla komgwaqo. Emgwaqweni onendlela eyodwa, misa imoto yakho ngokucophelela nangokomthetho endaweni ephephile emaphethelweni aseduze komgwaqo. Njalo qiniseka ukuthi kunendawo eyanele yokuthi imoto yamaphoyisa ime ngokuphepha ngemuva kwemoto yakho.

 Uma imoto yamaphoyisa ima ngemuva kwemoto yakho, ukuze uqinisekise ukuphepha kwakho, ukuphepha kwabagibeli bakho, kanye nokuphepha kwamaphoyisa, yenza okulandelayo:
1 Hlala uzolile. Ngemva kokumisa imoto yakho, qiniseka ukuthi i-transmission yakho isegiya le-PARK (i-automatic transmission) noma i-NEUTRAL gear (i-manual transmission). Faka ibhuleki le-park.
2 Hlala emotweni yakho. Thola futhi ulungele ukunikeza ilayisensi yakho yokushayela, ukubhaliswa kwemoto, kanye nomshwalense wemoto.
3 Lindela imiyalelo evela ephoyiseni lapho isondela emotweni yakho. Bambisana. Nikeza amadokhumenti acelwe yiphoyisa.
4 UNGAYITHUTHI imoto yakho kuze kube yilapho uyalelwa yiphoyisa.

 Umbhalo ezithombeni:
• Inhlawulo yesivinini iphindwe kabili uma abasebenzi bekhona.
• abantu abasebenza.
• Lalela umuntu ophethe ifulegi.
• Ukuphela komzila kuyancipha noma kuyancipha.

Ukushayela okusebenzayo kuwukushayela ngenhloso yokubona kusengaphambili izingozi ezingaba khona bese uthatha isinyathelo sokunciphisa, ukunciphisa, noma ukugwema ingozi ngaphambi kokuba yenzeke. Ungalokothi ucabange ukuthi abanye abashayeli bazoshayela ngokucophelela noma baphendule ngendlela efanele. Ukulindela okungenzeka kungakusiza ugweme ukushayisana okubangelwa amaphutha okushayela abanye. Lesi sahluko sichaza amakhono namasu okushayela ngokuzikhandla.

 Skena yonke indawo emotweni yakho

 Ukunaka kwakho okukhulu kufanele kunikezwe ekubhekeni phambili nasekuhloleni izingozi ezithuthukayo phambi kwakho. Uma ushayela endaweni yasemadolobheni, bheka okungenani imizuzwana eyi-12 kuya kweyi-15 ngaphambi kwemoto yakho. Lokhu kungaba yibhulokhi elilodwa kuya kweyodwa nengxenye. Uma ushayela ezindaweni zasemakhaya, bheka okungenani imizuzwana engama-20 kuya kwengama-25 ngaphambi kwemoto yakho. Lesi yisikhathi sakho sokubuka, esikunikeza isikhathi sokuphendula ezingozini eziphambi kwakho.

 Hlola ngemuva kwakho ngokubheka ezibukweni zakho ezingemuva njalo ngemizuzwana eyisishiyagalombili kuya kweyi-12 (cishe ibhulokhi ngalinye endaweni yasemadolobheni). Bheka ezibukweni zakho ezingemuva uma ulindele ukwehlisa noma ukuma. Qaphela izimoto ezinhlangothini zombili nasezindaweni ongaziboni. Ungakhohlwa ukubheka i-speedometer yakho ukuze uhlole isivinini sakho

 Qaphela izingozi ezingaba khona

 Ukushayela okusebenzayo kuhilela inqubo eqhubekayo yokubuka indawo okuzungezile nokucabanga ngokuthi izingozi ziyavela yini, bese uthatha isinyathelo sokunciphisa izingozi. Qaphela izingozi ezizinzile (lezo ezingashintshi) kanye nezingozi eziguquguqukayo (lezo ezishintshayo).

 Izingozi ezizinzile yizimo nezimo ezihlala njalo emgwaqweni, okuhlanganisa:
• izindawo zokubona ezivinjelwe njengemigoqo, amagquma, kanye nemigwaqo efihliwe
• izindawo zokuhlangana
• ukuhlanganisa imigwaqo.

 Izingozi eziguquguqukayo ziyashintsha phakathi nosuku, okuhlanganisa:
• izingane zesikole nabanye abahamba ngezinyawo
• izimoto ezijika kwesobunxele
• izindawo zomgwaqo ezineqhwa
• izibani eziluhlaza “ezidala”
• izimoto eziphuthumayo.

 Lungela ukuthatha isinyathelo ukuze ugweme inkinga njengoba isimo sishintsha. Lindela okungalindelekile futhi njalo uhlele indlela yokubaleka.

 Yiba nomcamelo wesikhala

 Shiya isikhala esanele phakathi kwakho nezimoto ezingaphambili, ngemuva, nakuzo zombili izinhlangothi, ukuze ume ngokuphephile noma ushayele eduze kwengozi engaba khona. Uma othile elandela eduze kakhulu, futhi uma kuphephile, yehlisa isivinini sakho ngokwanele ukumkhuthaza ukuba adlule. Uma umuntu engadluli, dala umcamelo wesikhala obanzi phakathi kwakho nemoto engaphambili.

 Uma umisa ngemuva kwenye imoto emgwaqweni, shiya isikhala esanele ukuze ukwazi ukuhambisa imoto yakho uye komunye umzila ngaphandle kokubuyela emuva. Isikhala esengeziwe sinciphisa ingozi yokushayisa imoto engaphambili uma ushayiswa ngemuva. Lokhu futhi kukuvumela ukuthi usuke endleleni yemoto engase ishelele noma ishelele eqhweni ngemuva kwakho.

 Hlela kusengaphambili

 Hlela indlela yakho yokuhamba ngaphambi kokuba uqale uhambo, futhi uyikhumbule njengoba ushayela. Qiniseka ukuthi usemzileni ofanele kusenesikhathi ngaphambi kokuphuma noma indawo yokujika. Lokhu kuzokusiza ukugwema ukwenza izinguquko zomzila ezisheshayo neziyingozi. Uma uphuthelwa indlela yakho yokuphuma noma yokujika, qhubeka uye endaweni yokuphuma noma yokuhlangana elandelayo. Ungalokothi ushayele imoto yakho emuva emgwaqweni ukuze ubuyele endleleni yokuphuma noma yokujika ephuthelwe. Sebenzisa izibani zakho zesignali ukuze wazise abanye abashayeli ukuthi uhlose ukwenzani.

 Ukugwema ukushayisana

 Qaphela umgwaqo ongaphambili futhi uhlale uqaphile. Qaphela noma yiziphi izinkinga ezingaba khona. Uma kufanele ujike ngokucijile ukuze ugweme okuthile emzileni wakho, hlala ohlangothini lwakho lomugqa ophuzi uma kungenzeka. Ungafunda kabanzi ngokushayela okusebenzayo nokugwema ukushayisana ngokuthatha isifundo semfundo yokushayela esivunyiwe. Izifundo Zokushayela Ezivikelayo ziyatholakala kulo lonke isifundazwe ezivela ezikoleni zokuqeqesha abashayeli ezinelayisensi kanye nezinhlangano ezigunyaziwe.

 Gcina isikhathi sakho esilandelayo kanye nebanga

 Ngaphansi kwezimo zomgwaqo nezimo zezulu ezijwayelekile kufanele ushayele okungenani imizuzwana emibili ngemuva kwemoto engaphambili. Uma izimo zingahambi kahle, yandisa ibanga lakho lokulandela. Ukuze wazi ukuthi ungemuva kwemoto ephambi kwakho ngemizuzwana emibili, uma idlula izinto ezihleliwe njengophawu lomgwaqo noma isithunzi emgwaqweni, qala ukubala. Bala inkulungwane eyodwa nenye, inkulungwane eyodwa nembili. Uma ingaphambili lemoto yakho lifika entweni ngaphambi kokuba uqede ukubala, ulandela eduze kakhulu. Nciphisa ijubane lakho bese ubala futhi. Umthetho wesibili usebenza nganoma yisiphi isivinini. Okuhlukile kulo mthetho kubashayeli bezimoto ezinkulu, njengezimoto. Kunconywa ukuthi usebenzise ibanga elilandela okungenani imizuzwana emine.

 Omakhalekhukhwini nezinye iziphazamiso

 Ungasebenzisi ifoni yeselula noma amanye amadivayisi kagesi ngenkathi ushayela. Ukusebenzisa ifoni yeselula ukwenza noma ukuthola ucingo, noma ukuthola noma ukuthumela umlayezo wombhalo, kuyisiphazamiso esingasusa ukunaka kwakho emsebenzini onzima wokushayela. Lokhu kusebenza nasezingcingweni zeselula ezingenazandla. Uma ufuna ukwenza noma ukuthola ucingo, noma ukuthola noma ukuthumela umlayezo wombhalo, yima endaweni ephephile nesemthethweni.

 Ungazibandakanyi emisebenzini ekuvumela ukuthi uphazamiseke ngenkathi ushayela. Nakuba zonke izinhlobo zokushayela okuphazamisekile zingaba yingozi, uMthetho Wokuphepha Kwethrafikhi uhlanganisa izinhlawulo kanye nezinzuzo ezintathu zeziphazamiso ezithile. Lokhu kufaka phakathi:
• ukusebenzisa ifoni ephathekayo
• ukuthumela imiyalezo noma i-imeyili
• ukusebenzisa amadivayisi kagesi, njengamakhompyutha aphathekayo, imidlalo yevidiyo, amakhamera, kanye nezibonisi zokuzijabulisa zevidiyo
• ukuhlela izidlali zomsindo eziphathwayo
• ukufaka ulwazi kumayunithi e-GPS
• ukufunda izinto ezinyathelisiwe emotweni
• ukubhala, ukuphrinta, noma ukudweba
• ukuzilungisa.

 Umbhalo ezithombeni:
• imizuzwana emi-2.
• Gcina ibanga okungenani lemizuzwana emibili uma ulandela enye imoto.

E-Alberta, bonke abashayeli nabagibeli kumele baboshwe kahle emotweni ngebhande lesihlalo noma isihlalo sokuphepha sengane esivunyiwe esinamathiselwe ngebhande lesihlalo noma uhlelo lwe-anchor.

 Abagibeli abaneminyaka engu-16 nangaphezulu abangaboshwa kahle emotweni bangahlawuliswa. Njengomshayeli, unesibopho sokuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abagibeli emotweni yakho abangaphansi kweminyaka engu-16 ubudala baboshwe kahle. Ungahlawuliswa uma bengaboshwa kahle.

 Izihlalo zokuphepha zengane

 Ingane engaphansi kweminyaka eyisithupha futhi engasindi ngaphezu kuka-18 amakhilogremu (40 amakhilogremu ) kumele iboshwe kahle esihlalweni sokuphepha sengane. Isihlalo sokuphepha sengane kumele sifakwe emotweni ngokwemiyalelo yomenzi wemoto kanye nesihlalo sokuphepha sengane.

 Zonke izihlalo zokuphepha zezingane ezisetshenziswa eCanada kumele zibe nelebula kuzo elisho ukuthi umkhiqizo uhlangabezana ne-Canada Motor Vehicle Safety Standard 213. Ungasebenzisi isihlalo sokuphepha sengane ngaphandle kokuthi sinale lebula. Ungasebenzisi isihlalo sokuphepha sengane esenzelwe ukusetshenziswa kwamanye amazwe ngaphandle kweCanada.

 Kunezinhlobo ezahlukene zezihlalo zokuphepha zengane ezitholakalayo. Khetha esilungele ubudala noma isisindo sengane yakho.

 Izihlalo zokuphepha ezibheke ngemuva:

 Kusukela ekuzalweni, zonke izingane kumele zigibele isihlalo sengane esibheke ngemuva noma isihlalo esiguqulwayo esibheke ngemuva kuze kube yilapho zifinyelela isisindo esinconywayo ukuze zishintshele esihlalweni sokuphepha esibheke phambili, ngokwemiyalelo yomenzi.

 Zonke izimoto ezintsha nezihlalo zokuphepha zezingane ziza zihlonyiswe ngohlelo lwe-anchor olujwayelekile noma i-UAS/LATCH. Ezimotweni ezindala, isihlalo sokuphepha sengane kumele siboshwe kahle emotweni kusetshenziswa ibhande lesihlalo. Hlola izincwadi zemiyalelo zemoto yakho kanye nesihlalo sokuphepha sengane ukuze uthole ulwazi olwengeziwe.

 Izihlalo zokuphepha ezibheke phambili:

 Izihlalo zokuphepha zezingane ezibheke phambili zenzelwe izingane ezineminyaka engu-10 kuya ku-18 amakhilogremu (22 kuya ku-40 amakhilogremu ). Zonke izimoto ezintsha nezihlalo zokuphepha zezingane zihlonyiswe ngohlelo lwe-anchor olujwayelekile noma i-UAS/LATCH. Ezimotweni ezindala, isihlalo esibheke phambili kumele siboshwe kahle ngokusebenzisa ibhande lesihlalo semoto. Ibhande lokubopha lesihlalo sengane kanye ne-anchor yokubopha imoto kumele kusetshenziswe. (Kungase kudingeke ukuthi umthengisi wakho wemoto afake i-anchor yokubopha.) Hlola amabhukwana emiyalelo yesihlalo semoto nesengane ukuze uthole ulwazi olwengeziwe.

 Izihlalo ze-Booster

 Izingane ezinesisindo esingaphezu kuka-18 amakhilogremu (40 amakhilogremu ) kufanele ziboshwe esihlalweni se-booster esivunyiwe ngaphambi kokusebenzisa ibhande lesihlalo semoto kuphela ngaphandle kwesihlalo se-booster. Isihlalo kumele sisetshenziswe ngokwemiyalelo yomenzi.

description:
Ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kahle kukaphethiloli

 Abashayeli abaningi banganciphisa kakhulu inani likaphethiloli elisetshenziswayo ngokusebenzisa imikhuba yokushayela eyisisekelo elandelayo.

 Lapho uthenga imoto, cabanga ngamamodeli asebenzisa uphethiloli ngendlela engabizi kakhulu. Ngokuvamile, uma injini incane, kuzoncipha uphethiloli. Lapho uthenga imoto entsha, bheka ilebula layo le-EnerGuide. Lokhu kukhomba ukusetshenziswa kukaphethiloli wemoto ngokwamalitha asetshenziswa kuwo wonke amakhilomitha ayi-100 aqhutshwayo (amalitha/100 km), kanye nezindleko zikaphethiloli ezilinganiselwa ngonyaka.

 Ukuhamba ngesivinini esiphezulu kwandisa ukusetshenziswa kukaphethiloli. Njalo nge-10 km/h ngaphezu kwe-90 km/h kushisa uphethiloli ongaphezulu ngamaphesenti ayi-10.

 Gwema ukusheshisa okusheshayo. Kuphephile futhi konga uphethiloli ukwandisa isivinini sakho kancane kancane. Kangangokunokwenzeka, gcina isivinini esizinzile. Ukusheshisa okusheshayo kanye nokushintsha kwesivinini kungakhuphula ukusetshenziswa kukaphethiloli ngamaphesenti angama-40. Ukulawula ukuhamba ngesikebhe kungasiza ukugcina isivinini esizinzile esisebenzisa uphethiloli emgwaqweni omkhulu.

 Uku-Idling kuchitha uphethiloli. Imizuzwana eyishumi yoku-Idling ingadla uphethiloli omningi kunokucisha injini yakho bese uyiqala kabusha. Uma upaka imizuzwana engaphezu kweyi-10, cisha injini yakho. Njalo ngemizuzu eyi-10 yoku-Idling, imoto ejwayelekile isebenzisa cishe ingxenye yesithathu yelitha likaphethiloli. Imoto enenjini enkulu ingasebenzisa kufika kuhhafu yelitha.

 Uku-Idling injini yakho akuyona indlela engcono kakhulu yokufudumeza imoto yakho ebusika. Uku-Idling kufudumeza injini futhi mhlawumbe ingaphakathi lemoto, kodwa akufudumezi izingxenye zemoto ezifana namathayi, isiteringi, nezinye izingxenye ezihambayo. Lezi zingxenye zemoto yakho zifudumeza kuphela ngokushayela. Ngokusho kwe-Natural Resources Canada, umzuzu owodwa woku-Idling ngosuku olubandayo lwasebusika wanele.

 Sebenzisa i-block heater ebusika ukufudumeza uwoyela wenjini nokwenza kube lula ukuqala ukubanda enjinini yakho. Sebenzisa i-timer ukuvula i-block heater amahora amabili ngaphambi kokuthi uhlele ukushayela. Ukusebenzisa kahle i-block heater kungathuthukisa ukonga uphethiloli wemoto yakho ngamaphesenti afinyelela ku-10. Ungashiyi i-block heater yakho ivuliwe ubusuku bonke ngoba ukonga kwakho amandla kuzonyamalala ngezindleko zikagesi eziphezulu.

 Iziqalisi zezimoto ezikude ziwusizo ekuseni okubandayo, kodwa ungayiqali imoto yakho kusenesikhathi.

 Yenza ukuhlolwa kokulungiswa njalo ngumakhenika oqeqeshiwe. Imoto enakekelwa kahle izosebenzisa kahle uphethiloli futhi iphephe:
• Injini engalungiswanga kahle ingandisa ukusetshenziswa kukaphethiloli ngamaphesenti afinyelela ku-50.
• Isihlungi somoya esivalekile singanciphisa ukusebenza kahle kukaphethiloli ngamaphesenti ayi-10.
• Amathayi angakhuphuki kahle andisa ukusetshenziswa kukaphethiloli ngamaphesenti amahlanu, kanye nokwandisa ukuguguleka kwamathayi nokunciphisa ukubamba.

 Ukuze uthole ukonga uphethiloli okuphezulu emotweni ene-gearbox ephathwayo, shintsha amagiya aphansi ngokushelela nangokushesha. Yakha isivinini kumagiya aphezulu. I-automatic transmission ishintsha iye egiya eliphezulu kusenesikhathi uma wehlisa ingcindezi ku-pedal yegesi njengoba ukhulisa isivinini.

 Ungathuthukisa ukusebenza kahle kukaphethiloli wakho ehlobo ngokunciphisa ukusebenzisa kwakho i-air conditioner. Ama-air conditioner asetshenziswa ezimotweni zokuma nokuhamba angandisa ukusetshenziswa kukaphethiloli ngamaphesenti ayi-10 kuya kwangu-25. Ngesivinini somgwaqo omkhulu, i-air conditioner inyusa ukusetshenziswa kukaphethiloli ngamaphesenti amathathu kuya kwamane. Ukuze uhlale upholile ngesivinini somgwaqo omkhulu, sebenzisa ukuhamba kwemoto yakho ngokungenisa umoya. Uma ushayela edolobheni, vula ifasitela.

 Isisindo esengeziwe sisho ukusebenzisa uphethiloli owengeziwe. Amasaka amakhulu esihlabathi nosawoti ebhuthini kuzosiza ukudonsa ukushayela ebusika, kodwa kufanele kususwe uma kungasadingeki.

 Ukuhlela uhambo kungakulondolozela isikhathi, imali, kanye nophethiloli. Gwema imizila eminyene yethrafikhi. Hlanganisa imisebenzi eminingana ohambweni olulodwa olude futhi ugweme ithrafikhi yamahora okushesha uma kungenzeka.

 Ukuphepha kokufaka uphethiloli

 Ukufaka uphethiloli emotweni kufanele kuthole ukunakwa kwakho okugcwele:
• Ungabhemi, ukhanyise umentshisi, noma usebenzise isibani lapho ufaka uphethiloli emotweni yakho. Umhwamuko kaphethiloli uhlangana nomoya, oqukethe umoya-mpilo. Uma ufaka umthombo wokushisa njengogwayi noma umentshisi, kungenzeka umlilo noma ukuqhuma.
• Ungasebenzisi ifoni ephathekayo ngenkathi ufaka uphethiloli. Izingcingo ezikhanya lapho zivuliwe noma lapho zikhala zingase zibe namandla anele okunikeza inhlansi. Inhlansi ingavuthela umhwamuko kaphethiloli.
• Cima ukuvuthela imoto yakho ngaphambi kokufaka uphethiloli.
• Uma unemoto yokuzijabulisa (i-RV) noma i-trailer, qiniseka ukuthi noma yiziphi izibani zomshayeli zicinyiwe. Lokhu kunganikeza umthombo wokuvuthela.
• Yazisa isisebenzi sesiteshi uma kukhona ukuchitheka kukaphethiloli.
• Ungavumeli izingane ziphathe i-nozzle kaphethiloli. Ungabeki ingane yakho engcupheni yokufafazwa ngophethiloli noma ukuhogela intuthu.
• Ungalokothi uphakamise isibambo se-nozzle kaphethiloli ngento ethile. Lokhu kwandisa kakhulu amathuba okuchitheka.
• Hlala eduze kwesibambo se-nozzle ngesikhathi ufaka uphethiloli. Ugesi ongaguquki ungakhiqizwa njengoba uhambahamba noma ungena futhi uphuma emotweni yakho. Uma ubuyela epompo bese uthinta isibambo se-nozzle, ugesi ongaguquki ungakhishwa. Lokhu kungavuthisa umusi kaphethiloli futhi kubangele umlilo noma ukuqhuma.
• Ungagcwalisi kakhulu ithangi lakho. Ukuchichima kanye nokuchitheka kungathinta imvelo.
• Uma ugcwalisa izitsha ezengeziwe, njengezitsha zegesi zomshini wakho wokugunda utshani noma umshini wokufutha iqhwa, zisuse emotweni yakho uzibeke phansi. Lokhu kuzovumela ugesi ongaguquki ukuthi ukhiphe futhi kugcine ukuchitheka kungaphandle kwemoto yakho.

Eminye imithetho yomgwaqo okufanele bonke abashayeli bayiqaphele ifaka phakathi okulandelayo:
• Ungasebenzisi imoto yakho ukudonsa noma ubani, isibonelo, umuntu ogibele ama-ski, ogibele i-toboggan, isithuthuthu, noma ibhayisikili.
• Kuphambene nomthetho ukuvumela umuntu agibele i-trailer lapho idonswa.
• Abantu abangaphansi kweminyaka eyi-14 abakwazi ukusebenzisa i-tractor noma yimuphi umshini wepulazi oziqhubayo emgwaqweni omkhulu.
• Uma umbono ovela esibukweni sakho sangemuva uvaliwe, kufanele unamathisele isibuko sangemuva sangaphandle ohlangothini ngalunye lwemoto.
• Uma umthwalo wemoto udlula imitha elilodwa nesigamu (amafidi amahlanu ) noma ngaphezulu ngaphezu kwengemuva lemoto, okulandelayo kuyadingeka:
· Ngesikhathi sasemini, ifulegi elibomvu kufanele linamathiselwe ekugcineni kwesandiso noma umthwalo. Ifulegi kumele libe okungenani amasentimitha angu-30 (ifidi elilodwa) ubude kuzo zonke izinhlangothi ezine zesikwele.
· Ebusuku, isibani esibomvu kumele sinamathiselwe ekugcineni kwesandiso noma umthwalo.
• Endaweni yokuhlala, akumelwe usebenzise imoto ngendlela ephazamisa izakhamuzi phakathi kwamahora angu-10 ebusuku no-7 ekuseni.
• Uma ushayela imoto emgwaqweni ngaphandle kokunakekelwa nokunakwa, noma ngaphandle kokucabangela abanye abasebenzisa umgwaqo, ungatholakala unecala lokushayela ngokunganaki.
• Akukho emthethweni ukusebenzisa imoto yakho usebenzisa imizila emibili emgwaqweni omkhulu, ngaphandle uma izimo zibangela ukuthi ukusetshenziswa komzila owodwa kungasebenzi.
• Uma ushayela, akumelwe uvumele noma ubani ukuba agibele ngaphandle kwemoto yakho. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ibhokisi elivulekile leloli lokuthutha. Wena nomunye umuntu ningabekwa icala ngaleli cala.

Abahamba ngezinyawo, abagibeli bamabhayisikili, kanye nabagibeli bezithuthuthu nabo babelana ngemigwaqo nabo bonke abaqhubi bezimoto nsuku zonke. Laba basebenzisi bomgwaqo banesivikelo esincane kunabashayeli bezinye izinhlobo zezimoto. Qaphela lapho usebenzisa imoto yakho eduze kwabahamba ngezinyawo, abagibeli bamabhayisikili, kanye nabagibeli bezithuthuthu.

 Ukuphepha kwabahamba ngezinyawo

 Uma ubona isibani sethrafikhi esikhanyayo esisebenza ngabahamba ngezinyawo, sehlise ijubane siye kumakhilomitha angu-30 ngehora bese uvumela abahamba ngezinyawo abafuna ukuwela umgwaqo.

 • Endaweni yasemadolobheni, abahamba ngezinyawo bangabonisa ukuthi bahlose ukuwela umgwaqo ngokuphakamisa ingalo nge-engeli yesokudla bese bekhomba unqenqema oluphambene.
• Lapho abahamba ngezinyawo bebonisa ukuthi bahlose ukuwela umgwaqo, kufanele umise imoto yakho ngokuphepha ngaphambi kwe-crosswalk bese ubavumela ukuba bawele.
• Uma umuntu ohamba ngezinyawo engene endaweni ye-crosswalk ephawulwe noma engaphawulwe, kufanele uvumele indlela elungile.
• Uma ume endaweni yokuwela abantu abahamba ngezinyawo, yima kude ngokwanele emuva (cishe ubude bezimoto ezimbili kuya kwezintathu) ukuze ithrafikhi kwezinye izindlela ikwazi ukubona umuntu ohamba ngezinyawo futhi ibe nesikhathi sokuma.
• Ungalokothi udlule enye imoto uma usondela endaweni yokuwela abantu abahamba ngezinyawo. Kuhlale kunethuba lokuthi enye imoto iyancipha noma ima endaweni yokuwela abantu abahamba ngezinyawo.
• Akuzona zonke izindawo zokuwela abantu ezihamba ngezinyawo eziphawuliwe, kodwa imithetho yokuphepha kwabahamba ngezinyawo kufanele ilandelwe kuzo zonke izindawo zokuwela abantu abahamba ngezinyawo.
• Cabangela abahambi ngezinyawo abangaboni kahle. Abanye bazoba nenduku emhlophe noma inja eqondisayo.
• Ebusuku, ungaqhubeki kakhulu nezibani zakho zangaphambili. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele ushayele ukuze ukwazi ukumisa imoto yakho ebangeni ongalibona kahle ngezibani zakho zangaphambili.
• Uma kumnyama, qaphela abahamba ngezinyawo. Kungaba nzima ukubabona bekude, ikakhulukazi uma begqoke izingubo ezimnyama.
• Izingane zingaba ezingalindelekile. Ezindaweni zokuhlala, qaphela izingane eziseduze nezimoto ezipakiwe, zigibela amabhayisikili, noma zidlala emgwaqweni. Bheka ngaphansi kwezimoto ezipakiwe ngaphambili kuzo zombili izinhlangothi zomgwaqo ukuze uhlole izinyawo zezingane, amathoyizi, namasondo ebhayisikili. Lokhu kunikeza isixwayiso sokuthi kungadingeka ume.

 Amabhayisikili

 Umthetho udinga abagibeli bamabhayisikili noma abagibeli ebhayisikilini, abangaphansi kweminyaka engu-18 ubudala, ukuba bagqoke isigqoko sokuphepha sebhayisikili esivunyelwe.

 Amathiphu okwabelana ngomgwaqo nabagibeli bamabhayisikili:
• Umgibeli webhayisikili ohamba eceleni futhi eqhuba ibhayisikili ungumuntu ohamba ngezinyawo.
• Abagibeli bamabhayisikili kudingeka bagibele eduze ngangokunokwenzeka nomngcele ofanele. Kodwa-ke, kungadingeka bagibele kude lapho begwema ama-drainage grates, imigodi yezimbiza, udoti, amatshe amatshe noma isihlabathi, izindawo ezimanzi noma ezishelelayo, kanye nomgwaqo onama-rust noma onemifantu. Qaphela izimo zomgwaqo ezingathinta umgibeli webhayisikili.
• Ibhayisikili eligitshelwayo liyimoto. Umgibeli webhayisikili kumele alandele imithetho yomgwaqo njengabashayeli bezinye izimoto.
· Umgibeli webhayisikili ohleli ebhayisikilini endaweni yokuhlangana kwemigwaqo, elinde isignali yokulawula ithrafikhi, unamalungelo nemithwalo yemfanelo efanayo nanoma iyiphi enye imoto elinde ukuqhubeka.
· Abagibeli bebhayisikili kudingeka basebenzise umzila ofanele lapho bejika ngakwesobunxele. Ibhayisikili nomgibeli bancane kunezinye izimoto, ababonakali kakhulu, futhi basengozini enkulu yethrafikhi lapho bejika ngakwesobunxele. Abagibeli bebhayisikili badinga ukucatshangelwa okwengeziwe lapho bejika ngakwesobunxele, ikakhulukazi emigwaqweni enemizila eminingi.
• Uma udlula umgibeli webhayisikili, shintsha imizila njengoba ubungenza kwezinye izimoto.
• Uma ulungiselela ukujika kwesokudla, qaphela abagibeli bebhayisikili abangase bagibele eceleni kwemoto yakho. Khumbula ukuhlola amahlombe akho ezindaweni ongaboni kuzo kwesokudla.
• Uma upake eceleni komgwaqo, hlola njalo abagibeli bebhayisikili ngaphambi kokuvula umnyango wemoto yakho. Kungumsebenzi womshayeli ukulinda kuze kube yilapho kuphephile ngaphambi kokuvula umnyango.
• Ngaphambi kokusuka eceleni komgwaqo, hlola abagibeli bebhayisikili abangase bagibele bedlula imoto yakho.
• Ungalandeli eduze kakhulu ngemuva kwabagibeli bamabhayisikili. Abanazo izibani zamabhuleki zokukuxwayisa uma bema.
• Qaphela izingane ezigibele amabhayisikili. Zingase zintule ulwazi oludingekayo namakhono okugibela amabhayisikili ngokuphephile emgwaqweni, futhi zingase zingazi zonke izingozi. Izingane ezigibele amabhayisikili amakhulu zisengozini yokulahlekelwa ukulawula.

 Abagibeli bamabhayisikili abasebenzisa imigwaqo nemigwaqo emikhulu kufanele benze okulandelayo:
• Gcina izandla zombili zisezibambi zezandla ngaphandle uma ubonisa isandla.
• Gcina zombili izinyawo kuma-pedal.
• Phatha inani labantu ibhayisikili eliklanyelwe ukubathwala kuphela.
• Ungalokothi ubambe noma unamathisele ibhayisikili kunoma iyiphi enye imoto ehambayo.
• Gibela ngefayela elilodwa ngaphandle uma udlula elinye ibhayisikili.
• Uma ugibela ibhayisikili sekuhlwile, faka okungenani isibani sekhanda esisodwa (kodwa kungabi ngaphezu kwezimbili), isibani esisodwa esibomvu sangemuva, kanye ne-reflector eyodwa ebomvu efakwe ngemuva kwebhayisikili. Gqoka izingubo ezikhanyayo nezikhanyayo.
• Qiniseka ukuthi ibhayisikili linamabhuleki asebenza kahle.
• Qiniseka ukuthi ibhayisikili lifakwe insimbi noma uphondo.

 Izithuthuthu

 Abagibeli bezithuthuthu bavame ukuhamba engxenyeni yesobunxele yomzila wabo. Lokhu kusiza ukubenza babonakale kakhulu kwabanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo. Akusho ukuthi bazojika ngakwesobunxele. Ngezinye izikhathi izimpawu zokujika zesithuthuthu zingaba nzima ukuzibona. Qaphela umgibeli ukuthola izinkomba. Uma umgibeli ehlola amahlombe, angase ahlose ukushintsha imizila noma ukujika.

 Uma ujika ngakwesobunxele, qaphela izithuthuthu ezizayo. Zingaba nzima ukuzibona, ikakhulukazi lapho kunezimoto eziningi, ebusuku, noma kusihlwa. Kungase kube nzima futhi ukwahlulela isivinini sesithuthuthu.

 Amathiphu okushayela ngokuphepha nabagibeli bezithuthuthu:
• Ungalokothi wabelane ngomzila nomgibeli wesithuthuthu. Umgibeli wesithuthuthu udinga wonke umzila ukuze ahambe ngokuphephile.
• Qaphela ukuthi abagibeli bezithuthuthu bavame ukuhamba ngaphakathi komzila wabo ukuze bagweme izingozi zomgwaqo, njengemigodi, futhi bagcine umcamelo wesikhala kwezinye izimoto.
• Uma ulandela umuntu ogibele isithuthuthu, vumela isikhala esengeziwe phakathi kwemoto yakho nesithuthuthu ngoba izithuthuthu zingama ngokushesha kakhulu.
• Qaphela ukuthi isimo sezulu esibi, izimo zomgwaqo, noma izingozi zomgwaqo kungenza umgibeli wesithuthuthu alahlekelwe ukulawula.

 Umbhalo ezithombeni:
• Umuntu ohamba ngezinyawo obonisa inhloso yokuwela umgwaqo.

Ukuqaphela izimoto ezinkulu kubalulekile ekuphepheni kwabo bonke abasebenzisi bomgwaqo. Landela lawa macebiso ukuqinisekisa ukushayela okuphephile lapho nihlanganyela umgwaqo nezimoto ezinkulu:
• Gcina isikhala esanele phakathi kwakho nezimoto ezinkulu.
• Uma usemuva kwemoto enkulu, yandisa isikhathi sakho esilandelayo kanye nebanga ukuze indawo yakho yokubuka ibe nkulu.
• Ungalokothi ungene esikhaleni esiphambi kwemoto enkulu esondela esibanini somgwaqo. Uma isibani somgwaqo sishintsha sibe bomvu umshayeli udinga leso sikhala esengeziwe sokuma. Ukusondela kakhulu emotweni yakhe kungase kungabaniki isikhala esanele sokubhuleka futhi kungabangela isimo esiyingozi. Khumbula ukuthi imoto enkulu idinga ibanga elengeziwe lokuma.
• Uma usegqumeni futhi uma ngemuva kwemoto enkulu, shiya isikhala esengeziwe phambi kwemoto yakho. Imoto enkulu ingase ibuyele emuva lapho umshayeli ekhulula amabhuleki akhe.
• Izimoto ezinkulu zingafafaza imfucuza, njengamatshe, efasiteleni lakho langaphambili. Hlala emuva ukuze ugweme umonakalo.
• Qaphela imoto enkulu ebuyela emuva. Uma useduze kakhulu ngemuva, umshayeli angase angakwazi ukukubona ezibukweni ezingemuva.
• Izimoto ezinkulu zinezindawo ezinkulu ezingaboni. Uma ushayela ngemuva kwemoto enkulu futhi ungakwazi ukubona zombili izibuko zayo ezisemaceleni, useduze kakhulu. Uma ungambona umshayeli esibukweni esiseceleni, umshayeli angakubona.
• Uzodinga isikhathi esengeziwe emzileni ozayo lapho udlula imoto enkulu. Ungadluli ngaphandle kokuthi uqinisekile ukuthi unesikhathi esanele nebanga lokuqedela iphasi ngokuphephile. Ezinye izimoto ezinkulu zinde futhi zingadonsa ama-trailer angaphezu kweyodwa.
• Izimoto ezinkulu zezentengiselwano zizodinga ibanga elithe xaxa ukuze wehlise ijubane noma ume. Ngemva kokudlula eyodwa, shiya isikhala esengeziwe ngaphambi kokuba ubuyele emzileni wakho ophambi kwayo. Lokhu kusebenza nasekushintsheni imizila ephambi kwayo.
• Izimoto ezinkulu zezentengiselwano zidinga isikhala esengeziwe sokujika. Uma imoto enkulu ijika ngakwesokudla, hlala kahle emuva futhi ungashayeli endaweni engakwesokudla semoto enkulu. Imoto yakho ingacindezelwa phakathi kwemoto enkulu nonqenqema noma onqenqemeni lomgwaqo.
• Uma usemgwaqweni lapho imoto enkulu ijika khona, qaphela ukuthi umqhubi wemoto angadinga ukushayela awele umugqa ophakathi, asike ikona, noma asebenzise ingxenye yomzila wakho ukuze aqedele ukujika. Misa emuva endaweni yokuhlangana ukuze uvumele umqhubi indawo yokuqedela ukujika.
• Izimoto ezinkulu zingadala umoya onamandla lapho zidlula, ikakhulukazi uma kunomoya onamandla owela umgwaqo. Lokhu kungathinta ikhono lakho lokulawula imoto yakho nokugcina indawo yakho yomzila.
• Abashayeli kumele baqaphele lapho besondela futhi bedlula imithwalo yezimoto ezinkulu. Eminye imithwalo yezimoto ezinkulu ihamba nge-convoy enezimoto zomshayeli ngaphambili nangemuva kwe-convoy. Imithwalo yezimoto ezinkulu kakhulu ivame ukuhamba ngesivinini esincishisiwe. Abashayeli bemithwalo yezimoto ezinkulu kakhulu kanye nama-convoy bavame ukufuna amathuba okuvumela ithrafikhi ukuthi idlule. Uma ukunqwabelana kwethrafikhi ngemuva komthwalo wezimoto ezinkulu kakhulu noma i-convoy kuba nzima, yonke iyunithi ivame ukusuka engxenyeni ehambayo yomgwaqo ukuze ivumele ithrafikhi idlule ngokuphepha. Abashayeli abafisa ukudlula imithwalo yezimoto ezinkulu noma ama-convoy kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi kuphephile ukwenza kanjalo ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi banendawo eyanele yokuhambahamba eduze kwemithwalo yezimoto ezinkulu noma ama-convoy, nokuthi bane-sightline eyanele yokuqinisekisa ukuthi akukho thrafikhi ezayo.

Izimoto zokuthutha izingodo zinde futhi zinzima uma zilayishiwe.

 • Ungalokothi udlule iloli yokuthutha izingodo ejika kwesobunxele noma kwesokudla emgwaqweni omkhulu. Ukwelulwa kwezingodo kusukela ngemuva kweloli kungaba ubude obungamamitha ayisishiyagalolunye (30 izinyawo). Uma la maloli ejika, izingodo zingavimba yonke noma eminye yemizila yomgwaqo omkhulu.

Abafundi abasebenzisa ibhasi lesikole bangaba sengozini lapho begibela noma behla ebhasini.

 Uma izibani zebhasi lesikole zikhanya:

 Emgwaqweni omkhulu ongahlukanisiwe (ongahlukaniswanga yi-median), yenza okulandelayo:
• Uma usondela ebhasini lesikole usuka kunoma yiluphi uhlangothi (usuka phambili noma ngemuva), futhi linezibani eziphuzi ezishintshanayo ezikhanya, kumelwe ulungele ukuma. Lesi yisixwayiso sokuthi izibani ezibomvu ezishintshanayo zizoqala ukukhanya futhi ibhasi lesikole liyama ukuvumela abafundi ukuthi bangene noma baphume.
• Uma udlula ibhasi lesikole elinezibani zalo eziphuzi ezishintshanayo ezikhanya, dlula ngokucophelela.
• Uma ibhasi lesikole lima ukuze abafundi bavule noma bavale, izibani zalo ezibomvu ezishintshanayo zizoqala ukukhanya. Uzobona futhi uphawu lokuma olunwetshiwe kusukela ohlangothini lwesobunxele lwebhasi lesikole. Kumelwe ume ngokuphelele cishe ngamamitha angu-20 (cishe ubude bezimoto ezine kuya kwezinhlanu) ukusuka ebhasini lesikole. Leli banga livumela abashayeli bezinye izimoto ngemuva kwakho ukuthi babone izibani ezikhanyayo nabafundi bewela umgwaqo omkhulu
• Kumelwe uhlale umile kuze kube yilapho izibani ezibomvu ezikhanyayo ezishintshanayo zicinyiwe futhi uphawu lokuma ohlangothini lomshayeli lungasanwetshwa.

 Emgwaqweni omkhulu ohlukaniswe yi-median, yenza okulandelayo:
• Uma usondela ebhasini lesikole usuka ngemuva futhi izibani zalo eziphuzi ezishintshanayo zikhanya, landela izinqubo ezifanayo njengoba ubungenza emgwaqweni omkhulu ongahlukaniswa yi-median.
• Uma usondela ebhasini lesikole usuka ngaphambili futhi ibhasi lesikole linezibani zalo eziphuzi ezishintshanayo noma ezibomvu ezikhanya, ungase uqhubeke ngokuqapha. Qaphela abahamba ngezinyawo. Khumbula, lokhu kusemgwaqweni omkhulu ohlukene kuphela.

 Le mithetho isebenza noma nini lapho izibani zebhasi lesikole zisebenza khona. Abanye omasipala banemithetho yokusebenza kwebhasi lesikole eqondene nesifunda sabo.

Uma kususwa iqhwa emigwaqweni, ama-snowplow angase adale ifu leqhwa elenza kube nzima ngabashayeli bezinye izimoto ukuwabona. Kungase kube nzima nokubona ngale kwama-snowplow ezimoto ezizayo.

 Amathiphu okuphepha lapho ushayela eduze kwe-snowplow:
• Ama-snowplow afakwe izibani ezikhanyayo eziphuzi nezibomvu ukuze zibonakale kakhulu. Khumbula, `ukukhanya okuphuzi nokubomvu kusho ukulima kweqhwa phambili`.
• Gcina ibanga eliphephile ngemuva kwe-snowplow. Izimoto eziningi zokulungisa zizoba nophawu ngemuva ukuze zazise abashayeli bezimoto ibanga eliphephile lokulandela. Ukugcina leli banga kuzokunika isikhathi esengeziwe sokusabela ezintweni ezingalindelekile, futhi ugweme ukulimala kwedwala emotweni yakho kusuka kuyunithi yokusantisa i-snowplow.
• Ukudlula i-snowplow kuvinjelwe ngokuphelele uma:
· umbono ohlangothini lwe-snowplow uvinjiwe
· ukudlula kuphazamisa ukusebenza kwe-snowplow, noma
· isenzo sokudlula asikwazi ukwenziwa ngokuphephile.
• Abasebenzi be-snow plow bazohamba baye eceleni komgwaqo, lapho kuphephile khona, njalo ngamakhilomitha amahlanu kuya kwayisishiyagalombili ukuze kuvunyelwe izimoto ukuba zidlule. Ngisho noma ukudlula kuvunyelwe, kuphephile ukuhlala emuva kuze kube yilapho umqhubi we-snowplow ekwazi ukuhamba ngokuphephile ukuze avumele izimoto ukuba zidlule.
• Ngaphambi kokudlula i-snowplow emgwaqweni omkhulu onemizila emibili (umzila owodwa ohlangothini ngalunye), qiniseka ukuthi ubona kude ngokwanele ngaphambili nokuthi ukudlula kuvunyelwe izimpawu zomgwaqo noma izimpawu. Uma i-snowplow isondela ohlangothini oluphambene, bheka phambili emzileni wakho ngokucophelela. Kungase kube nemoto ezayo edlula i-snowplow isebenzisa umzila wakho. Lungela ukusebenzisa indlela yokubaleka.

Ungalokothi uzame ukujaha isitimela uye endaweni yokuwela. Izitimela zidinga ibanga elide kakhulu ukuze zime. Zivumele njalo.

 Izindawo zokuwela izitimela zimakwe ngezimpawu. Zingaba namadivayisi okuxwayisa ngomshini noma kagesi.

 Izimpawu zokuxwayisa kusengaphambili:

 Lezi zimpawu zikutshela ukuthi ubheke, ulalele, futhi wehlise isivinini ngoba kungadingeka ume ukuze ugibele isitimela. Uphawu lwesivinini olungaphansi kophawu lokuxwayisa kusengaphambili luyisivinini esinconywayo sokuwela isitimela. Luzoba ngaphansi kwesivinini esibekiwe somgwaqo.

 Izimpawu zomgwaqo:

 Izimpawu zomgwaqo, njengo-X kanye/noma umugqa wokuma, zingamakwa endaweni yokuwela izitimela lapho kusondela ezinye izindawo zokuwela izitimela. Uma kufanele ume ukuze ugibele isitimela, kwenze ngaphambi komugqa wokuma.

 Izimpawu zokuwela izitimela:

 Lezi zimpawu zitholakala kuzo zonke izindawo zokuwela izitimela zomphakathi. Uphawu lokuwela isitimela lusho ukuthi abashayeli kumele bavumele zonke izitimela. Uma kunezindlela zesitimela ezingaphezu kweyodwa, uphawu lokuwela luzobonisa inani lezindlela. Kumelwe ume lapho isitimela sibonakala noma sikhala isignali futhi sisondela ngaphakathi kwamamitha angu-500 (cishe amabhlogo amahlanu edolobha) ukusuka endaweni yokuwela.

 Izimpawu zokuwela isitimela ezinophawu lokuma:

 Uphawu lokuma endaweni yokuwela isitimela ludinga umshayeli ukuthi ame ngokuphelele phakathi kwamamitha amahlanu (15 izinyawo) namamitha angu-15 (50 izinyawo) ukusuka endaweni yesitimela esiseduze. Ungaqhubeki uze uqiniseke ukuthi isitimela asisondeli.

 Izimpawu zokukhanya okubomvu ezikhanyayo kanye nensimbi:

 Izimpawu zokukhanya okubomvu zisetshenziswa nezimpawu zesitimela ezindaweni eziningi zokuwela isitimela. Misa lapho izibani ziqala ukukhanya futhi izinsimbi zikhala ukukhombisa ukuthi isitimela sisondela. Umshayeli wemoto eseduze nendawo yokuwela kumele ame okungenani amamitha amahlanu emuva endaweni yesitimela esiseduze. Ungaqhubeki kuze kube yilapho izibani nezinsimbi sezimile, futhi isitimela sesidlulile noma sesime ngokuphelele. Uma kunezindlela ezingaphezu kweyodwa, qiniseka ukuthi zonke izindlela zicacile ngaphambi kokuwela.

 Amasango (izingalo), izibani, nezinsimbi:

 Amasango asetshenziswa ngezibonakaliso zokukhanya ezibomvu nezinsimbi kwezinye izindawo zokuwela zesitimela. Kumelwe uhlale umile kuze kube yilapho amasango ephakanyisiwe, izibani ziyeke ukukhanya, nezinsimbi ziyeke ukukhala.

 Landela lawa macebiso okuphepha lapho ushayela eduze kwemizila yesitimela:
• Ungabhajwa ezitimeleni zesitimela endaweni yokuwela yesitimela. Linda lapho usondela endaweni yokuwela bese uwela kuphela uma uqinisekile ukuthi ungakwazi ukuqeda indawo yokuwela.
• Lapho imoto yokugcina yesitimela idlula indawo yokuwela, qiniseka ukuthi esinye isitimela asifiki ngaphambi kokuba uqhubekele phambili. Isitimela sesibili singafika kwenye indlela sisuka kwenye indlela. Ungase ungakwazi ukuzwa isitimela sesibili ngenxa yomsindo wesokuqala.
• Ungalokothi ushayele uzungeze amasango. Uma isango liphansi, liphakama, noma lehla, ungaweli imigwaqo.
• Uma imoto yakho ine-gearbox ejwayelekile (eyenziwe ngesandla), ungashintshi amagiya ngenkathi uwela imigwaqo. Uma ungakwazi ukuqeda ishifti, imoto yakho ingamiwa emizileni.
• Uma imoto yakho ima endaweni yokuwela isitimela, khipha wonke umuntu emotweni futhi uqhelelane nemigwaqo ngokushesha. Uma isitimela siza, hamba kahle emotweni yakho futhi uqhelelane nemigwaqo. Uma kungenzeka, hamba uye lapho isitimela sisondela khona. Lokhu kuzokuvimbela ekushayweni yimfucumfucu endizayo uma isitimela sishayisa imoto emi.
• Ngesikhathi sezulu esibi noma ebusuku, qaphela isixwayiso sesitimela esisengaphambili kanye nezimpawu zesitimela. Shayela ngesivinini esizokuvumela ukuthi ukwazi ukuma ngaphakathi kwebanga elikhanyiswe kahle yizibani zakho zangaphambili.

 Khumbula, kungathatha ikhilomitha noma ngaphezulu ukuthi isitimela sime, ngisho nangaphansi kokubhuleka okuphuthumayo okuphelele. Ukuphepha kwakho nabagibeli bakho kuncike ngokuphelele kuwe njengomshayeli.

description: Izimoto zezentengiselwano ezithutha abagibeli noma izimpahla eziyingozi zingadingeka ngokomthetho noma ngenqubomgomo yenkampani ukuthi zime lapho kuwela khona izitimela. Lungela ukuma lapho ulandela imoto yezentengiselwano eduze nendawo yokuwela izitimela.

Izindawo zokuwela zesitimela esincane (LRT) eCalgary nase-Edmonton zifana nezinye izindawo zokuwela zesitimela futhi zidinga abahamba ngezinyawo, abagibeli bamabhayisikili, kanye nabashayeli bezimoto ukuba baqaphele kulezi zindawo.

 Izinhlelo ze-LRT zisebenza ngogesi, okwenza zithule kakhulu. Lezi zindawo zokuwela zisebenzisa amadivayisi ahlukahlukene okuxwayisa njengezibani zesignali zomgwaqo ezivamile, izimpawu, izinsimbi, namasango. Lezi zixwayiso zonke zisho ukuthi yima futhi ungaweli emigwaqweni.

 Ungalokothi ushayele uzungeze amasango, noma ngabe isitimela se-LRT sisanda kudlula. Esinye singase sivele kolunye uhlangothi.

 Ngenxa yesisindo nesivinini saso, isitimela se-LRT singathatha amamitha ayi-100 (330 izinyawo) ukuma esimweni esiphuthumayo.

Uma ushayela, kubalulekile ukuqaphela izimoto ezingaphandle komgwaqo omkhulu kanye nabasebenzi bazo abangase babe seduze noma bazama ukuwela umgwaqo omkhulu. Qaphela lapho uhlangana nezimoto ezihamba yonke indawo, izimoto zeqhwa, noma izimoto ezifanayo.

Uma uhlanganyela emngcwabeni, uvunyelwe ukuqhubeka udlule endaweni lapho kuhlangana khona izimoto enophawu lokuma noma isibani sethrafikhi esibomvu ngaphandle kokuma. Izibani zakho zangaphambili kumele zivulwe. Ungaqhubeka kuphela uma ulandela eduze imoto ephambi kwakho emngcwabeni futhi kuphephile ukwenza kanjalo.

 Ungadluli emngcwabeni. Veza ilungelo lokungena kuze kube yilapho selidlulile ngaphambi kokuba uqhubeke.

Ingabe ukulungele ukushayela?

 Kubalulekile ukuqaphela izici ezingathinta ikhono lakho lokushayela ngokuphepha. Ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa, njengotshwala nezidakamizwa, kungaphazamisa ukwahlulela kwakho nesikhathi sokusabela lapho usebenzisa imoto. Eminye imithi, ngisho naleyo etholakala ngomuthi kadokotela noma ngaphandle kwemithi kadokotela, ingaba nomphumela ofanayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukucindezeleka, ukukhathala, kanye nokuntuleka kokulala nakho kungaba nomthelela omubi ekhonweni lakho lokushayela.

 Ukukhathala

 Ukushayela ukhathele kungaba yingozi kakhulu futhi kuvame ukubangelwa yizici ezahlukahlukene ezifana nalezi:
• ukungalali kahle noma ukuphumula
• ukucindezeleka ngokomzwelo
• isithukuthezi
• ukushayela isikhathi eside
• umsebenzi womzimba
• ukugula
• ukukhathala kwamehlo.

 Ukukhathala kungandiswa futhi yizici ezifana nokudla ngokweqile, ukusebenzisa utshwala noma izidakamizwa, noma ngisho nemoto efudumele nekhululekile.

 Ukukhathala kungandisa isikhathi osithathayo ukuze usabele. Kungaphazamisa nokwahlulela kwakho kanye nokwenza izinqumo. Lokhu kungabangela amaphutha okushayela njengokushayela uphuma emgwaqweni, ungene komunye umzila, noma ungene emotweni ezayo. Ungase ungaqapheli ukuthi usesimweni esiyingozi noma ungakwazi ukusabela ngokushesha.

 Ukuze unciphise ingozi yokukhathala, yenza okulandelayo:
• Qiniseka ukuthi uphumule kahle ngaphambi kokuba uqale uhambo lwakho.
• Gcina imoto yakho isezingeni lokushisa elifanele. Qiniseka ukuthi inomoya omuhle.
• Gcina amehlo akho ehamba ngokuskena umgwaqo phambili nangemuva. Hlala uqaphele indawo ekuzungezile futhi uhlole ama-gauge emoto yakho.
• Sebenzisa izibuko zelanga ezinsukwini ezikhanyayo.
• Uma uzizwa ukhathele, yima uphumule. Hamba uzungeze imoto yakho.
• Ungashayeli ngemuva kokuphuza utshwala noma ukuthatha izidakamizwa.

 Imithi

 Eminye imithi kadokotela nemithi engagunyaziwe (etholakala ngaphandle kwemvume kadokotela) ingaba nomthelela omubi ekhonweni lakho lokuphatha imoto, ukwahlulela, kanye nokwenza izinqumo ezifanele lapho usebenzisa imoto. Imiphumela emibi ingafaka ukozela noma isiyezi.

 Khuluma nodokotela wakho kanye nosokhemisi. Yazi imiphumela yayo yonke imithi kadokotela nemithi engagunyaziwe kadokotela oyithathayo ngaphambi kokusebenzisa noma iyiphi imoto. Yazi ukuthi imiphumela yotshwala noma izidakamizwa izoba yini uma uyihlanganisa nemithi yakho.

 Utshwala nezidakamizwa

 Ukuphuza utshwala nokushayela kuyinhlanganisela eyingozi ebeka wena nabanye endleleni engozini enkulu. Ukushayela ukhubazekile kuyaqhubeka nokuba yimbangela enkulu yokufa kwabantu emgwaqweni kanye nokulimala e-Alberta.

 Ngokwesilinganiso, kusukela ngo-2016 kuya ku-2020, minyaka yonke kwabulawa abantu ababalelwa ku-38 kanti abantu abangu-535 balimala ezingozini ezihilela ukushayela kabi.

 Izidakamizwa noma utshwala zizolimaza ukushayela kwakho. Ukusebenzisa imoto ngokuphepha nangokwethembeka kudinga ukuthi uqaphele. Ukukhubazeka kuqala ngokusebenzisa utshwala noma izidakamizwa okokuqala. Kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abashayeli baqonde izingozi zokusebenzisa utshwala noma izidakamizwa nokushayela, futhi baqaphele ukuthi kunezingozi, imithetho, kanye nezijeziso ezihilelekile kulokhu kukhetha.

 Ungase ubhekane nalokhu:
• izinhlawulo ezinkulu
• irekhodi lobugebengu
• isikhathi ejele
• ukulahlekelwa amalungelo akho elayisensi yokushayela
• amaphrimiyamu omshwalense wemoto akhuphukile
• umonakalo empahleni
• ukulimala okukhulu noma ukufa
• ukulahlekelwa umsebenzi, uma ukushayela kudingeka njengengxenye yomsebenzi.

Amaphuzu okulahlekelwa kanye nemiphumela

 Amaphuzu okulahlekelwa aqoshwa ngokumelene nerekhodi lakho lokushayela uma ulahlwe yicala. Ulahlwe yicala uma:
• ukhokha inhlawulo ehlolwa ithikithi lakho ngokuzithandela
• uvela enkantolo futhi utholakala unecala
• wehluleka ukuvela enkantolo futhi `ulahlwe yicala (unecala) ungekho`

 Izigwebo kanye nezikhathi lapho amalungelo akho elayisensi yokushayela emisiwe zihlala kurekhodi lakho lokushayela iminyaka eyi-10 futhi zizovela ku-abstract yokushayela kwakho.

 Abashayeli abanelayisensi ephelele:

 Uma uqoqe amaphuzu ayisishiyagalombili kuya kwayi-14 okulahlekelwa phakathi nesikhathi seminyaka emibili, uzothola incwadi ekwazisa ngesimo sakho sephoyinti lokulahlekelwa. Uma uqoqe amaphuzu okulahlekelwa ayi-15 noma ngaphezulu phakathi nesikhathi seminyaka emibili amalungelo akho elayisensi yokushayela azomiswa ngokuzenzakalelayo isikhathi esithile. Uma isikhathi sokumiswa kwakho sesiphelile, amalungelo akho elayisensi yokushayela azobuyiselwa kanye namaphuzu ayisikhombisa okushiyeka kurekhodi lakho lelayisensi yokushayela. La maphuzu azohlala kurekhodi lakho lokushayela isikhathi seminyaka emibili kusukela ngosuku lokubuyiselwa encwadini.

 Uma usuqoqe amaphuzu amane kuya kwayisikhombisa okushiyeka kungakapheli iminyaka emibili, uzothola incwadi ekwazisa ngesimo sakho sokushiyeka.  Ukushayela ngenkathi amalungelo akho elayisensi yokushayela emisiwe noma engavunyelwe

 Uma usebenzisa imoto ngenkathi amalungelo akho elayisensi yokushayela emisiwe noma engavunyelwe ungabhekana nesikhathi ejele, izinhlawulo, noma kokubili. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma okwamanje ukhonza ukumiswa, uzobhekana nokumiswa okunye. Imoto oyishayelayo izothathwa futhi iboshwe izinsuku ezingu-30 kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubani ongumnikazi obhalisiwe. Zonke izindleko zokudonsa kanye nezimali zokubopha zizokhokhiswa kumnikazi obhalisiwe wemoto.

 Amalungelo akho okushayela elayisensi yokushayela angamiswa noma angavunyelwe. Uma uthola ukumiswa noma ukungafaneleki kwelayisensi yokushayela uzothola isaziso ngencwadi ebhalisiwe ekhelini lokugcina elirekhodiwe kurekhodi lakho lelayisensi yokushayela, elivela ku-Driver Fitness and Monitoring, elibonisa izizathu zokumiswa noma ukungafaneleki kwakho.

 Uma amalungelo akho okushayela elayisensi yokushayela emisiwe noma engavunyelwe, incwadi yakho yeSaziso Sokumiswa izokhomba ubude bokumiswa noma ukungafaneleki kwakho kanye nemibandela okumele uyihlangabezane nayo ukuze amalungelo akho okushayela abuyiselwe.
