 Isaziso Sokumiswa sizothunyelwa kuwe ngeposi ekhelini lokugcina elirekhodiwe elayisensini yakho yokushayela. Qiniseka ukuthi ilayisensi yakho yokushayela inekheli lakho lamanje.

 Ukumiswa kuhlala kusebenza kuze kube yilapho yonke imibandela eseSazisweni Sokumiswa ihlangatshezwa. Lokhu kufaka phakathi abashayeli abashiye isifundazwe. Funda isaziso sakho ngokucophelela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uhlangabezane nemibandela yokumiswa kwakho. Uma ungahlangabezananga nemibandela yokumiswa kwakho amalungelo akho okushayela angase angabuyiselwa.

 Isaziso Sokumiswa sizofaka yonke imibandela okumele ihlangatshezwane nayo ngaphambi kokubuyiselwa kwamalungelo akho okushayela.

 Ngenkokhelo yokushayela ehlobene notshwala, izidakamizwa, noma utshwala kanye nezidakamizwa, eminye yemibandela okungadingeka uyihlangabezane nayo yile:
1. Yiba khona ohlelweni lokushayela losuku olulodwa.
2. Yiba khona ohlelweni lokushayela lwempelasonto.
3. Ukubamba iqhaza kuHlelo Lokuvinjelwa Kokushaja lwase-Alberta.

 Kuzodingeka futhi ukhokhe imali yokubuyiselwa futhi wenze ukuhlolwa komgwaqo.

 Ngemva kokuba isikhathi sakho sokumiswa sesiphelile, kufanele uye ehhovisi le-ejenti yokubhalisa yase-Alberta bese unikeza ubufakazi bokuthi uhlangabezane nezidingo zakho zokubuyiselwa. I-ejenti yokubhalisa izokwazi ukukunikeza ilayisensi yokushayela. Isaziso esibhaliwe esithi amalungelo akho okushayela abuyiselwe sizothunyelwa kuwe ngeposi.

 Uma ilayisensi yakho yokushayela iphelelwa yisikhathi ngesikhathi sokumiswa, ayikwazi ukuvuselelwa kuze kube yilapho zonke izimo zokubuyiselwa sezihlangatsheziwe.

 Uhlelo lokuxhumanisa i-Ignition

 Uhlelo lwe-Ignition Interlock lwase-Alberta:
• lwenzelwe ukusiza abantu ukuthi bahlukanise ukuziphatha okuyingozi kakhulu kokushayela ngenkathi bekhubazekile,
• lusetshenziswa njengethuluzi lokufundisa ukuvimbela ukuphindaphinda kobugebengu, kanye
• lusetshenziselwa ukuvimbela abashayeli abasengozini enkulu ekusebenziseni izimoto zabo ngenkathi bekhubazekile.

 Uhlelo lwe-Alberta’s Ignition Interlock luvumela abashayeli ukuthi bahlale behambahamba ukuze bakwazi ukuthola ukwesekwa nokwelashwa, balondoloze umsebenzi, futhi banakekele amalungu omndeni ngenkathi beqinisekisa ukuphepha komphakathi ngokuqapha okusebenzayo kanye namalungelo okushayela anqunyelwe.

 Uhlelo lwe-Ignition Interlock luhilela ukufakwa kwedivayisi yokuxhuma emotweni elinganisa izinga lokugcwala kotshwala lomoya womshayeli, futhi izovala ukushaqeka kwemoto (imoto ngeke ikwazi ukuqalwa noma ukuqhutshwa) uma ukufundwa kokugcwala kotshwala komoya kungaphezu kwezinga elibekiwe.

 Uhlelo lwe-Alberta’s Ignition Interlock luhlanganisa imifudlana emithathu ehlukene yokubamba iqhaza:

 1. I-IRS: Uhlelo lwe-FAIL Interlock Ignition:

 Lolu hlelo lungolwabashayeli abanikezwe ukumiswa kwelayisensi yokushayela ngaphansi kohlelo lwe-IRS: FAIL lokushayela okukhubazekile ezingeni lobugebengu, futhi lapho usuku lokwenzeka lwalungomhlaka-1 Disemba 2020 noma ngemuva kwawo.

 2. Uhlelo Lokumiswa Kwelayisensi Yokuphatha yase-Alberta Uhlelo Lokushaqeka Kwe-Interlock:

 Lolu hlelo lungolwabashayeli abanikezwe ukumiswa kwelayisensi yokushayela ngaphansi koHlelo Lokumiswa Kwelayisensi Yokuphatha yase-Alberta yokushayela okuphazamisekile ezingeni lobugebengu, futhi lapho usuku lokwenzeka lwalungoNovemba 30, 2020 noma ngaphambi kwalo.

 3. Uhlelo Lokushaqeka Kwe-Interlock Okuphoqelekile:

 Lo mzila wokubamba iqhaza uyimpoqo kubo bonke abashayeli abatholwe benecala lokushayela okuphazamisekile ngaphansi kweKhodi Yobugebengu yaseCanada, njengengxenye yezidingo zabo zokubuyiselwa emsebenzini. Abashayeli kumele basebenze ngokugcwele isikhathi sabo esidingekayo kuHlelo Lokushaqeka Kwe-Interlock Okuphoqelekile ukuze ikhodi yesimo sokubuyiselwa emsebenzini efanele igcwaliswe/isuswe efayeleni lezimoto zabo futhi babuyisele ngokugcwele ilayisensi yabo yokushayela. Abashayeli kulo mzila wokubamba iqhaza kumele babonise ikhono eliqhubekayo lokuhlukanisa ukuziphatha okuyingozi kakhulu.

 Incwadi yesaziso sokumiswa izothunyelwa ekhelini lokugcina eliqoshwe kufayela lakho lemoto. Kungumthwalo wakho ukwazisa ihhovisi le-ejenti yokubhalisa yase-Alberta noma nini lapho ushintsha ikheli lakho leposi.

 • Incwadi yesaziso sokumiswa izobonisa imibandela okumele igcwaliswe ngaphambi kokubuyiselwa kwamalungelo akho okushayela.
• Isaziso sokumiswa sizobonisa usuku lokuqala kokumiswa kwakho.
• Kufanele unikezele ilayisensi yakho yokushayela kunoma yiliphi ihhovisi le-ejenti yokubhalisa yase-Alberta ngosuku noma ngaphambi kosuku lokuqala ukusebenza. Akukho emthethweni ukuba nelayisensi yakho yokushayela ngenkathi ukhonza ukumiswa. Kuyicala elibi ukusebenzisa imoto ngenkathi ukhonza ukumiswa.
• Kumelwe usebenze isikhathi sokumiswa.

 Ukumiswa kwesifundazwe

 Ukumiswa kwesifundazwe kungabekwa ngezizathu ezifana nerekhodi lokushayela elibi, ukwehluleka ukukhokha isahlulelo esisemthethweni, izizathu zezokwelapha, noma ukwehluleka ukulandela iSaziso Sokubika

I-SafeRoads Alberta igatsha lokwahlulela kwezokuphatha le-Transportation and Economic Corridors elinomthwalo wokwenza ukubuyekezwa kwezijeziso zokuphatha zesifundazwe ezitholwa abashayeli abakhubazekile kanye nokubuyekezwa kokubanjwa kwezimoto.

 I-SafeRoads Alberta yenza ukubuyekezwa kwezinselelo zezijeziso zokuphatha zesifundazwe ngaphansi kohlelo lwe-IRS. Zonke izindaba zixazululwa ezinsukwini ezingama-30 ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abashayeli abakhubazekile abasekho emigwaqweni. Amacala abucayi kakhulu, okuhlanganisa ukwephula umthetho okuphindaphindiwe kanye nokushayela okukhubazeka okubangela ukufa noma ukulimala emzimbeni, azothola kokubili izinhlawulo zokuphatha zesifundazwe kanye namacala e-Criminal Code of Canada.

 Ukubuyekezwa kokushayela okukhubazeka

 I-SafeRoads Alberta yenza ukubuyekezwa kwezinselelo zezijeziso zokuphatha zesifundazwe ngaphansi kohlelo lwe-IRS.

 Abashayeli abafisa ukudlulisa isikhalo ngesijeziso sabo sokushayela okukhubazeka bangenza kanjalo ngokufaka isicelo sokubuyekezwa ku-SafeRoads Alberta ku-www.saferoads.com.

 Ukubuyekezwa kokubanjwa kwezimoto

 Ukuthathwa kwezimoto kubuyekezwa yi-SafeRoads Alberta. Uma imoto ithathwe ngokwesigaba 94 soMthetho Wokuphepha Kwethrafikhi, ngemva kokwebiwa noma ukuthathwa ngaphandle kwemvume, noma uma imoto ingeyomnikazi wenkampani yokuqasha izimoto, ungacela ukubuyiselwa kwemoto nge-SafeRoads Alberta.

 Abanikazi ababhalisiwe banesibopho sazo zonke izindleko ezihilelekile ekuthathweni kwemoto. Ukufaka isicelo sokubuyekezwa akuqinisekisi ukubuyiselwa kwemoto, futhi izimali zokubuyekezwa azibuyiselwa.

Inqubo Yokucatshangelwa Kabusha Kwababhalisi inikeza abantu base-Alberta ikhono lokufaka isikhalo ngezinqumo zokushayela ezingaphazamiseki.

Kumelwe ube nokubhaliswa okusemthethweni okuvela kurejista yase-Alberta ye-trailer yakho futhi kumele kube nawe uma udonsa i-trailer. Kumelwe futhi kube nepuleti lelayisensi elisebenzayo elinamathiselwe ngemuva kwe-trailer futhi libonakale kahle. Ukubhaliswa kanye nepuleti lelayisensi kuyadingeka ngaphambi kokuba i-trailer isetshenziswe emgwaqweni.

• I-trailer yakho kumele ibe nezibani zangemuva ezisebenzayo, izibani zamabhuleki, kanye nezimpawu zokujika ezisebenza emotweni edonsayo.
• Uma une-hitch yebhola nesokhethi, kuzodingeka futhi unamathisele amaketanga okuphepha phakathi kwe-trailer nemoto edonsayo. Amaketanga kufanele awelwe ngaphansi kolimi lwe-trailer futhi aboshwe ngokuphephile. Lokhu kusebenza kuzo zonke izinqola ngaphandle kwezinqola zamasondo amahlanu.
• Uma i-trailer yakho ifakwe uhlelo lwesibili lokuphuka oluphuthumayo, qiniseka ukuthi uhlelo luxhunywe kahle ngokwemiyalelo yomenzi.
• Lungisa izibuko zemoto yakho ukuze ubone kahle ithrafikhi esondela ngemuva. Kufanele usebenzise izibuko zokwandisa uma i-trailer ibanzi kunemoto edonsa i-trailer.

 Amabhuleki ayadingeka ku-trailer uma edingeka ukulawula ukuhamba okuphephile kwe-trailer. Kodwa-ke, ama-trailer alandelayo awadingi amabhuleki:
• ama-trailer anesisindo esiphelele esingu-910 amakhilogremu (2,000 amakhilogremu ) noma ngaphansi, noma
• ama-trailer anesisindo esiphelele esingaphansi kwengxenye yesisindo esingalayishiwe semoto edonsayo.

Uma ushayela nge-trailer, kubalulekile ukukhumbula isisindo nobude obengeziwe:
• Vumela isikhathi esengeziwe kanye nebanga ngaphambi kokungena emotweni.
• Gcina ibanga eliphephile lokulandela ezinye izimoto futhi uqaphele isikhala esengeziwe esidingekayo ukuze uqondise ubude obengeziwe be-trailer.
• Sheshisa futhi ubhuleke kancane, futhi uvumele isikhathi esengeziwe lapho uhlanganisa noma ushintsha imizila.
• Uma ushayela emgwaqweni omkhulu onemizila eminingi, khumbula ukuthi izimoto ezihamba kancane kufanele zihambe ngendlela efanele.
• Hlela ukushayela kwakho. Bheka phambili ukuze ubikezele futhi uphathe izingozi ezingaba khona. Gwema izimo ezingadinga ukushintsha imizila ngokushesha noma ukuma okungalindelekile.
• Uma ithrafikhi yanda ngemuva kwakho, thola indawo ephephile yokuma ngaphandle komgwaqo ukuze uvumele abanye badlule.

 Ukujika ezimpambanweni

 Ukujika kwesobunxele:
• Sondela ekujikeni kancane. Uma ususeduze nendawo yokuhlangana kwemigwaqo, hamba eduze komngcele ongakwesokudla womzila wakho ngaphandle kokuwela noma ukwelula noma iyiphi ingxenye yemoto yakho noma i-trailer uye emzileni olandelayo. Lokhu kuzokunika isikhala esengeziwe sokuqedela ukujika ngokuphephile.
• Qala ukujika kwakho lapho ingaphambili lemoto yakho lilingana nohlangothi lwesobunxele lomzila owufunayo.
• Bheka ngezikhathi ezithile esibukweni sakho sangaphandle kwesobunxele emasondo e-trailer ngesikhathi sokujika. Amasondo e-trailer azohamba ngendlela engaphakathi kwendlela yamasondo emoto yakho. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi i-off-tracking.
• Ukuze uvumele i-off-tracking, hamba uye ohlangothini lwesokudla lomzila emgwaqweni ongena kuwo.
• Lapho nje i-trailer yakho isidlulile ekujikeni ngokuphephile, qondisa imoto iye maphakathi nomzila wakho.
• Ukuze ujike kwesokudla, buyisela emuva lezi ziqondiso. Kodwa-ke, uma ungavumeli i-off-tracking ungathinta umgwaqo, imoto epakiwe, noma umuntu ohamba ngezinyawo.

 Ukusekela i-trailer

 Ukusekela i-trailer kudinga ukuzijwayeza. Ngezinye izikhathi, ukuze uqondise i-trailer lapho ubuyisela emuva uzophendula isondo lokuqondisa ngendlela ehlukile kunaleyo obungayenza uma ubuyisela emuva ngaphandle kwe-trailer.

 Uma usebenzisa imoto ukuze ubuyisele i-trailer emuva, yenza okulandelayo:
• Cela othile akuqondise.
• Uma ungenaye umhlahlandlela, hamba uye ngemuva kwe-trailer ukuqinisekisa ukuthi indlela engemuva icacile.
• Njalo buyela emuva ungasheshi ngaphezu kwejubane lokuhamba.

 Qala ukubuyela emuva ngokuphendula isondo lokuqondisa ngendlela ehlukile ofuna ukuya ngayo. Jikisa isondo lokuqondisa ngakwesokudla ukuze uye kwesobunxele. Ngokufanayo, jikisa isondo lokuqondisa ngakwesokunxele ukuze uye kwesokudla.

 • Ukuze ugweme ukuthi imoto yakho ithinte i-trailer, jika isondo lokuqondisa kuphela ukujika kwekota kuya kwesigamu. Lapho nje i-trailer iqala ukujika, buyisela isondo lokuqondisa endaweni evamile. Sebenzisa ukunyakaza okuncane kwesiteringi ukuqondisa i-trailer.

 Uma usekela i-trailer ngakwesokudla, qaphela ukuthi ukubonakala kwakho kunqunyelwe ngenxa yezindawo ezingabonakali ngemuva kwe-trailer.

 Umbhalo ezithombeni:
Jikela kwesobunxele uma udonsa i-trailer - qaphela indlela yemoto namasondo e-trailer.
Jikela kwesokudla uma udonsa i-trailer - qaphela indlela yemoto namasondo e-trailer.
Indawo yamathayi emoto edonsayo ukuze usekele i-trailer.
